stemZh: ——吉姆邀请你去他的聚会了吗？——邀请了，但我拒绝了他。我得在家照顾妹妹。
explanation: invite sb. to one's party 意为“邀请某人参加聚会”，故选 C。

stem: I think she ________ a famous singer in the future.
stemZh: 我认为她将来会成为一名著名歌手。
explanation: 表示对未来的预测，用 will be，故选 B。

stem: —What's your ________ about the result of our school basketball match next week? —I'm sure Class 8 will be the winner.
stemZh: ——你对我们学校下周篮球赛的结果有什么预测？——我确定八班会赢。
explanation: prediction 意为“预测”，对比赛结果的预测，故选 B。

stem: —________ you be at home tonight? —Yes, I will.
stemZh: ——你今晚会在家吗？——是的，我会。
explanation: 询问将来情况的一般疑问句，用 Will 开头，故选 C。

stem: My parents often tell me ________ in the street. It's dangerous.
stemZh: 我父母经常告诉我不要在街上玩。那很危险。
explanation: tell sb. not to do sth. 意为“告诉某人不要做某事”，故选 B。

stem: Mike is the ________ in our class because he often thinks out new ideas.
stemZh: 迈克是我们班最有创造力的人，因为他经常想出新点子。
explanation: most creative 意为“最有创造力的”，与想出新点子相符，故选 C。

stem: —Are you going to do a part-time job in your free time? —Yes. I don't think I should always ________ my parents.
stemZh: ——你打算在空闲时间做兼职吗？——是的。我觉得我不应该总是依赖父母。
explanation: depend on 意为“依靠、依赖”，符合语境，故选 C。

stem: We all know that the earth ________ around the sun.
stemZh: 我们都知道地球绕着太阳转。
explanation: 描述客观事实用一般现在时，主语 the earth 是第三人称单数，用 goes，故选 B。

stem: —Do you know the ________ of the fame show? —I'm not really sure. Maybe Richard Smith.
stemZh: ——你知道这个名人秀的获胜者是谁吗？——我不太确定。也许是理查德·史密斯。
explanation: winner 意为“获胜者”，Maybe Richard Smith 是人，故选 C。

stem: I believe I ________ a better level if I practice more.
stemZh: 我相信如果多练习，我会达到更好的水平。
explanation: if 条件句主将从现，主句用 will reach，故选 B。

stem: —What are your plans for the weekend? —I'm not sure. Maybe I ________ a movie with my family.
stemZh: ——你周末有什么计划？——我不确定。也许我会和家人看电影。
explanation: Maybe 表示不确定的将来打算，用 will see，故选 B。

stem: —Is Helen here? —No, she isn't. She ________ in half an hour.
stemZh: ——海伦在吗？——不在。她半小时后到。
explanation: in half an hour 表示“半小时后”，用 will arrive，故选 C。

stem: We must study harder next term. There will be ________ subjects, so we will have ________ time for each subject.
stemZh: 下学期我们必须更努力学习。将会有更多科目，所以我们每科的时间会更少。
explanation: subjects 可数用 more 修饰；time 不可数用 less 修饰，故选 C。

stem: —Do you have fun ________ English stories in class? —Yes. They're quite interesting.
stemZh: ——你们上课听英语故事觉得有趣吗？——是的。它们相当有趣。
explanation: have fun doing sth. 意为“做某事有趣”，listen to 意为“听”，用 listening to，故选 C。

stem: —Why do you learn computer programming? —________ I want to be a software engineer in the future.
stemZh: ——你为什么学计算机编程？——因为我想将来成为一名软件工程师。
explanation: Because 回答 why 的提问，表示原因，故选 A。

stem: —What ________ the world ________ like in 100 years? —Maybe there will be more robots everywhere.
stemZh: ——100年后世界会是什么样子？——也许到处都会有更多机器人。
explanation: 问句含将来时间 in 100 years，用一般将来时 will + 动词原形 be，故选 A。

stem: Mike will come back from America ________.
stemZh: 迈克将在半年后从美国回来。
explanation: in + 时间段用于一般将来时，表示“在……之后”，故选 C。

stem: I think people here are friendly. Do you agree ________ me?
stemZh: 我认为这里的人很友好。你同意我的看法吗？
explanation: agree with sb. 意为“同意某人的看法”，故选 A。

stem: —Do you think people ________ live on Mars in 50 years? —Maybe. Scientists are working hard on space travel.
stemZh: ——你认为50年后人们会住在火星上吗？——也许。科学家们正在努力研究太空旅行。
explanation: in 50 years 是将来时间，用 will 表示预测，故选 A。

stem: —________ will the future be like? —Cities will be more polluted.
stemZh: ——未来会是什么样子？——城市污染会更严重。
explanation: What...be like? 询问“……是什么样子”，故选 C。

stem: Camels are useful means of ________ in the desert.
stemZh: 骆驼是沙漠中有用的交通工具。
explanation: means of transport 意为“交通工具”，故选 A。

stem: —________ will people work in the future? —They will work fewer hours and have more free time.
stemZh: ——将来人们会工作多少小时？——他们工作时间会更少，有更多空闲时间。
explanation: How many hours 询问工作时长，答语提到 fewer hours，故选 D。

stem: —________ we make a meal for our grandparents on Double Ninth Festival? —Good idea. Let's do it right now.
stemZh: ——我们在重阳节为祖父母做顿饭好吗？——好主意。我们现在就做吧。
explanation: Shall we...? 用于提出建议，故选 D。

stem: There ________ an important meeting this afternoon. All of you should attend it.
stemZh: 今天下午有一个重要会议。你们所有人都应该参加。
explanation: there be 句型一般将来时为 there will be，故选 B。

stem: —Shall we have a picnic next Saturday? —________
stemZh: ——我们下周六去野餐好吗？——那是个好主意。
explanation: That's a good idea 表示赞同对方的建议，故选 C。

stem: —I ________ football after school in the playground. Do you want to come? —Sure. I'll be there after school.
stemZh: ——放学后我要在操场踢足球。你想来吗？——当然。我放学后去那儿。
explanation: after school 提示将来动作，用 will play，故选 D。

stem: ________ you work together, you will be able to finish the task quickly.
stemZh: 只要你们一起努力，就能很快完成任务。
explanation: As long as 意为“只要”，引导条件状语从句，故选 A。

stem: —Who do you think ________ the singing competition? —Maybe Lucy. She sings really well.
stemZh: ——你认为谁会赢得歌唱比赛？——也许是露西。她唱得真好。
explanation: 对未来比赛结果的推测，用 will win，故选 C。

stem: We are glad to hear that the Greens ________ to a new flat next week.
stemZh: 我们很高兴听说格林一家下周将搬进新公寓。
explanation: next week 提示一般将来时，用 will move，故选 C。

stem: —I ________ for you in front of the library after school. —OK. Catch you then.
stemZh: ——放学后我在图书馆前等你。——好的。到时候见。
explanation: after school 提示将来动作，用 will wait，故选 C。

stem: I need a ________ to practice English dialogues with, so I joined the club.
stemZh: 我需要一个搭档来练习英语对话，所以我加入了俱乐部。
explanation: partner 意为“搭档”，练习对话需要搭档，故选 C。

stem: —How ________ you ________ your summer vacation next year? —I'm going to visit the space museum in Beijing.
stemZh: ——明年你打算怎样度过暑假？——我打算参观北京航天博物馆。
explanation: next year 提示一般将来时，特殊疑问句用 will + 主语 + 动词原形，故选 B。

stem: —Our library has a self-service borrowing and returning ________, so we don't need to wait for librarians. —That's good news for students.
stemZh: ——我们图书馆有自助借还系统，所以我们不必等图书管理员。——这对学生来说是个好消息。
explanation: system 意为“系统”，自助借还系统符合语境，故选 B。

stem: There are ________ students in our school.
stemZh: 我们学校有数百名学生。
explanation: hundreds of 表示“成百上千的”；数词 + hundred 后不加 of 且 hundred 用单数，故选 A。

stem: —What do you think the world ________ like in 100 years? —It will be more beautiful and greener.
stemZh: ——你认为100年后世界会是什么样子？——它会更美丽、更环保。
explanation: in 100 years 提示一般将来时，用 will be，故选 C。

stem: There ________ a big sports meeting in our city next month.
stemZh: 下个月我们城市将有一场大型运动会。
explanation: next month 提示将来时，there be 句型将来时为 there will be，故选 B。

stem: Tom was able ________ himself when he was six.
stemZh: 汤姆六岁时就能自己穿衣服了。
explanation: be able to do sth. 意为“能够做某事”，用不定式 to dress up，故选 C。

stem: Technology plays an important part in improving our daily lives.
stemZh: 科技在改善我们的日常生活中起着重要作用。
explanation: 画线部分 plays an important part 与 plays an important role 同义，意为“起重要作用”，故选 A。

stem: She plans ________ art in Paris because there are many famous art museums there.
stemZh: 她计划去巴黎学艺术，因为那里有许多著名的艺术博物馆。
explanation: plan to do sth. 意为“计划做某事”，用不定式 to study，故选 C。

stem: Scientists are trying to make robots ________ humans and do the same things as we do.
stemZh: 科学家们正努力让机器人看起来像人类，并做和我们一样的事情。
explanation: look like 意为“看起来像”，机器人模仿人类的外形，故选 C。

stem: The film Ne Zha 2 has become a huge success in the film ________.
stemZh: 电影《哪吒2》在电影行业取得了巨大成功。
explanation: film industry 意为“电影行业”，符合语境，故选 B。

stem: —I don't know ________ to work out the math problem. What can I do? —You can ask your teachers for help.
stemZh: ——我不知道如何解出这道数学题。我该怎么办？——你可以向老师求助。
explanation: 疑问词 + 不定式，how to work out 意为“如何解出”，故选 D。

stem: —Did you call Jenny? —Oh no, I forgot. I ________ call her now.
stemZh: ——你给珍妮打电话了吗？——哦不，我忘了。我现在就给她打。
explanation: 忘记后临时决定现在打，用 will，故选 B。

stem: My mother is a ________. She often writes articles for newspapers.
stemZh: 我妈妈是一名记者。她经常为报纸写文章。
explanation: reporter 表示“记者”，为报纸写文章，故选 D。

stem: Schools play the most important role in ________.
stemZh: 学校在教育中起着最重要的作用。
explanation: education 意为“教育”，学校在教育中作用最大，故选 C。

stem: Our company developed a new umbrella last month.
stemZh: 我们公司上个月开发了一款新雨伞。
explanation: 画线部分 developed 意为“开发”，与 created 同义，故选 C。

stem: The thing flew very fast in the sky and soon it ________. Nobody knew what it was.
stemZh: 那个东西在天空中飞得很快，很快就消失了。没人知道它是什么。
explanation: 画线部分 disappeared 意为“消失了”，故选 B。

stem: It's ________ for me to give a speech in public. I have to prepare carefully ahead.
stemZh: 在公共场合演讲对我来说很有挑战性。我必须提前认真准备。
explanation: challenging 意为“有挑战性的”，符合语境，故选 C。

stem: You can certainly do it well if you keep on ________ the rock climbing.
stemZh: 如果你坚持练习攀岩，你一定能做好。
explanation: keep on doing sth. 意为“坚持做某事”，用动名词 practising，故选 D。

stem: —How was your trip to London, Jack? —Couldn't be ________. The bad weather made everything in a mess.
stemZh: ——杰克，你的伦敦之行怎么样？——再糟糕不过了。坏天气把一切都弄得一团糟。
explanation: Couldn't be worse 意为“再糟糕不过了”，否定词 + 比较级表最高级，故选 C。

stem: —Our school basketball team needs more players. Why not join us, Tom? —That sounds great. I ________ the training this afternoon.
stemZh: ——我们校篮球队需要更多球员。汤姆，为什么不加入我们呢？——听起来很棒。我今天下午就参加训练。
explanation: this afternoon 提示将来动作，用 will join，故选 C。

stem: —Do you think the new energy cars can ________ the oil ones? —Maybe, but I'm not sure.
stemZh: ——你认为新能源汽车能取代燃油车吗？——也许吧，但我不确定。
explanation: replace 意为“取代”，新能源车取代燃油车，符合语境，故选 C。

stem: There are ________ students in the school. But I don't know ________ the girls among them.
stemZh: 学校里有大量学生。但我不知道其中女生的数量。
options: a number of; a number of
the number of; the number of
a number of; the number of
the number of; a number of
explanation: a number of 许多（修饰复数名词）；the number of ……的数量（后接 is），故选 C。

stem: There ________ no more paper books in the future. People will read e-books.
stemZh: 将来不会再有纸质书了。人们将阅读电子书。
explanation: in the future 提示将来时，there be 句型将来时为 there will be，故选 B。

stem: This photo reminds me ________ my English teacher, Miss Green.
stemZh: 这张照片让我想起了我的英语老师格林小姐。
explanation: remind sb. of... 意为“使某人想起……”，故选 D。

stem: —________ there be less pollution in the future? —I hope so. We should protect the environment now.
stemZh: ——将来污染会更少吗？——希望如此。我们现在应该保护环境。
explanation: in the future 提示一般将来时，一般疑问句把 will 提前，故选 B。

stem: I'm sure they ________ the game next week.
stemZh: 我确信他们下周会赢得比赛。
explanation: next week 提示将来时，表示确信他们会赢，用 will win，故选 C。

stem: —Don't kick the ball like that. It will ________ your feet. —Thank you. I won't do it again.
stemZh: ——别那样踢球。那会伤害你的脚。——谢谢。我不会再那样做了。
explanation: do harm to 意为“对……有害”，符合语境，故选 B。

stem: —Who is hosting the meeting now? —Mr. Wang. He _______ the meeting when the head teacher had to leave early.
stemZh: ——现在谁在主持会议？——王先生。班主任不得不提前离开时，他接管了会议。
explanation: take over 意为“接管”，王老师接管了会议，故选 A。

stem: —Who ________ will come to the party tomorrow? —Fred.
stemZh: ——明天还有谁会来参加聚会？——弗雷德。
explanation: else 常用于疑问词 who 之后，who else 意为“还有谁”，故选 B。

stem: Tina and Mary ________ a party this weekend. They are getting ready for it.
stemZh: 蒂娜和玛丽这周末将举办一个聚会。她们正在为此做准备。
explanation: this weekend 提示将来时，用 will have，故选 A。

stem: Wait a moment, please. The party ______ after everyone arrives.
stemZh: 请稍等。聚会将在所有人都到齐后开始。
explanation: after everyone arrives 提示将来开始，用 will start，故选 B。

stem: —________ there a class meeting tomorrow? —Maybe. I saw our teacher writing his speech just now.
stemZh: ——明天有班会吗？——也许。我刚才看到老师在写演讲稿。
explanation: there be 句型一般疑问句将来时用 Will there be，故选 B。

stem: —Can I borrow your bike tomorrow? —It ________ my plan. If I don't use it, you can take it.
stemZh: ——明天我能借你的自行车吗？——这取决于我的计划。如果我不用，你可以拿走。
explanation: depend on 意为“取决于”，取决于我的计划，符合语境，故选 D。

stem: —I ________ Mount Lu with my parents. —Really? I really admire you. Have a good time!
stemZh: ——我要和父母去庐山。 ——真的吗？我真羡慕你。玩得开心！
explanation: 还没去参观，叙述将要做的事，用 will visit，故选 C。

stem: —________ will the train arrive? —In 10 minutes.
stemZh: ——火车还要多久到？——10分钟后。
explanation: How soon 询问“还要多久”，答语 In 10 minutes，故选 B。

stem: These natural ________ have warned us that everyone should start to protect the environment immediately.
stemZh: 这些自然灾害警示我们，每个人都应该立即开始保护环境。
explanation: disasters 意为“灾难”，自然灾害警示我们，故选 B。

stem: I left my mobile phone ________ in the shop but I can't find it ________.
stemZh: 我把手机落在店里的某个地方了，但现在到处都找不到。
explanation: 肯定句用 somewhere，否定句用 anywhere，故选 A。

stem: If there are ________ people driving, there will be ________ air pollution.
stemZh: 如果开车的人更少，空气污染就会更少。
explanation: people 可数用 fewer；pollution 不可数用 less，故选 C。

stem: —I'm so nervous about the math exam tomorrow. I'm not sure if I can ________ it. —Don't worry. You study hard these days.
stemZh: ——我对明天的数学考试很紧张。我不确定能否通过。——别担心。你这些天学习很努力。
explanation: pass 意为“通过（考试）”，符合语境，故选 A。

stem: The music is very ________ and it makes all the students feel ________.
stemZh: 这音乐很无聊，让所有学生都感到无聊。
optionsZh: 令人无聊的；感到无聊的
感到无聊的；令人无聊的
令人无聊的；令人无聊的
explanation: boring 修饰事物；bored 修饰人的感受，故选 B。

stem: Look! The baby is walking towards the hot water. She ________ get hurt!
stemZh: 看！婴儿正朝热水走去。她要受伤了！
explanation: 根据眼前迹象（婴儿走向热水）预测即将发生，用 is going to，故选 B。

stem: —Wuhan makes ________ services available for everyone. Hospitals won't refuse any patients. —That's great news!
stemZh: ——武汉让每个人都能享受医疗服务。医院不会拒绝任何病人。——那真是好消息！
explanation: medical services 意为“医疗服务”，符合语境，故选 B。

stem: Xu Yuanchong translated many books ________ English and French during his life.
stemZh: 许渊冲一生中把许多书翻译成了英语和法语。
explanation: translate...into... 意为“把……翻译成……”，故选 B。

stem: I think Helen can get that nice job, because she has a good ________ background.
stemZh: 我认为海伦能得到那份好工作，因为她有良好的教育背景。
explanation: education background 意为“教育背景”，故选 D。

stem: If it rains tomorrow, we ________ at home.
stemZh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。
explanation: if 条件句主将从现，主句用 will stay，故选 C。

stem: —Now I know how to do these things well by ________. —So you don't have to ________ your parents.
stemZh: ——现在我知道如何独自把这些事情做好了。——所以你就不必依赖父母了。
explanation: by myself 意为“独自”；depend on 意为“依靠”，故选 C。

stem: —What ________ your life ________ in 10 years? —I think I'll be a doctor working in a big hospital.
stemZh: ——10年后你的生活会是什么样子？——我想我会成为一名在大医院工作的医生。
explanation: in 10 years 提示一般将来时，What will...be like? 询问将是什么样，故选 A。

stem: My sister loves music, so ________ weekends she always goes to the ________.
stemZh: 我姐姐热爱音乐，所以周末她总是去听音乐会。
explanation: at/on weekends 意为“在周末”，go to the concert 意为“去听音乐会”，故选 D。

stem: —Do you have any plans for this weekend? —Yes. I ________ with my dad.
stemZh: ——你这周末有什么计划吗？——有。我要和爸爸去钓鱼。
explanation: this weekend 提示将来计划，用 will go fishing，故选 A。

stem: There ________ a basketball game between Class 1 and Class 3 tomorrow afternoon.
stemZh: 明天下午一班和三班之间有一场篮球赛。
explanation: tomorrow afternoon 提示将来时，there be 句型将来时为 there is going to be，故选 C。

stem: —Life is a journey with so many problems. —Yes, and it is _________ to solve all problems by ourselves.
stemZh: ——生活是一段充满许多问题的旅程。——是的，靠我们自己解决所有问题是不可能的。
explanation: impossible 意为“不可能的”，靠我们自己解决所有问题不可能，故选 A。

stem: What will the life ________ in 100 years?
stemZh: 100年后的生活将会是什么样子？
explanation: What will...be like? 询问将来是什么样，will 后接动词原形，故选 D。

stem: We need to save water because we can only use about 1% of the water ________ the earth.
stemZh: 我们需要节约用水，因为我们只能使用地球上大约1%的水。
explanation: on the earth 意为“在地球上”，固定搭配，故选 B。

stem: My father ________ a new car next year, because his old one is broken.
stemZh: 我爸爸明年要买一辆新车，因为他的旧车坏了。
explanation: next year 提示一般将来时，用 will buy，故选 C。

stem: Nowadays, people drive new energy cars to replace gas-powered cars.
stemZh: 如今，人们驾驶新能源汽车来取代燃油车。
explanation: 画线部分 replace 意为“取代”，与 take the place of 同义，故选 C。

stem: Mr. Smith ________ to England next week after spending 10 years teaching in Singapore.
stemZh: 史密斯先生在新加坡教了10年书后，下周将返回英国。
explanation: next week 提示一般将来时，用 will return，故选 D。

stem: —What will schools ________ like in the future? —Students may study at home with online teachers.
stemZh: ——未来的学校会是什么样子？——学生可能在家跟着网上老师学习。
explanation: What will ... be like? 询问将来是什么样子，will 后接动词原形 be，故选 A。

stem: If you study hard, you ________ good grades.
stemZh: 如果你努力学习，你会取得好成绩。
explanation: if 条件句主将从现，主句用一般将来时 will get，故选 C。

stem: The man gave up smoking because of lung ________.
stemZh: 那个男人因为肺癌戒了烟。
explanation: lung cancer 意为“肺癌”，符合语境，故选 D。

stem: —Sam, do you know ________ woman in a black coat? —Yes, she is ________ expert from Beijing Hospital.
stemZh: ——萨姆，你认识那个穿黑外套的女人吗？——认识，她是北京医院的一位专家。
explanation: 第一空特指穿黑外套的女人用 the；第二空泛指一位专家，expert 以元音音素开头用 an，故选 C。

stem: —Do you ________ like reading the books on cooking, Mrs. White? —No, and my husband doesn't like them ________.
stemZh: ——怀特夫人，你也喜欢读烹饪方面的书吗？——不，我丈夫也不喜欢。
explanation: also 用于句中；either 用于否定句句末，故选 B。

stem: Since science and technology are developing fast, scientists and doctors will certainly find a way to ________ cancer some day.
stemZh: 由于科技发展迅速，科学家和医生总有一天会找到治愈癌症的方法。
explanation: cure 意为“治愈”，找到治愈癌症的方法，故选 A。

stem: John went to Japan yesterday. And he will come back ________ two days.
stemZh: 约翰昨天去了日本。他两天后回来。
explanation: in + 时间段表示“在……之后”，用于一般将来时，故选 A。

stem: What is the meaning of positive?
stemZh: positive（积极的）的意思是什么？
options: looks for the good in all situations
looks for the bad in all situations
gives up easily when facing difficulties
optionsZh: 在任何情况下都看到好的一面
在任何情况下都看到坏的一面
explanation: positive 意为“积极的”，指凡事往好处看，故选 A。

stem: I believe that everyone ________ a happy life in the future.
stemZh: 我相信将来每个人都会过上幸福的生活。
explanation: in the future 提示一般将来时，用 will have，故选 A。

stem: —Oh, no! Your brother left his umbrella at home. There ________ a heavy rain this afternoon. —Don't worry, Mum. I'll bring it to him.
stemZh: ——哦，不！你哥哥把伞忘在家里了。今天下午会有大雨。——别担心，妈妈。我会给他送去。
explanation: this afternoon 提示对未来的预测，用 will be，故选 D。

stem: Your suggestion will have an important influence ________ my decision.
stemZh: 你的建议将对我的决定产生重要影响。
explanation: have an influence on... 意为“对……有影响”，故选 C。

stem: The students ________ about vegetables tomorrow.
stemZh: 学生们明天将学习关于蔬菜的知识。
explanation: tomorrow 提示一般将来时，用 will learn，故选 D。

stem: It's ________ for Tony to finish such hard math problems in 10 minutes. Because he isn't good at math.
stemZh: 托尼在10分钟内完成这么难的数学题是不可能的。因为他不擅长数学。
explanation: impossible 意为“不可能的”，与不擅长数学相符，故选 A。

stem: The ________ of the movie is so interesting that many people like it.
stemZh: 这部电影的故事如此有趣，以至于许多人都喜欢它。
explanation: story 表示“故事”，电影的故事有趣，故选 B。

stem: Where ________ you go travelling in the coming summer holiday?
stemZh: 在即将到来的暑假里，你打算去哪里旅行？
explanation: in the coming summer holiday 提示将来时，用 will，故选 C。

stem: —What is your plan for the coming holiday? —I ________ homeless people to get a good place to live in.
stemZh: ——你对即将到来的假期有什么计划？——我将帮助无家可归的人找到好住处。
explanation: the coming holiday 提示将来，用 will help，故选 C。

stem: —________ will you return home? —In a week.
stemZh: ——你多久后回家？——一周后。
explanation: How soon 询问“还要多久”，答语 In a week，故选 C。

stem: —It's very useful for students to join in ________. —Yes, they can learn how to help people in need.
stemZh: ——对学生来说参加社区服务很有用。——是的，他们能学会如何帮助有需要的人。
explanation: community services 意为“社区服务”，帮助有需要的人，符合语境，故选 D。

stem: Mr.Brown is busy now. He ________ you after work this afternoon, OK?
stemZh: 布朗先生现在很忙。他今天下午下班后给你打电话，好吗？
explanation: this afternoon 提示将来动作，用 will meet，故选 D。

stem: The scientist believes there will be ________ cars and ________ pollution.
stemZh: 这位科学家相信汽车会更少，污染也会更少。
explanation: cars 可数用 fewer；pollution 不可数用 less，故选 B。

stem: —Do you think people will live to be 200 years old? —________ It's hard to say, but maybe with the development of medicine.
stemZh: ——你认为人们会活到200岁吗？——我不知道。很难说，但也许随着医学的发展可以。
explanation: It's hard to say 表示不确定，用 I don't know，故选 C。

stem: We hope there ________ war in the world. Everyone can live a happy life.
stemZh: 我们希望世界上不会再有战争。每个人都能过上幸福的生活。
explanation: there be 句型将来时否定形式为 there will not be，故选 D。

stem: We ________ a vacation in three days. How happy we are!
stemZh: 三天后我们将放假。我们多高兴啊！
explanation: in three days 表示“三天后”，用一般将来时 will take，故选 C。

stem: —I think there will be more wild animals living in forests in the future if we keep protecting the environment. —________. We need to take action from now on.
stemZh: ——我认为如果我们继续保护环境，将来会有更多野生动物生活在森林里。——希望如此。我们需要从现在开始采取行动。
explanation: I hope so 表示希望如此，认同对方观点，故选 B。

stem: The robots can do some jobs as ________ as people.
stemZh: 机器人能像人一样出色地完成一些工作。
explanation: as...as 中间用原级，修饰动词 do 用副词 well，故选 B。

stem: The ________ of the robot is so amazing that it can clean the house without any instructions.
stemZh: 这项机器人技术如此惊人，它能在没有任何指令的情况下打扫房子。
explanation: technology 表示“技术”，机器人技术令人惊叹，故选 C。

stem: We ________ have a robot in every home in 50 years.
stemZh: 50年后每个家庭都会有一个机器人。
explanation: in 50 years 提示一般将来时，表示预测用 will，故选 B。

stem: —Hey, Lisa! You look unhappy. ________? —I failed the math exam again.
stemZh: ——嘿，丽莎！你看起来不开心。怎么了？——我数学考试又没及格。
explanation: What's up 意为“怎么了”，询问对方不开心的原因，故选 A。

stem: —Human beings should not eat or kill wild animals anymore! —________
stemZh: ——人类不应该再吃或杀害野生动物了！——我再同意不过了。
explanation: I can't agree more 意为“我再同意不过了”，表示完全赞同，故选 C。

stem: Life in the future ________ different from life today because of technological development.
stemZh: 由于科技的发展，未来的生活将与今天不同。
explanation: in the future 提示一般将来时，用 will be，故选 C。

stem: —What would you like to drink? —I ________ have a cup of coffee, please.
stemZh: ——你想喝点什么？——请给我来一杯咖啡。
explanation: 点餐是临时决定，用 will have，故选 C。

stem: We should use less water ________ we can save more for future.
stemZh: 我们应该少用水，以便为将来节约更多。
explanation: so that 引导目的状语从句，意为“以便”，故选 A。

stem: —What's your ________ about the future, Mike? —I think people won't go to work in the factories in thirty years.
stemZh: ——迈克，你对未来有什么预测？——我认为三十年后人们不会去工厂上班了。
explanation: prediction 意为“预测”，对未来的预测，故选 B。

stem: It ________ rain this evening. The sky is getting dark and cloudy.
stemZh: 今晚可能会下雨。天空变得又黑又阴。
explanation: may 表示“可能”，根据乌云密布的迹象推测可能下雨，故选 A。

stem: Will Jill play a part in ________ the plan for English study?
stemZh: 吉尔会在制定英语学习计划中发挥作用吗？
explanation: play a part in doing sth. 意为“在……中发挥作用”，用动名词 making，故选 D。

stem: We __________ a picnic tomorrow.
stemZh: 我们明天要去野餐。
explanation: tomorrow 提示一般将来时，用 will have，故选 C。

stem: Friends are like books. You don't need a lot of ________ them as long as they are good.
stemZh: 朋友就像书。只要它们好，你不需要很多。
explanation: as long as 意为“只要”，引导条件状语从句，故选 C。

stem: China has the world's ________ population of university graduates, so providing them with jobs is really a ________ for the government.
stemZh: 中国拥有世界上最多的大学毕业生人口，所以为他们提供工作对政府来说确实是一个挑战。
explanation: largest population 人口最多；challenge 挑战，故选 C。

stem: She ________ a gift yesterday but she didn't ________ it.
stemZh: 她昨天收到了一份礼物，但她没有接受。
explanation: receive 客观收到，accept 主观接受；didn't 后接动词原形，故选 D。

stem: After years of hard work, he became a(n) ________ in this field.
stemZh: 经过多年的努力，他成为了这个领域的专家。
explanation: expert 意为“专家”，符合语境，故选 A。

stem: —How amazing the picture is! I like the cat in it. —I agree. Lisa is ________ at drawing animals—her pictures always look very real.
stemZh: ——这幅画真棒！我喜欢里面的猫。——我同意。丽莎擅长画动物——她的画总是看起来非常逼真。
explanation: be expert at 意为“擅长……”，丽莎擅长画动物，故选 B。

stem: There ________ more green trees in our city next year because we are planting more now.
stemZh: 明年我们城市将有更多绿树，因为我们现在种得更多了。
explanation: next year 提示将来时，there be 句型的将来时为 there will be / there is going to be，故选 B。

stem: ________ your brother come back from London soon?
stemZh: 你哥哥很快会从伦敦回来吗？
explanation: soon 提示将来时，一般疑问句用 Will 开头，故选 B。

stem: I don't like this small bag. Could you give me a ________ one?
stemZh: 我不喜欢这个小包。你能给我一个更大一点的吗？
explanation: 与 small 相对，用比较级 bigger 表示“更大一点的”，故选 B。

stem: —Will there be more trees in the future? —________ Because people will plant more.
stemZh: ——将来会有更多树吗？——会有。因为人们会种更多。
explanation: 根据后文人们会种更多树，作肯定回答 Yes, there will，故选 A。

stem: —Did you create the poster for the English Festival? —Yes, it is on the board now.
stemZh: ——你制作了英语节的海报吗？——是的，现在它在展板上。
explanation: 画线部分 create 意为“创造、制作”，与 make 同义，故选 B。

stem: —It's dangerous to drive after drinking. —That's true. It can increase the risk of ________ accidents.
stemZh: ——酒后驾车很危险。——确实。它会增加交通事故的风险。
explanation: traffic accidents 意为“交通事故”，符合语境，故选 C。

stem: If Open AI technology is used properly, the world ________ better and better.
stemZh: 如果人工智能技术被正确使用，世界将变得越来越好。
explanation: if 条件句主将从现，主句用一般将来时 will become，故选 D。

stem: In the future, robots ________ the problem of taking care of the old people.
stemZh: 将来，机器人将解决照顾老人的问题。
explanation: In the future 提示一般将来时，用 will solve，故选 B。

stem: —Where is Alice? The film will begin soon. —Don't worry. I ________ her to find out what's wrong.
stemZh: ——爱丽丝在哪里？电影快开始了。——别担心。我会打电话给她，看看出了什么事。
explanation: 打电话行为还未发生，用 will call，故选 D。

stem: He promises he ________ computer games again.
stemZh: 他保证他不会再玩电脑游戏了。
explanation: 表示承诺“不再玩”，用否定形式 won't play，故选 A。

stem: —Will there be fewer paper books? —________ More books will be on computers.
stemZh: ——纸质书会更少吗？——是的，会更少。更多书将在电脑上。
explanation: 更多书在电脑上，说明纸质书更少，作肯定回答 Yes, there will，故选 B。

stem: The TV news reports that there ________ a storm the day after tomorrow.
stemZh: 电视新闻报道后天将有一场暴风雨。
explanation: the day after tomorrow 提示将来时，there be 将来时为 there is going to be，故选 B。

stem: I've made my decision. I ________ study abroad next year.
stemZh: 我已经做出决定了。我打算明年出国留学。
explanation: 已做好决定、事先计划好，用 be going to，故选 B。

stem: If you ________ hard, you will get good grades.
stemZh: 如果你努力学习，你会取得好成绩。
explanation: if 条件句主将从现，从句用一般现在时 study，故选 A。

stem: ________ you don't give up, your dreams will come true.
stemZh: 只要你不放弃，你的梦想就会实现。
explanation: As long as 意为“只要”，引导条件状语从句，故选 A。

stem: —The superstar hopes to keep his personal life away from the ________. —I can understand him.
stemZh: ——这位巨星希望让自己的私生活远离公众。——我能理解他。
explanation: the public 意为“公众”，远离公众，符合语境，故选 A。

stem: Study hard or you will fail in the maths exam.
stemZh: 努力学习，否则你数学考试会不及格。
explanation: 画线部分 fail 意为“不及格”，与 not pass 同义，故选 C。

stem: A lot of foreign people ________ to Mingsha Mountain next week.
stemZh: 许多外国人下周将去鸣沙山旅游。
explanation: next week 提示一般将来时，用 will travel，故选 C。

stem: —What do you _______ that store? —I think it has the best _______ clothes.
stemZh: ——你觉得那家商店怎么样？——我认为它有质量最好的衣服。
explanation: What do you think of...? 意为“你认为……怎么样”；quality 意为“质量”，故选 A。

stem: My cousin ________ a spaceship to the moon when she grows up. She's interested in space.
stemZh: 我表妹长大后要乘宇宙飞船去月球。她对太空很感兴趣。
explanation: when she grows up 表将来，用一般将来时 will fly，故选 A。

stem: —Sam, would you like to go to Zhou Shen's concert with me this Sunday? —Sorry, I ________ to visit my uncle with my parents that day.
stemZh: ——萨姆，这周日你想和我一起去周深的演唱会吗？——抱歉，那天我要和父母去看望叔叔。
explanation: that day 指周日（将来），用 will go，故选 C。

stem: The environment ________ better if everyone plays a part in protecting it.
stemZh: 如果每个人都参与保护环境，环境会变得更好。
explanation: if 条件句主将从现，主句用一般将来时 will become，故选 A。

stem: —________ will you be a teacher? —In five years.
stemZh: ——你多久后能成为一名老师？——五年后。
explanation: How soon 询问“还要多久”，答语 In five years，故选 B。

stem: There will be ________ jobs for people because some robots will do the same jobs as people.
stemZh: 人们的就业机会会更少，因为一些机器人将做人同样的工作。
explanation: 机器人和人做同样的工作，所以人的工作机会更少，用 fewer，故选 C。

stem: —What will you do next Sunday? —We ________ a picnic in the park.
stemZh: ——你下周日要做什么？——我们要在公园野餐。
explanation: 问句含 will 和 next Sunday，回答用一般将来时 will have，故选 C。

stem: It's ________ to live on another planet now, but maybe it will be possible in 50 years.
stemZh: 现在移居另一个星球是不可能的，但也许50年后会变得可能。
explanation: impossible 意为“不可能的”，现在移居其他星球不可能，故选 B。

stem: —I think it's very important for parents to ________ a sense of duty in their children. —I can't agree more.
stemZh: ——我认为父母培养孩子的责任感非常重要。——我完全同意。
explanation: develop a sense of duty 意为“培养责任感”，故选 B。

stem: —Do you think people will live on the moon one day? —________. It's too far from the earth.
stemZh: ——你认为有一天人们会住在月球上吗？——我不同意。它离地球太远了。
explanation: 月球离地球太远，对方不同意这种观点，用 I don't agree，故选 C。

stem: If you keep practicing, you will ________ your skills over time.
stemZh: 如果你坚持练习，随着时间的推移你的技能会得到提升。
explanation: develop 意为“发展、提升”，坚持练习提升技能，故选 A。

stem: —May I live together with my best friend, Mum? —You should live ________ your own because you are old enough.
stemZh: ——妈妈，我可以和我最好的朋友住在一起吗？——你应该独立生活，因为你已经长大了。
explanation: on one's own 意为“独立地、独自”，是固定短语，故选 A。

stem: My father told me to eat ________ vegetables and ________ meat because it's good for health.
stemZh: 我爸爸让我多吃蔬菜少吃肉，因为这有益健康。
explanation: vegetables 可数用 more；meat 不可数用 less，故选 B。

stem: —My bag is so heavy. —I ________ carry it for you.
stemZh: ——我的包太重了。——我帮你拿吧。
explanation: 临时决定帮忙拿包，用 will，故选 A。

stem: We should play a part in ________ the earth a better place to live.
stemZh: 我们应该为把地球变得更宜居发挥作用。
explanation: play a part in doing sth. 意为“在……中起作用”，介词 in 后接动名词 making，故选 B。

stem: —I like reading this novel by Charlotte. The stories are so ________! —Me too. I think her experience as a teacher had a direct ________ on her work.
stemZh: ——我喜欢读夏洛特的这部小说。这些故事太感人了！——我也是。我认为她当老师的经历对她的作品有直接影响。
explanation: touching 意为“感人的”；have an influence on 意为“对……有影响”，故选 D。

stem: —Let's predict the future of technology! —________ It's so interesting to imagine it.
stemZh: ——让我们预测一下技术的未来吧！——好极了！想象它太有趣了。
explanation: Great! 表示赞同，回应对方提出的有趣提议，故选 B。

stem: She dreams of ________ a scientist to study the universe when she graduates.
stemZh: 她梦想毕业后成为一名研究宇宙的科学家。
explanation: dream of doing sth. 意为“梦想做某事”，介词 of 后接动名词 being，故选 C。

stem: To live a green life, we should try to save ________ energy and produce ________ pollution.
stemZh: 为了过绿色生活，我们应该努力节约更多能源，产生更少污染。
explanation: save more energy 节约更多能源，produce less pollution 产生更少污染，故选 A。

stem: —Can you tell me something ________ your school life in the USA? —Sure. It's quite different from that in China.
stemZh: ——你能告诉我一些关于你在美国学校生活的事情吗？——当然。它和中国的大不相同。
explanation: something about... 意为“关于……的一些事情”，故选 B。

stem: Xinyue not only has high ________, but also studies hard. She always does well in the exams.
stemZh: 新月不仅智商高，而且学习努力。她考试总是考得很好。
explanation: intelligence 意为“智力”，智商高且学习努力，故选 A。

stem: My father always does some ________ on how to cook delicious food.
stemZh: 我爸爸总是做些关于如何做好吃的研究。
explanation: do some research 意为“做些研究”，research 不可数，故选 A。

stem: The students in our school ________ some vegetables in the field next year.
stemZh: 我们学校的学生明年将在田里种些蔬菜。
explanation: next year 提示一般将来时，用 will grow，故选 A。

stem: Mr. Green ________ in a small house 10 years ago. He ________ in a big apartment in a tall building in 10 years.
stemZh: 格林先生10年前住在一间小房子里。10年后他将住在一栋高楼的大公寓里。
explanation: 10 years ago 用一般过去时；in 10 years 用一般将来时，故选 D。

stem: Would you like me to ________ the driving for a while?
stemZh: 你想让我开一会儿车吗？
explanation: take over 意为“接管、接替”，接替开车，符合语境，故选 B。

stem: All life on earth depends ________ the sun.
stemZh: 地球上所有的生命都依赖太阳。
explanation: depend on 意为“依赖”，是固定搭配，故选 B。

stem: She spends a lot of time ________ about her future career.
stemZh: 她花很多时间思考她未来的职业。
explanation: spend time (in) doing sth. 意为“花费时间做某事”，用动名词 thinking，故选 C。

stem: We ________ use paper money in the future. Most people will pay with digital wallets.
stemZh: 将来我们不会使用纸币。大多数人将用电子钱包支付。
explanation: in the future 提示将来时，根据后文大多数人用电子钱包可知不会用纸币，用 won't，故选 A。

stem: There are special machines that will carve ice to artists' designs. Because of this new ________, ice sculptors can create designs with more detail.
stemZh: 有些特殊机器能按照艺术家的设计雕刻冰。由于这项新技术，冰雕师能创作出细节更丰富的设计。
explanation: technology 意为“技术”，新技术让冰雕更精细，故选 D。

stem: —Will there be fewer trees? —No, ________.
stemZh: ——树会更少吗？——不，不会。
explanation: there be 句型一般疑问句的否定回答用 No, there won't，故选 A。

stem: —________ do you visit your grandparents, Timmy? —Once a week.
stemZh: ——蒂米，你多久看望一次你的祖父母？——一周一次。
explanation: How often 询问频率，答语 Once a week，故选 D。

stem: —Sally, I heard you're going to America. ________ will you stay there? —For two whole years.
stemZh: ——萨莉，我听说你要去美国。你会在那里待多久？——整整两年。
explanation: How long 询问多长时间，答语 For two whole years，故选 C。

stem: —What a(n) _______ girl! She often leaves things somewhere. —I think it's _______ for her to make a change right now.
stemZh: ——多么粗心的女孩啊！她经常把东西落在某处。——我认为她现在做出改变是不可能的。
optionsZh: 粗心的；不可能的（错误拼写）
explanation: careless 意为“粗心的”；impossible 意为“不可能的”，故选 C。

stem: How long will cats live ________?
stemZh: 猫能活到多少岁？
explanation: live to be 意为“活到……岁”，用不定式 to be，故选 B。

stem: I ________ a movie with my friends tomorrow evening.
stemZh: 明天晚上我要和朋友去看电影。
explanation: tomorrow evening 提示一般将来时，用 will watch，故选 D。

stem: He did not mention the quarrel with his wife.
stemZh: 他没有提到和妻子的争吵。
explanation: 画线部分 mention 意为“提及”，与 talk about 同义，故选 C。

stem: Next Monday is my mother's birthday. I ________ her a big present on that day.
stemZh: 下周一是妈妈的生日。那天我要送她一份大礼物。
explanation: Next Monday 提示将来时，用 will give，故选 B。

stem: —Shall we make a cake for Tina as a birthday gift? —________ It will give her a big surprise.
stemZh: ——我们为蒂娜做一个蛋糕作为生日礼物好吗？——好主意。这会给她一个大惊喜。
explanation: Good idea 表示赞同建议，故选 A。

stem: I ________ a picnic with my brother next Saturday.
stemZh: 下周六我要和哥哥去野餐。
explanation: next Saturday 提示一般将来时，用 will have，故选 C。

stem: "Bad traffic" is perhaps ________ excuse, for everyone knows it's only a five-minute walk.
stemZh: “交通拥堵”也许是最糟糕的借口，因为大家都知道那只是五分钟的步行路程。
explanation: the worst excuse 意为“最糟糕的借口”，符合语境，故选 D。

stem: —There is a worried expression on Amy's face. What's wrong with her? —She lost her ________ this morning and she is afraid to tell her parents.
stemZh: ——艾米脸上有担忧的表情。她怎么了？——她今天早上丢了钱包，不敢告诉父母。
explanation: wallet 意为“钱包”，丢了钱包不敢告诉父母，故选 D。

stem: If you want to build good relationships with your classmates, you should ________ them and share your feelings with them.
stemZh: 如果你想和同学建立良好的关系，你应该信任他们，并与他们分享你的感受。
explanation: trust 表示“信任”，建立良好关系需要信任同学，故选 C。

stem: When the teacher came in, all the students ____ talking.
stemZh: 老师进来时，所有学生都停止了讲话。
explanation: 从句 came 是一般过去时，主句也用过去式 stopped，故选 B。

stem: They ________ to visit the museum last week.
stemZh: 他们上周去参观了博物馆。
explanation: last week 提示用一般过去时 went，故选 B。

stem: —What's wrong with you? —I'm feeling ____. I think I have a cold.
stemZh: ——你怎么了？——我感觉不舒服。我想我感冒了。
explanation: 感冒了所以感觉不舒服，用 sick，故选 A。

stem: He is ____ his math book, but he can't ____ it.
stemZh: 他正在找他的数学书，但找不到。
explanation: look for 强调“寻找”的过程，find 强调“找到”的结果，故选 A。

stem: There is ____ wrong with my watch. It doesn't work.
stemZh: 我的手表出了毛病。它不走了。
explanation: something wrong 意为“出了毛病”，是固定用法，故选 A。

stem: —Here is today's newspaper! I just read it. —Thanks, is there ________ in it?
stemZh: ——这是今天的报纸！我刚读过。——谢谢，上面有什么新内容吗？
explanation: 疑问句中用 anything；形容词 new 后置，故选 C。

stem: —Tom, you played the piano very well at the concert. Who taught you? —________. I taught myself.
stemZh: ——汤姆，你在音乐会上钢琴弹得真好。谁教你的？——没有人。我自学的。
explanation: 根据“I taught myself”可知没有人教他，用 Nobody，故选 C。

stem: I didn't see ____ in the gymnasium except a boy who plays basketball by himself.
stemZh: 除了一个独自打篮球的男孩，我在体育馆里没看到任何人。
explanation: 否定句用 anybody，除了那个男孩没看到任何人，故选 D。

stem: —Where did you go last winter vacation? —I ____ to London with my family.
stemZh: ——你去年寒假去哪里了？——我和家人去了伦敦。
explanation: 问句是一般过去时，答语用 go 的过去式 went，故选 C。

stem: —Did you do ____ interesting on your holiday? —No, I just stayed at home and helped with some housework.
stemZh: ——你假期做了什么有趣的事吗？——没有，我只是待在家里帮忙做家务。
explanation: 疑问句中用 anything；something 用于肯定句，故选 B。

stem: —The students worked hard for months and finally won the ________ in the science competition. —Wow! Their efforts paid off!
stemZh: ——学生们努力了几个月，终于在科学竞赛中赢得了胜利。——哇！他们的努力得到了回报！
explanation: victory 表示“胜利”，根据 won 和 science competition 可知，故选 A。

stem: —I'll have a tennis game tomorrow. I'm a little bit nervous. —Believe in ________. You're the best in our club.
stemZh: ——我明天有网球赛。我有点紧张。——相信你自己。你是我们俱乐部最棒的。
explanation: 主语是 you，用反身代词 yourself，believe in oneself 表示“相信自己”，故选 C。

stem: Is there ____ in today's newspaper, Linda?
stemZh: 琳达，今天的报纸上有什么令人兴奋的内容吗？
optionsZh: 令人兴奋的内容（错误语序）
explanation: 疑问句用 anything，修饰事物用 -ing 形式形容词且后置，故选 A。

stem: —Is there ________ in today's newspaper? —The 19th Asian Games are held in Hangzhou, China from September 23 to October 8.
stemZh: ——今天的报纸上有什么重要内容吗？——第19届亚运会于9月23日至10月8日在中国杭州举行。
explanation: 疑问句中用 anything；形容词 important 后置，故选 C。

stem: —Wow! This maths problem is so easy. —Yeah, but I don't think ____ can work it out correctly.
stemZh: ——哇！这道数学题太简单了。——是啊，但我认为不是每个人都能正确解出来。
explanation: not 与 everyone 构成部分否定，意为“不是每个人都能算对”，故选 A。

stem: —Do you have ____ to eat? —Sorry, I don't have ____ food in my bag.
stemZh: ——你有吃的东西吗？——抱歉，我包里没有食物。
explanation: 疑问句用 anything；否定句修饰不可数名词 food 用 any，故选 A。

stem: —Teng Fei, you made a mistake. I think you should say sorry to Mom. —________. I'll talk to her when she gets home.
stemZh: ——腾飞，你犯了个错误。我认为你应该向妈妈道歉。——我想你是对的。她回家后我会和她谈。
explanation: I guess you're right 表示“我想你是对的”，接受对方的建议，故选 B。

stem: ____ my stay in Paris, I visited many famous museums.
stemZh: 在巴黎逗留期间，我参观了许多著名博物馆。
explanation: during 意为“在……期间”，符合语境，故选 A。

stem: —How was the scenery of Mount Yulong? —It just ____ my breath away.
stemZh: ——玉龙雪山的风景怎么样？——它简直让我惊叹不已。
explanation: take one's breath away 意为“令人惊叹”，故选 C。

stem: It's important to ____ your worries and relax yourself during the holiday.
stemZh: 假期里放下担忧、放松自己很重要。
explanation: forget one's worries 意为“放下担忧”，度假时放下烦恼放松自己，故选 A。

stem: Every dish tasted ____. I liked the fish very much.
stemZh: 每道菜尝起来都很好。我非常喜欢那道鱼。
explanation: taste 是系动词，后接形容词 good，故选 A。

stem: None of the news ____ good.
stemZh: 没有一条消息是好的。
explanation: news 是不可数名词，none of + 不可数名词用单数，语境为过去用 was，故选 C。

stem: They have just returned from ____ places with wonderful stories to tell.
stemZh: 他们刚从遥远的地方回来，有许多精彩的故事要讲。
explanation: faraway 是形容词“遥远的”，修饰 places，故选 A。

stem: —Peter, did you play table tennis with your friends after school yesterday? —No, I didn't. We ________ vegetables in our school garden.
stemZh: ——彼得，你昨天放学后和朋友打乒乓球了吗？——没有。我们在学校花园里给蔬菜浇水。
explanation: 根据 did you play 和 No, I didn't 可知回答用一般过去时 watered，故选 C。

stem: Although everything was expensive in Hong Kong, I still bought ________ for my daughter.
stemZh: 虽然香港的东西都很贵，我还是给女儿买了一些特别的东西。
explanation: 肯定句中用 something；形容词 special 后置，故选 B。

stem: You can drive my car as long as you promise to drive ________.
stemZh: 只要你答应小心驾驶，就可以开我的车。
explanation: carefully 表示“小心地”，开车要小心，故选 B。

stem: —I'm going to take a driving test next week. I'm a bit nervous. —Don't worry. Just make sure you ________ the traffic rules during the test.
stemZh: ——我下周要参加驾照考试。我有点紧张。——别担心。只要确保考试时注意交通规则。
explanation: pay attention to 表示“注意”，考试时要注意交通规则，故选 A。

stem: Chinese tea is ____. Many foreigners love it a lot.
stemZh: 中国茶非常棒。许多外国人都非常喜欢它。
explanation: fantastic 意为“极好的”，外国人都喜欢，故选 A。

stem: —Listen! ________ is singing in the hall. —I think it is Helen.
stemZh: ——听！有人在大厅里唱歌。——我想是海伦。
explanation: someone 表示“某人”，用于肯定句，故选 A。

stem: —Did you ________ last week? —Yes. I went to Beijing with my family.
stemZh: ——你上周去什么地方了吗？——是的。我和家人去了北京。
explanation: Did 后接动词原形 go；疑问句中用 anywhere，故选 B。

stem: He is so honest a man that we all ________ him.
stemZh: 他是如此诚实的人，以至于我们都信任他。
explanation: trust 表示“信任”，根据 so honest a man 可知，故选 B。

stem: —I can't find my English book. What should I do? —Don't worry. I will help you ________ it.
stemZh: ——我找不到我的英语书了。我该怎么办？——别担心。我会帮你找它。
explanation: look for 表示“寻找”，根据 I can't find my English book 可知，故选 A。

stem: We ________ a great time at the party last night.
stemZh: 昨晚我们在聚会上玩得很开心。
explanation: last night 提示用一般过去时 had，故选 B。

stem: —Listen! ____ is knocking at the door. —Oh, it's just a playful cat.
stemZh: ——听！有人在敲门。——哦，只是一只调皮的猫。
explanation: 肯定句表示“有人在敲门”，用 Somebody，故选 A。

stem: I felt ____ when I first took a plane, but soon I enjoyed the trip.
stemZh: 第一次坐飞机时我感到紧张，但很快就享受这次旅行了。
explanation: 第一次坐飞机感到紧张，与后文“很快享受旅行”转折呼应，用 nervous，故选 B。

stem: —Did you enjoy ________ at the party? —Yes, we did.
stemZh: ——你们在聚会上玩得开心吗？——是的，很开心。
explanation: 主语是 we，用反身代词 yourselves，enjoy oneself 表示“玩得开心”，故选 B。

stem: The sisters often have a ________ over who gets to use the computer first.
stemZh: 姐妹俩经常因为谁先用电脑而争吵。
explanation: have a fight over 表示“因为……争吵”，故选 A。

stem: —This time Tom finished his homework himself. ____ helped him. —That's good.
stemZh: ——这次汤姆自己完成了作业。没有人帮他。——那很好。
explanation: Tom 自己完成作业，说明没有人帮他，用 No one，故选 C。

stem: To make a green city, ____ should play a part in saving the energy.
stemZh: 为了建设绿色城市，每个人都应该为节约能源发挥作用。
explanation: 每个人都应为节约能源出力，用 everyone，故选 B。

stem: —Jane, you look unhappy. Is ________ all right? —Yes. I'm just bored and I've got ________ interesting to do.
stemZh: ——简，你看起来不开心。一切都好吗？——是的。我只是无聊，没什么有趣的事可做。
explanation: 第一空 Is everything all right? 是固定表达；第二空根据 bored 可知没什么有趣的事做，故选 C。

stem: —Did you decide on the ________ of your school trip? —Not yet. But most students think it should be after the exam.
stemZh: ——你们决定学校旅行的日期了吗？——还没有。但大多数学生认为应该在考试后。
explanation: date 表示“日期”，根据 after the exam 可知讨论的是日期，故选 A。

stem: He ____ a cold last week, so the doctor asked him to stay at home.
stemZh: 他上周感冒了，所以医生让他待在家里。
explanation: last week 是过去时间，catch 的过去式为 caught，故选 C。

stem: Tom ________ the piano every day when he was in primary school.
stemZh: 汤姆上小学时每天弹钢琴。
explanation: when he was in primary school 提示用一般过去时 played，故选 B。

stem: —Tony, you are back from London. What are English schools like? —Here are a few photos. I ____ them by myself.
stemZh: ——托尼，你从伦敦回来了。英国学校怎么样？——这里有几张照片。我自己拍的。
explanation: 照片已经拍好，用一般过去时 took，故选 C。

stem: The two sides decided to ________ their differences on the football field.
stemZh: 双方决定在足球场上解决他们的分歧。
explanation: fight out 表示“通过斗争解决”，双方决定在足球场上解决分歧，故选 D。

stem: —How was your vacation? —Pretty good! I ________ the Great Wall with my friends.
stemZh: ——你的假期怎么样？——相当好！我和朋友们爬了长城。
explanation: 根据 How was your vacation 可知回答用一般过去时 climbed，故选 C。

stem: The cat is lying ____ the sun, looking very lazy.
stemZh: 猫躺在阳光下，看起来很懒。
explanation: in the sun 意为“在阳光下”，故选 C。

stem: Many hotels in China ________ free toothbrushes to every guest.
stemZh: 中国的许多酒店向每位客人提供免费牙刷。
explanation: offer sth. to sb. 表示“向某人提供某物”，符合语境，故选 offer。

stem: —How did you move all these things to your new house quickly? —Some of my neighbors ________ to help me last weekend.
stemZh: ——你是怎么这么快把所有东西搬到新家的？——上周末我的一些邻居主动提出帮我。
explanation: offer to do sth. 表示“主动提出做某事”，符合语境，故选 offered。

stem: She ________ her homework at home yesterday.
stemZh: 她昨天把作业忘在家里了。
explanation: yesterday 提示用一般过去时，否定句用 didn't + 动词原形，故选 B。

stem: —What did you do last weekend? —I ____ a film.
stemZh: ——你上周末做了什么？——我看了一部电影。
explanation: last weekend 是过去时间，用 see 的过去式 saw，故选 B。

stem: Mother ________ me a nice present on my birthday last year.
stemZh: 去年我生日时妈妈送了我一件漂亮的礼物。
explanation: last year 提示用一般过去时 gave，故选 B。

stem: Paper-cutting is my favorite. ____ is more interesting than it.
stemZh: 剪纸是我的最爱。没有什么比它更有趣。
explanation: 剪纸是最爱，没有什么比它更有趣，用 Nothing，故选 C。

stem: I want to find ____ for my parents as holiday gifts.
stemZh: 我想给父母找些好东西作为节日礼物。
explanation: 肯定句用 something，形容词修饰不定代词要后置，故选 A。

stem: It's ________ to talk loudly in the library.
stemZh: 在图书馆大声说话是不礼貌的。
explanation: impolite 表示“不礼貌的”，在图书馆大声说话是不礼貌的，故选 D。

stem: —Tom bought me a big birthday cake. It was a big ____ for me. —Yeah, we were all ____ at it at the party.
stemZh: ——汤姆给我买了一个大生日蛋糕。这对我来说是个大惊喜。——是啊，在聚会上我们都对此感到惊讶。
optionsZh: 令人惊讶的；感到惊讶的
感到惊讶的；令人惊讶的
explanation: a big surprise 名词“惊喜”；人对……感到惊讶用 surprised，故选 A。

stem: Everyone in our class ____ a good time on the school trip.
stemZh: 我们班每个人在学校旅行中都玩得很开心。
explanation: have a good time 是固定搭配，事情发生在过去，用 had，故选 C。

stem: —Why did you miss the meeting? —I'm so ________ these days. I just forgot about it.
stemZh: ——你为什么错过了会议？——我这些天太健忘了。我就是忘了。
explanation: forgetful 表示“健忘的”，根据 I just forgot about it 可知，故选 B。

stem: I have ________ to say. Thank you for listening.
stemZh: 我还有别的要说。谢谢你的倾听。
optionsZh: 别的任何事物（错误语序）
explanation: 肯定句中用 something；else 后置，故选 A。

stem: Our school team will play ____ the team from No.2 Middle School.
stemZh: 我们校队将与二中代表队对阵。
explanation: against 意为“对阵、对抗”，符合语境，故选 B。

stem: Look! There is ____ in the classroom. It's empty.
stemZh: 看！教室里没有人。它是空的。
explanation: 教室是空的，里面没有人，用 nobody，故选 A。

stem: —Where ________ you go on vacation? —I went to the mountains.
stemZh: ——你假期去哪里了？——我去了山里。
explanation: 根据答语 went 可知问句用一般过去时 did，故选 B。

stem: The heart is the most important ____ of the human body. It keeps us alive.
stemZh: 心脏是人体最重要的部分。它维持我们的生命。
explanation: part 意为“部分”，心脏是身体最重要的部分，故选 B。

stem: The proper ________ of your spare time will make your life colorful.
stemZh: 合理利用你的业余时间会让你的生活丰富多彩。
explanation: use of spare time 表示“业余时间的利用”，故选 B。

stem: Yesterday ________ unusual took place at the famous restaurant.
stemZh: 昨天在那家著名餐厅发生了一件不寻常的事。
explanation: 肯定句中用 something，表示“某件不寻常的事”，故选 C。

stem: —Your new watch looks great. —Thanks. My aunt ____ it for my birthday last month.
stemZh: ——你的新手表看起来很棒。——谢谢。上个月我姑姑为我的生日买了它。
explanation: last month 是过去时间，buy 的过去式为 bought，故选 C。

stem: Without saying ________, he left.
stemZh: 他什么也没说就离开了。
optionsZh: 别的任何事物（错误语序）
explanation: without 是否定词，用 anything；else 后置，故选 A。

stem: —________ your father ________ to work by bus yesterday? —Yes, he did.
stemZh: ——你爸爸昨天坐公交车上班吗？——是的。
explanation: yesterday 提示用一般过去时，疑问句用 Did + 主语 + 动词原形，故选 B。

stem: Running outdoors is getting popular. It is good for our health and it ____ almost nothing.
stemZh: 户外跑步越来越流行。它有益健康，而且几乎不花钱。
explanation: cost 表示“花费金钱”，主语是物，跑步几乎不花钱，故选 D。

stem: —How do you feel about the new chair? —It's really ____. I can sit in it for a long time without feeling tired.
stemZh: ——你觉得这把新椅子怎么样？——真的很舒服。我可以坐很久而不觉得累。
explanation: 能久坐不累说明椅子舒适，用 comfortable，故选 A。

stem: —What did you do on your holiday? —I did ____ special. I just read books at home.
stemZh: ——你假期做了什么？——我没做什么特别的事。我只是在家读书。
explanation: nothing special 意为“没什么特别的”，假期只在家读书，故选 C。

stem: There ____ a lot of people on the beach yesterday afternoon.
stemZh: 昨天下午海滩上有很多人。
explanation: yesterday afternoon 是过去时间，a lot of people 是复数，be 动词用 were，故选 C。

stem: We rode to the village ____ over 2 hours, but no one seemed tired.
stemZh: 我们骑车去那个村庄花了两个多小时，但没有人显得累。
explanation: for + 时间段表示持续的时间，故选 C。

stem: There is ________ interesting in today's newspaper.
stemZh: 今天的报纸上没什么有趣的东西。
explanation: 根据语境，报纸上没什么有趣的东西，用 nothing，故选 B。

stem: —Would you like to go shopping with me? —Sorry, I have ________ to do.
stemZh: ——你想和我一起去购物吗？——抱歉，我有些别的事要做。
explanation: 肯定句中用 something；else 后置，故选 A。

stem: I advise you not to show ____ on Wechat because it may cause trouble.
stemZh: 我建议你不要在微信上展示任何个人信息，因为这可能引起麻烦。
explanation: 否定句用 anything，形容词修饰不定代词后置，故选 A。

stem: —Did you try any special food on vacation? —Yes, I ____.
stemZh: ——你假期尝过什么特别的食物吗？——是的，尝过。
explanation: Did 引导的一般疑问句，简略回答用 did，故选 D。

stem: —Next month we're going ____ as soon as the holiday begins. —Sounds good!
stemZh: ——下个月假期一开始我们就去某个有趣的地方。——听起来不错！
optionsZh: 任何有趣的地方（错误语序）
explanation: 肯定句用 somewhere，形容词 interesting 后置，故选 A。

stem: —Why didn't you come to Jenny's birthday party? ________ else was there. —Sorry, I had to take a piano lesson.
stemZh: ——你为什么没来参加珍妮的生日聚会？其他所有人都在那里。——抱歉，我不得不去上钢琴课。
explanation: 根据 I had to take a piano lesson 可知其他人都在，用 Everybody，故选 A。

stem: I ________ a book about history last Sunday.
stemZh: 上周日我读了一本关于历史的书。
explanation: last Sunday 提示用一般过去时，read 的过去式仍是 read，故选 A。

stem: I don't have ____ to do today. I can play with you.
stemZh: 我今天没什么事可做。我可以和你玩。
explanation: 否定句用 anything，意为“今天没什么事可做”，故选 D。

stem: Be quiet, please. I have ________ important to tell you.
stemZh: 请安静。我有重要的事情要告诉你们。
explanation: 肯定句中用 something；形容词 important 后置，故选 B。

stem: —Have you ever been to the Science Museum, John? —Yes, I have. I ____ part in an AI competition there last month.
stemZh: ——约翰，你去过科学博物馆吗？——去过。上个月我在那里参加了一场人工智能比赛。
explanation: last month 是过去时间，用 take 的过去式 took，故选 B。

stem: —Where did you go on vacation last winter? —I ________ to Hainan with my family and had a good time there.
stemZh: ——去年冬天你去哪里度假了？——我和家人飞去了海南，在那里玩得很开心。
explanation: last winter 提示用一般过去时，fly 的过去式是 flew，故选 B。

stem: We aren't ready ____ the match, while they get everything ready ____ it.
stemZh: 我们还没为比赛做好准备，而他们已经为比赛做好了一切准备。
explanation: be ready for 为……做准备；get ready to do 准备好做某事，故选 A。

stem: —I'm really nervous because I lost my key. —Don't be worried. Stay ________ and think about where you might have left it.
stemZh: ——我丢了钥匙，真的很紧张。——别担心。保持冷静，想想你可能把它落在哪里了。
explanation: calm 表示“冷静的”，stay calm 表示“保持冷静”，故选 B。

stem: —Thank you so much for telling me so many communication skills. —________. I'm glad I could help.
stemZh: ——非常感谢你告诉我这么多沟通技巧。——不客气。我很高兴能帮上忙。
explanation: You're welcome 是回答感谢的常用表达，故选 D。

stem: —There ____ no library in my school five years ago. —No, but now you can study in a new library.
stemZh: ——五年前我们学校没有图书馆。——是的，但现在你可以在新图书馆学习。
explanation: there be 就近原则，no library 是单数，five years ago 用过去式 was，故选 C。

stem: She ____ his grandparents in the countryside last Friday.
stemZh: 上周五她去看望了乡下的祖父母。
explanation: last Friday 是过去时间，用 visited，故选 C。

stem: I didn't buy anything for ________ when I was on vacation.
stemZh: 度假时我没给自己买任何东西。
explanation: buy sth. for oneself 表示“给自己买某物”，用 myself，故选 C。

stem: —Is there ________ in today's newspaper? —No, there's ________.
stemZh: ——今天的报纸上有什么特别的内容吗？——没有，没什么令人愉快的。
optionsZh: 任何特别的内容，某些令人愉快的
任何特别的内容，没什么令人愉快的
特别的内容（错误语序），没什么令人愉快的
特别的内容（错误语序），没什么令人愉快的
explanation: 疑问句中用 anything special；根据 No 可知没什么令人愉快的新闻，用 nothing enjoyable，故选 B。

stem: My foreign friends knew ____ about the Dragon Boat Festival, so I introduced it to them.
stemZh: 我的外国朋友对端午节一无所知，所以我向他们介绍了它。
explanation: 外国朋友对端午节一无所知，所以我向他们介绍，用 nothing，故选 D。

stem: Jeff didn't wear his raincoat in the heavy rain, ________ he was all wet.
stemZh: 杰夫在大雨中没穿雨衣，所以他全身湿透了。
explanation: so 表示结果，根据 he was all wet 可知结果是他全身湿透了，故选 D。

stem: ________ had a good time at the party yesterday.
stemZh: 昨天每个人都在聚会上玩得很开心。
explanation: 根据语境，每个人都在聚会上玩得很开心，用 Everybody，故选 D。

stem: —Is there ____ in the box? —Nothing.
stemZh: ——盒子里有什么东西吗？——没什么。
optionsZh: 别的任何事物（错误语序）
explanation: 疑问句用 anything，else 修饰不定代词后置，故选 C。

stem: —What ________ she do last Sunday? —She visited her aunt.
stemZh: ——上周日她做了什么？——她去看望了她的姑姑。
explanation: last Sunday 提示用一般过去时，疑问句用 did，故选 B。

stem: —____ you at home yesterday afternoon? —No, I was out.
stemZh: ——你昨天下午在家吗？——不，我出去了。
explanation: be at home 表状态，主语 you，过去时用 were，故选 C。

stem: —I thought she would arrive on time! —It's not a big deal. After all, ____ is perfect.
stemZh: ——我以为她会准时到！——没什么大不了的。毕竟，人无完人。
explanation: 人无完人，用 nobody，故选 C。

stem: He ____ to a small mountain town last summer.
stemZh: 去年夏天他去了一个小山城。
explanation: last summer 是过去时间，go 的过去式为 went，故选 C。

stem: My hometown is famous for its ____, such as the clear river, high mountains and green trees.
stemZh: 我的家乡以它的风景闻名，比如清澈的河流、高山和绿树。
explanation: scenery 意为“风景”，家乡以风景闻名，故选 A。

stem: Last year my uncle ____ some tomatoes on the farm.
stemZh: 去年我叔叔在农场种了些西红柿。
explanation: Last year 是过去时间，grow 的过去式为 grew，故选 A。

stem: ________ you ________ to the beach last Sunday?
stemZh: 上周日你去海滩了吗？
explanation: last Sunday 提示用一般过去时，疑问句用 Did + 主语 + 动词原形，故选 B。

stem: —How was your vacation? —It was ________. I didn't enjoy it at all.
stemZh: ——你的假期怎么样？——很糟糕。我一点也不喜欢。
explanation: 根据 I didn't enjoy it at all 可知假期很糟糕，用 terrible，故选 B。

stem: I have ____ important to tell you.
stemZh: 我有重要的事情要告诉你。
explanation: 肯定句用 something，形容词修饰不定代词后置，故选 A。

stem: —Mrs. Williams, what's your ________ of being a wonderful tennis player? —Nothing special. I just work hard every day.
stemZh: ——威廉姆斯夫人，你成为出色网球运动员的秘诀是什么？——没什么特别的。我只是每天努力训练。
explanation: secret 表示“秘诀”，根据 Nothing special. I just work hard 可知，故选 B。

stem: There isn't ________ in the classroom. All the students are having a PE lesson in the playground.
stemZh: 教室里没有人。所有学生都在操场上体育课。
explanation: 否定句中用 anybody，故选 B。

stem: —The best things in life are free. —I couldn't agree more. Air costs ____, but we can't live without it.
stemZh: ——生活中最美好的东西是免费的。——我再同意不过了。空气不花钱，但我们离不开它。
explanation: 空气不用花钱，用 nothing，故选 A。

stem: —Can I have something to eat, mom? —Sorry, there is ________ left at home. Let's go shopping now.
stemZh: ——妈妈，我能吃点东西吗？——抱歉，家里没剩下什么吃的了。我们现在去购物吧。
explanation: 根据 Let's go shopping now 可知家里没剩下什么吃的，用 nothing，故选 C。

stem: ____ in our group enjoyed the holiday trip. We all had great fun.
stemZh: 我们组每个人都享受了这次假期旅行。我们都玩得很开心。
explanation: 后文“我们都玩得开心”，用 Everyone（每个人），故选 A。

stem: Mary isn't a ________ nurse, so now she is receiving a week's ________ in a hospital.
stemZh: 玛丽不是一名受过训练的护士，所以现在她正在医院接受一周的培训。
explanation: trained 是形容词，表示“受过训练的”；training 是名词，表示“培训”，故选 D。

stem: Fu Xing will go to the science museum with us ________ she is free tomorrow.
stemZh: 如果符星明天有空，她会和我们一起去科学博物馆。
explanation: if 引导条件状语从句，表示“如果她明天有空”，故选 C。

stem: Mark and Tony are very good friends. They always ____ much with each other.
stemZh: 马克和托尼是很好的朋友。他们总是彼此分享很多东西。
explanation: share 意为“分享”，好朋友总是分享很多，故选 A。

stem: —What does your maths teacher ____? —He is of medium build.
stemZh: ——你的数学老师长什么样？——他中等身材。
explanation: 询问外貌用 look like，故选 D。

stem: I am really tired after the basketball game. ____ is better than a good rest.
stemZh: 篮球赛后我真的很累。没有什么比好好休息更好的了。
explanation: 打完球很累，没有什么比好好休息更好的了，用 Nothing，故选 C。

stem: We ________ many photos during our trip to Guilin.
stemZh: 在桂林旅行期间我们拍了许多照片。
explanation: 描述过去的旅行经历，用一般过去时 took，故选 B。

stem: Nowadays, almost all the schools pay more attention to the children's health, ____ their mental health.
stemZh: 如今，几乎所有学校都更加关注孩子的健康，尤其是他们的心理健康。
explanation: especially 意为“尤其”，强调突出心理健康，故选 A。

stem: The marketing campaign went over ________ due to unexpected costs.
stemZh: 由于意外成本，这次营销活动超出了预算。
explanation: budget 意为“预算”，超出预算，故选 D。

stem: —Did you go to Beijing on your summer vacation? —____ Beijing is very beautiful and I want to visit it one more time.
stemZh: ——你暑假去北京了吗？——去了。北京很美，我还想再去一次。
explanation: 问句用 Did 提问，答语用 did；去过并且想再去，故选 A。

stem: The ____ of Mount Tai is famous for the beautiful sunrise in the early morning.
stemZh: 泰山的风景以清晨美丽的日出而闻名。
explanation: scenery 意为“风景”，泰山以美丽的日出风景闻名，故选 C。

stem: I went to the library straight after class. I ____ only two minutes on the way.
stemZh: 下课后我直接去了图书馆。路上我只花了两分钟。
explanation: 前后文是一般过去时，spend 的过去式为 spent，故选 B。

stem: The students ________ a school trip last week.
stemZh: 学生们上周进行了一次学校旅行。
explanation: last week 提示用一般过去时 had，故选 B。

stem: —Be quiet please! Have you seen the sign "No Talking"? —Sorry. I ____ it.
stemZh: ——请安静！你看到“禁止交谈”的标志了吗？——抱歉。我没注意到。
explanation: 刚才没注意到标志，用一般过去时 didn't notice，故选 A。

stem: —Did you go to the beach last summer? —No, I ________. I went to the mountains.
stemZh: ——去年夏天你去海滩了吗？——没有。我去了山里。
explanation: 对 Did you...? 的否定回答用 No, I didn't，故选 B。

stem: —Where did you go on vacation? —I went to a small town near Shanghai.
stemZh: ——你假期去哪里了？——我去了上海附近的一个小镇。
options: Where did you go on vacation
Where did she go on vacation
explanation: 根据答语 I went to a small town near Shanghai 可知询问地点，故选 A。

stem: Don't come ________ I phone you.
stemZh: 除非我打电话给你，否则不要来。
explanation: unless 表示“除非”，除非我打电话，否则不要来，故选 B。

stem: —How ____ your summer vacation? —It was great.
stemZh: ——你的暑假怎么样？——很棒。
explanation: 询问假期状态，主语 vacation 是单数，用 was，故选 A。

stem: —Did your sister go shopping with you? —No, she ________ at home.
stemZh: ——你妹妹和你一起去购物了吗？——没有，她待在家里。
explanation: 根据 Did your sister go 可知回答用一般过去时 stayed，故选 B。

stem: Kate and I usually have a lot of fun ____ the summer vacation.
stemZh: 凯特和我通常在暑假期间玩得很开心。
explanation: during 意为“在……期间”，故选 D。

stem: —Where did you go ____ holiday? —I went back ____ the UK with my brother.
stemZh: ——你假期去哪里了？——我和哥哥回到了英国。
explanation: go on holiday 度假；go back to 回到，故选 C。

stem: —Sarah, you're wanted on the phone. It's from Beijing. —You must be kidding. I don't know ____ in Beijing.
stemZh: ——萨拉，有人打电话找你。是从北京打来的。——你一定在开玩笑。我在北京谁也不认识。
explanation: 否定句用 anybody，我不认识北京的任何人，故选 A。

stem: —The little girl looks so scared after seeing the big dog. —Let's try to ________ her down. She might feel better.
stemZh: ——小女孩看到大狗后看起来很害怕。——我们试着让她平静下来。她可能会感觉好些。
explanation: calm sb. down 表示“使某人平静下来”，故选 B。

stem: —What a nice T-shirt! How much did you ________ it? —It ________ me twenty yuan.
stemZh: ——多漂亮的T恤！你花多少钱买的？——它花了我二十元。
explanation: pay for 表示“为……付款”，主语是人；cost 表示“花费金钱”，主语是物，故选 B。

stem: This story is very ____. All the children are interested in it.
stemZh: 这个故事很有趣。所有的孩子都对它感兴趣。
explanation: 故事本身有趣用 interesting，故选 B。

stem: Did ____ go to the park with you?
stemZh: 有人和你一起去公园了吗？
explanation: 一般疑问句用 anyone，表示“任何人”，故选 B。

stem: My favorite teacher is Confucius. People call him Kongfuzi. He ____ a lot of students.
stemZh: 我最喜欢的老师是孔子。人们称他为孔夫子。他教过很多学生。
explanation: 孔子教过很多学生，描述过去的事实用一般过去时 taught，故选 A。

stem: —What did you do last weekend? —I ________ to the movies with my friends.
stemZh: ——你上周末做了什么？——我和朋友们去看电影了。
explanation: last weekend 提示用一般过去时 went，故选 D。

stem: There isn't ____ in the box. It's empty.
stemZh: 盒子里没有任何东西。它是空的。
explanation: 否定句用 anything，故选 B。

stem: —Would you like ____ to eat? —Yes, some bread, please.
stemZh: ——你想吃点东西吗？——是的，请来些面包。
explanation: 委婉询问、期待肯定回答，用 something，故选 A。

stem: Mary wants to write down what is going on, so she keeps a(n) ________ every day.
stemZh: 玛丽想把正在发生的事情记下来，所以她每天写日记。
explanation: keep a diary 表示“写日记”，故选 B。

stem: ________ your head, and you will have an idea.
stemZh: 动动脑筋，你就会有主意。
explanation: 祈使句以动词原形开头，故选 A。

stem: —Did everyone have a good time? —Oh, yes. ________ was excellent. We love it so much.
stemZh: ——每个人都玩得开心吗？——哦，是的。一切都很棒。我们非常喜欢它。
explanation: 根据 We love it so much 可知一切都很棒，用 Everything，故选 D。

stem: There is ____ he'd like to share with us about this story.
stemZh: 关于这个故事，他还有些别的事情想和我们分享。
explanation: 肯定句用 something，else 修饰不定代词要后置，故选 A。

stem: —Where did you go last winter? —I ____ to Hainan.
stemZh: ——去年冬天你去哪里了？——我去了海南。
explanation: 问句是一般过去时，答语用过去式 went，故选 B。

stem: —Is there ____ wrong with the e-bike? —I'm not sure. I will ask ____ to check it.
stemZh: ——电动车出什么毛病了吗？——我不确定。我会请人检查一下。
explanation: 疑问句用 anything；肯定句请人检查用 someone，故选 C。

stem: Mom, can you pick me up ________ after school?
stemZh: 妈妈，你放学后能准时来接我吗？
explanation: on time 表示“准时”，放学后准时来接我，故选 A。

stem: —Is there ____ in the classroom? —No. It's empty. ____ is out to play sports!
stemZh: ——教室里有人吗？——没有。它是空的。所有人都出去运动了！
explanation: 第一空是疑问句用 anyone；第二空“所有人都出去运动”用 Everyone，故选 C。

stem: —When ________ you ________ the Great Wall? —Last month.
stemZh: ——你什么时候参观长城的？——上个月。
explanation: 根据答语 Last month 可知用一般过去时，疑问句用 Did + 主语 + 动词原形，故选 B。

stem: —Dad, I am angry. What should I do? —You should ________.
stemZh: ——爸爸，我很生气。我该怎么办？——你应该深呼吸。
explanation: 生气时应该深呼吸，take a deep breath，故选 B。

stem: —Who ________ you to the zoo yesterday? —My father did.
stemZh: ——昨天谁带你去的动物园？——我爸爸。
explanation: yesterday 提示用一般过去时 took，故选 B。

stem: The dog ran ____ the boy happily when it saw him.
stemZh: 狗看到男孩时高兴地朝他跑去。
explanation: towards 意为“朝、向”，狗高兴地跑向男孩，故选 A。

stem: All the students went out. There was ________ in the classroom now.
stemZh: 所有学生都出去了。现在教室里没有人。
explanation: 根据 All the students went out 可知教室里没有人，用 nobody，故选 C。

stem: The little boy ________ his mother at the bus stop an hour ago.
stemZh: 一小时前小男孩在公交车站遇到了他妈妈。
explanation: an hour ago 提示用一般过去时 met，故选 B。

stem: He ________ me a postcard from Beijing last month.
stemZh: 上个月他从北京给我寄了一张明信片。
explanation: last month 提示用一般过去时 sent，故选 B。

stem: —Who was in the classroom just now? —____. All students went home.
stemZh: ——刚才谁在教室里？——没有人。所有学生都回家了。
explanation: 回答 who 引导的问句，指人用 No one，故选 B。

stem: —Did you do ____ on Mother's Day? —Yes, I drew a picture for my mom.
stemZh: ——母亲节你做了什么特别的事吗？——是的，我给妈妈画了一幅画。
explanation: 疑问句用 anything，形容词 special 修饰不定代词后置，故选 C。

stem: ____ in our class went to the summer camp, so the classroom was empty.
stemZh: 我们班每个人都去了夏令营，所以教室是空的。
explanation: 教室空了说明全班都去了夏令营，用 Everyone，故选 A。

stem: —Did you ________ the museum last week? —Yes, I did.
stemZh: ——你上周参观博物馆了吗？——是的，去了。
explanation: Did 后接动词原形 visit，故选 A。

stem: There's ____ wrong with the engine—it's making strange noises.
stemZh: 发动机出毛病了——它发出奇怪的声音。
explanation: 肯定句表示“出了毛病”，用 something，故选 B。

stem: —Would you like ________ to drink? —Great, a glass of cold coke please.
stemZh: ——你想喝点冷的吗？——太好了，请来一杯冰可乐。
optionsZh: 任何冷的东西（错误语序）
explanation: 表示委婉请求的疑问句中用 something；形容词 cold 后置，故选 A。

stem: In the geography class, the teacher used a stick to ________ at the different places on the world map and told us something about them.
stemZh: 地理课上，老师用棍子指着世界地图上的不同地方，并给我们讲了一些关于它们的知识。
explanation: point at 表示“指向”，老师用棍子指着地图上的不同地方，故选 C。

stem: He ________ up early and ________ to school on foot yesterday morning.
stemZh: 昨天早上他早起，步行去上学。
explanation: yesterday morning 提示用一般过去时，get 的过去式是 got，go 的过去式是 went，故选 B。

stem: —Who taught you to fix a bike? It looks so professional! —____. I learned it from videos.
stemZh: ——谁教你修自行车的？看起来太专业了！——没有人。我从视频里学的。
explanation: 我是从视频里学的，没有人教，用 Nobody，故选 C。

stem: Linda is new in our school so she has ________ friends here. Let's play with her together.
stemZh: 琳达是我们学校的新生，所以她在这里朋友很少。我们一起和她玩吧。
explanation: few 表示“很少”，修饰可数名词复数，根据 Let's play with her together 可知她朋友很少，故选 B。

stem: ________ wants to make their dreams come true, but few can make it.
stemZh: 每个人都想让自己的梦想成真，但很少有人能做到。
explanation: 根据 but few can make it 可知每个人都想实现梦想，用 Everybody，故选 D。

stem: Mary wanted to have a word with Tom. She had ________ to tell him.
stemZh: 玛丽想和汤姆说句话。她有重要的事情要告诉他。
explanation: 肯定句中用 something；形容词 important 后置，故选 D。

stem: —Do you think we have a ________ of winning the game? —Of course. We practice a lot.
stemZh: ——你认为我们有赢得比赛的机会吗？——当然。我们训练了很多。
explanation: chance 表示“机会”，have a chance of doing sth. 表示“有做某事的机会”，故选 B。

stem: But I can't promise you ________. You'll have to try it yourself.
stemZh: 但我不能向你保证任何事。你得自己试试。
explanation: 否定句用 anything，意为“不能向你保证任何事”，故选 B。

stem: Please be quiet! I have ____ to tell you.
stemZh: 请安静！我有重要的事情要告诉你们。
optionsZh: 任何重要的事（错误语序）
explanation: 肯定句用 something，important 修饰不定代词后置，故选 B。

stem: We're looking for ____ who can deal with the new computer virus.
stemZh: 我们正在寻找能处理这种新电脑病毒的人。
explanation: 找一个能处理病毒的人，肯定句用 someone，故选 A。

stem: —Where did you go for your holiday? —I ________ to the mountains with my friends.
stemZh: ——你假期去哪里了？——我和朋友们去了山里。
explanation: 描述过去的假期经历，用一般过去时 went，故选 B。

stem: —What did you do ________ the summer vacation? —We went to the beach and visited my grandparents in the summer vacation.
stemZh: ——暑假期间你做了什么？——我们去了海滩，还看望了祖父母。
explanation: during the summer vacation 表示“在暑假期间”，故选 C。

stem: —I didn't go anywhere on vacation. What about you? —I didn't go anywhere, ________.
stemZh: ——我假期哪儿也没去。你呢？——我也哪儿都没去。
explanation: either 用于否定句末尾，表示“也”，故选 C。

stem: Miss Li always has a lot of work to do. For her, ____ is more important than a proper plan.
stemZh: 李老师总是有很多工作要做。对她来说，没有什么比一个合适的计划更重要。
explanation: 没有什么比合适的计划更重要，用 nothing，故选 A。

stem: —How is Lily in the new school? —She is doing very well. There is ________ to worry about.
stemZh: ——莉莉在新学校怎么样？——她很好。没什么好担心的。
explanation: 根据 She is doing very well 可知没什么好担心的，用 nothing，故选 B。

stem: Would you like ____ to drink, Lily? I think you are thirsty.
stemZh: 莉莉，你想喝点什么吗？我想你渴了。
explanation: 提出建议的疑问句用 something，故选 C。

stem: —Did you enjoy your vacation? —Yes, I ________ a wonderful time.
stemZh: ——你假期玩得开心吗？——是的，我玩得很开心。
explanation: 根据 Did you enjoy 可知回答用一般过去时 had，故选 B。

stem: Learning is a lifelong journey because we can learn ____ every day.
stemZh: 学习是一生的旅程，因为我们每天都能学到新东西。
optionsZh: 没什么新事物（错误语序）
explanation: 每天都能学到新东西，形容词 new 修饰不定代词后置，故选 A。

stem: He didn't ____ TV last night. He read books.
stemZh: 他昨晚没看电视。他看书了。
explanation: didn't 后接动词原形，故选 A。

stem: —It's really a pity that I missed getting a full mark in the English spelling bee. —Take it easy! You should remember that there is ____ perfect in the world.
stemZh: ——真遗憾，我在英语拼写比赛中没拿到满分。——放轻松！你应该记住，世界上没有什么是完美的。
explanation: 世界上没有什么是完美的，用 nothing，故选 D。

stem: The frozen pear is really popular in Northeast China, and almost ____ could say no to it there.
stemZh: 冻梨在中国东北真的很受欢迎，那里几乎没有人能拒绝它。
explanation: 冻梨在东北很受欢迎，几乎没有人能拒绝，用 nobody，故选 A。

stem: We travelled to Beijing ____ train and stayed there for a week.
stemZh: 我们乘火车去北京旅行，在那里待了一周。
explanation: by + 交通工具表示出行方式，by train 意为“乘火车”，故选 B。

stem: —How do you like the film last night? —It's very ____. You'd better not sit in the cinema for two hours.
stemZh: ——你觉得昨晚的电影怎么样？——它非常无聊。你最好不要在电影院坐两个小时。
explanation: 电影令人无聊用 boring，故选 D。

stem: The computer is a common ________ for communication.
stemZh: 电脑是常见的交流媒介。
explanation: medium 表示“媒介”，电脑是常见的交流媒介，故选 A。

stem: Boys and girls, please follow your heart and never let ________ take away your dreams.
stemZh: 孩子们，请跟随你的内心，永远不要让任何人夺走你的梦想。
explanation: never let anyone take away your dreams 表示“不要让任何人夺走你的梦想”，故选 B。

stem: —Miss Zhang, what can I do to improve my English? —I think you should realize the ________ of learning English first.
stemZh: ——张老师，我怎样才能提高英语？——我认为你首先应该意识到学习英语的重要性。
explanation: importance 表示“重要性”，意识到学英语的重要性，故选 D。

stem: —What kind of music do you like? —I like many kinds, ________ pop music.
stemZh: ——你喜欢哪种音乐？——我喜欢很多种，尤其是流行音乐。
explanation: especially 表示“尤其”，根据 I like many kinds 可知尤其喜欢流行音乐，故选 C。

stem: The Palace Museum is a place with many ____ buildings in China.
stemZh: 故宫是中国有许多古建筑的地方。
explanation: ancient 意为“古老的”，故宫有许多古建筑，故选 D。

stem: I didn't go ____, I just stayed at home the whole holiday.
stemZh: 我哪儿也没去，整个假期我都待在家里。
explanation: 否定句用 anywhere；地点副词前不加介词 to，故选 B。

stem: —She often argues ________ her parents ________ everything.
stemZh: ——她经常因为每件事和父母争吵。
explanation: argue with sb. about sth. 是固定短语，表示“与某人争论某事”，故选 C。

stem: —What did you buy in the shop? —____. I didn't have any money.
stemZh: ——你在商店里买了什么？——什么也没买。我没有钱。
explanation: 回答 what 引导的问句，指物用 Nothing，故选 C。

stem: —Frank, winter holiday is coming. Will you go ____? —Yes, Harbin.
stemZh: ——弗兰克，寒假要到了。你要去什么有趣的地方吗？——是的，哈尔滨。
explanation: 疑问句用 anywhere，形容词 interesting 后置，故选 B。

stem: Last summer, my family ________ to Sanya for a holiday.
stemZh: 去年夏天，我们全家去三亚度假。
explanation: last summer 提示用一般过去时 went，故选 B。

stem: —They ________ working after a quick dinner. —Well, I advised them to have a rest, but they refused.
stemZh: ——他们匆匆吃完晚饭后继续工作。——我建议他们休息一下，但他们拒绝了。
explanation: continue doing sth. 表示“继续做同一件事”，故选 C。

stem: —How do you find your classmates? —Most are kind, but ____ of them is as friendly to me as Cathy.
stemZh: ——你觉得你的同学怎么样？——大多数都很友善，但没有一个像凯西那样对我友好。
explanation: none of 表“……之中没有一个”，与 of 连用，故选 A。

stem: I feel ____ because my job is too ____.
stemZh: 我感到无聊，因为我的工作太无聊了。
optionsZh: 感到无聊的；感到无聊的
令人无聊的；令人无聊的
感到无聊的；令人无聊的
explanation: 人感到无聊用 bored，事物令人无聊用 boring，故选 D。

stem: He ____ his homework. He ____ to the library instead.
stemZh: 他没做作业。他去了图书馆。
explanation: 一般过去时否定用 didn't + 动词原形；第二空用过去式 went，故选 A。

stem: —How often do you eat fruit? —________. I eat it every day.
stemZh: ——你多久吃一次水果？——总是。我每天都吃。
explanation: 根据 I eat it every day 可知总是吃水果，用 Always，故选 C。

stem: —I want to tell you ________.
stemZh: ——我想告诉你一些重要的事。
optionsZh: 任何重要的事（错误语序）
explanation: 肯定句中用 something important，形容词后置，故选 A。

stem: ________ it was raining hard, they went on working.
stemZh: 尽管雨下得很大，他们还是继续工作。
explanation: Although 表示“尽管”，尽管雨下得很大，他们还是继续工作，故选 A。

stem: The old man lives ________, but he doesn't feel ________.
stemZh: 这位老人独自居住，但他并不感到孤独。
explanation: alone 表示“独自”，lonely 表示“孤独的”，故选 B。

stem: —Your paintings are so great, David! When did you learn ________? —Three years ago.
stemZh: ——大卫，你的画太棒了！你什么时候学画画的？——三年前。
explanation: learn to paint 表示“学习画画”，根据 Your paintings 可知，故选 C。

stem: —May I ________ your dictionary, Lucy? —Of course, but you can only ________ it for one week.
stemZh: ——露西，我可以借你的字典吗？——当然，但你只能借一周。
explanation: borrow 表示“借入”；keep 表示“保存”，可与一段时间连用，故选 C。

stem: —________ do you watch TV? —Almost every day.
stemZh: ——你多久看一次电视？——几乎每天。
explanation: How often 提问频率，答语 Almost every day 表示频率，故选 B。

stem: We can buy clothes ________ during Double Eleven Shopping Festival online.
stemZh: 双十一网购节期间，我们可以在网上便宜地买衣服。
explanation: cheaply 表示“便宜地”，双十一购物节可以便宜地买衣服，故选 A。

stem: —Let's make a weekly plan ________ the coming holiday! —Sure, we plan ________ have a trip to the mountains.
stemZh: ——让我们为即将到来的假期制定一个每周计划吧！——当然，我们计划去山里旅行。
explanation: 第一空 for 表示“为了”；第二空 plan to do sth. 表示“计划做某事”，故选 B。

stem: You need a pair of ________ to cut the paper for your art project.
stemZh: 你需要一把剪刀来为你的美术项目剪纸。
explanation: scissors 表示“剪刀”，用来剪纸，故选 A。

stem: The girl ________ goes to bed late because she has a good living habit.
stemZh: 这个女孩从不晚睡，因为她有良好的生活习惯。
explanation: 根据 good living habit 可知她从不晚睡，用 never，故选 D。

stem: —________ do you have an English test? —Once a month.
stemZh: ——你们多久有一次英语测试？——一个月一次。
explanation: How often 提问频率，答语 Once a month 表示频率，故选 A。

stem: —My parents ________ me to get better grades this term. —You can do it if you always work hard.
stemZh: ——我父母期望我这学期取得更好的成绩。——如果你一直努力，你能做到的。
explanation: expect sb. to do sth. 表示“期望某人做某事”，故选 C。

stem: —Could you please sweep the floor before the guests arrive? —________. I'll do it right away.
stemZh: ——客人到来之前你能扫一下地吗？——没问题。我马上做。
explanation: No problem 表示“没问题”，同意对方的请求，故选 C。

stem: —Don't play computer games again. It brings ________ to you. —Sorry, mom. I won't.
stemZh: ——不要再玩电脑游戏了。它没给你带来任何有用的东西。——抱歉，妈妈。我不会了。
explanation: 根据 Don't play computer games again 可知打游戏没带来任何有用的东西，用 nothing useful，故选 B。

stem: My uncle ________ in this apartment for over 10 years, and he doesn't want to move.
stemZh: 我叔叔在这套公寓里住了十多年，他不想搬家。
explanation: for over 10 years 提示用现在完成时 has lived，故选 C。

stem: —Can you ________ your new coach? —Hmm... I think he is very humorous.
stemZh: ——你能描述一下你的新教练吗？——嗯……我认为他很幽默。
explanation: describe 表示“描述”，根据 I think he is very humorous 可知，故选 B。

stem: —________ do you visit your grandparents? —Once a week.
stemZh: ——你多久看望一次祖父母？——一周一次。
explanation: How often 提问频率，答语 Once a week 表示频率，故选 B。

stem: My father ________ the newspaper every morning.
stemZh: 我爸爸每天早上看报纸。
explanation: read the newspaper 表示“看报纸”，故选 C。

stem: The boys ________ football on the playground now.
stemZh: 男孩们现在正在操场上踢足球。
explanation: now 提示用现在进行时 are playing，故选 C。

stem: —How often does your sister use the Internet? —She uses it ________. She is busy with her study.
stemZh: ——你妹妹多久上一次网？——她几乎从不上网。她忙于学习。
explanation: 根据 She is busy with her study 可知几乎不上网，用 hardly ever，故选 A。

stem: I love sitting on the ________ to watch the stars and the city lights at night.
stemZh: 我喜欢晚上坐在阳台上看星星和城市灯光。
explanation: balcony 表示“阳台”，可以坐在上面看星星和城市灯光，故选 B。

stem: The baby is sleeping. Please ________.
stemZh: 宝宝在睡觉。请保持安静。
explanation: keep quiet 表示“保持安静”，根据 The baby is sleeping 可知，故选 A。

stem: The girl ________ dance very well. She won first prize in the dancing competition.
stemZh: 这个女孩跳舞跳得非常好。她在舞蹈比赛中获得了一等奖。
explanation: can 表示能力，根据 won first prize 可知，故选 A。

stem: The shop is ________ the bank and the hotel.
stemZh: 商店在银行和酒店之间。
explanation: between...and... 表示“在……和……之间”，故选 B。

stem: ________ you study hard, you will pass the exam.
stemZh: 如果你努力学习，你就会通过考试。
explanation: if 引导条件状语从句，故选 A。

stem: —Bill, ________ I use your ruler? —Of course! Here you are.
stemZh: ——比尔，我可以用你的尺子吗？——当然！给你。
explanation: can 表示请求许可，故选 A。

stem: Millie gets up early and she is ________ late for school.
stemZh: 米莉起得早，她上学从不迟到。
explanation: 根据 gets up early 可知她从不迟到，never 表示“从不”，故选 C。

stem: The little boy is ________ to go to school. He is only five years old.
stemZh: 这个小男孩太小了不能上学。他只有五岁。
explanation: 根据 He is only five years old 可知他太小了不能上学，too young to go to school，故选 C。

stem: —How's Susan? —Oh. I ________ see her because she lives abroad.
stemZh: ——苏珊怎么样？——哦，我几乎见不到她，因为她住在国外。
explanation: 根据“she lives abroad”可知几乎见不到她，hardly表示“几乎不”。

stem: —Do you often exercise? —No, I ________ exercise. I don't like sports.
stemZh: ——你经常锻炼吗？——不，我几乎不锻炼。我不喜欢运动。
explanation: 根据“I don't like sports”可知几乎不锻炼，hardly ever表示“几乎从不”。

stem: Before we moved to the new apartment, I helped my little brother ________ his toys into boxes and write his name on each one.
stemZh: 在我们搬到新公寓之前，我帮弟弟把玩具装进盒子里，并在每个盒子上写上他的名字。
explanation: pack表示“打包”，把玩具装进盒子里。

stem: My brother has a healthy living habit. He ________ stays up late.
stemZh: 我哥哥有健康的生活习惯。他很少熬夜。
explanation: 根据“healthy living habit”可知他很少熬夜，seldom表示“很少”。

stem: Great changes ________ in my hometown since my parents got married.
stemZh: 自从我父母结婚以来，我的家乡发生了巨大的变化。
explanation: since引导时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时。

stem: Last Sunday we didn't go out ________ the rain.
stemZh: 上周日因为下雨我们没有出去。
explanation: because of后接名词短语the rain；because后接句子。

stem: Our ________ is very quiet and safe, with a small park where kids often play.
stemZh: 我们的社区非常安静安全，有一个小公园，孩子们经常在那里玩。
explanation: neighborhood表示“社区”，根据“a small park where kids often play”可知。

stem: It is really difficult to ________ my excitement in words.
stemZh: 真的很难用语言描述我的兴奋。
explanation: describe表示“描述”，很难用语言描述我的兴奋。

stem: You are too heavy. I think you must ________ eat ________ meat.
stemZh: 你太重了。我认为你必须少吃肉多吃（其他东西）。
explanation: 根据“too heavy”可知应该多吃（more）少（less）肉，less修饰不可数名词meat。

stem: ________ my mother was cooking, I was doing my homework.
stemZh: 当我妈妈在做饭时，我在做作业。
explanation: While引导时间状语从句，表示两个动作同时进行。

stem: We didn't tell them we were coming. They felt ________ when they saw us at the station.
stemZh: 我们没有告诉他们我们要来。他们在车站看到我们时感到很惊讶。
explanation: surprised表示“惊讶的”，根据“We didn't tell them”可知。

stem: We need to ________ the living room before our relatives come for the Spring Festival.
stemZh: 在我们亲戚来过年之前，我们需要打扫客厅。
explanation: clean up表示“打扫、清理”。

stem: —I have some exciting news to ________ you. —Really? I can't wait to hear it!
stemZh: ——我有一些激动人心的消息要和你分享。——真的吗？我迫不及待想听了！
explanation: share sth. with sb.表示“与某人分享某事”。

stem: The white ________ match the light-colored walls in our living room very well.
stemZh: 白色的窗帘和我们客厅浅色的墙壁非常搭配。
explanation: curtains表示“窗帘”，与墙壁搭配。

stem: —Someone is knocking at the door. It ________ be Jim. —No, it ________ be him. He is now in another city.
stemZh: ——有人在敲门。可能是吉姆。——不，不可能是他。他现在在另一个城市。
explanation: 第一空may表示不确定推测；第二空can't表示否定推测。

stem: Mr. Li is a great teacher. He often uses games to make his lessons ________.
stemZh: 李老师是一位很棒的老师。他经常用游戏使他的课令人愉快。
explanation: enjoyable表示“令人愉快的”，根据“uses games”可知。

stem: —What's the ________ of your visit to Beijing? —To visit the Palace Museum.
stemZh: ——你参观北京的目的是什么？——参观故宫博物院。
explanation: purpose表示“目的”，根据答语可知询问参观北京的目的。

stem: You should ask him ________ smoking. It's bad for his health.
stemZh: 你应该让他停止吸烟。这对他的健康有害。
explanation: ask sb. to do sth.表示“要求某人做某事”。

stem: The teacher made us ________ the text twice a day.
stemZh: 老师让我们每天背诵课文两遍。
explanation: make sb. do sth.中不带to。

stem: I ________ watch TV in the evening because I have too much homework.
stemZh: 我晚上几乎不看电视，因为我有太多作业。
explanation: 根据“too much homework”可知几乎不看电视。

stem: The crane is used to ________ heavy things onto the ship.
stemZh: 起重机被用来把重物吊到船上。
explanation: lift表示“举起”，根据“heavy things onto the ship”可知。

stem: The water in the river ________ quickly after the heavy rain.
stemZh: 大雨过后河里的水位迅速上升。
explanation: rise表示“上升”，是不及物动词，主语water是动作的执行者。

stem: The family had to stay at a hotel ________ it was raining hard.
stemZh: 这家人不得不待在酒店，因为雨下得很大。
explanation: because引导原因状语从句，因为雨下得很大，所以不得不待在酒店。

stem: ________ your hands before you have dinner.
stemZh: 吃饭前洗手。
explanation: 祈使句以动词原形开头。

stem: When Mum opened the box, the biscuits made by Grandma ________ so good that we could not stop eating them.
stemZh: 当妈妈打开盒子时，奶奶做的饼干闻起来太香了，我们忍不住一直吃。
explanation: smell表示“闻起来”，根据“biscuits”可知是气味。

stem: He ________ like doing housework, but now he helps his mom clean the house every weekend.
stemZh: 他过去不喜欢做家务，但现在他每个周末都帮妈妈打扫房子。
explanation: used not to do sth.表示“过去不常做某事”。

stem: He ________ his homework at home yesterday.
stemZh: 他昨天把作业忘在家里了。
explanation: yesterday提示用一般过去时，否定句用didn't + 动词原形。

stem: ________ he is poor, he is very happy.
stemZh: 尽管他很穷，但他很快乐。
explanation: Although表示“尽管”，引导让步状语从句。

stem: —Could I use your computer for a while? —________. I need it to look up some information.
stemZh: ——我可以用一会儿你的电脑吗？——抱歉，恐怕不行。我需要它查一些信息。
explanation: 根据“I need it to look up some information”可知不能借，用Sorry, I'm afraid not。

stem: —How long did it ________ you to clean the whole apartment? —About two hours. We all worked together.
stemZh: ——打扫整个公寓花了你多长时间？——大约两个小时。我们都一起干的。
explanation: It takes sb. some time to do sth.是固定句型。

stem: —Is there a library near here? —Yes, there is. You can find it ________ the end of this road.
stemZh: ——这附近有图书馆吗？——是的，有。你可以在这条路的尽头找到它。
explanation: at the end of表示“在……的尽头”。

stem: Today is quite ________ for me because I have to take many lessons.
stemZh: 今天对我来说相当忙碌，因为我不得不上很多课。
explanation: busy表示“忙碌的”，根据“I have to take many lessons”可知。

stem: The teacher asked us to ________ the new words in the dictionary.
stemZh: 老师让我们在字典里查阅新单词。
explanation: look up表示“查阅（词典）”。

stem: I ________ go to the movies because I have no time.
stemZh: 我很少去看电影，因为我没有时间。
explanation: 根据“I have no time”可知很少去看电影。

stem: —________ I go to the movies with my friends tonight? —Sure, but you have to come back before 10 o'clock.
stemZh: ——我今晚可以和朋友去看电影吗？——当然可以，但你必须在10点前回来。
explanation: Could I...?表示委婉请求许可。

stem: You ________ the work better in the future.
stemZh: 你将来能够把工作做得更好。
explanation: can do表示“能够做”，in the future提示用一般现在时表将来。

stem: —Linda can't play soccer at all. —________ Soccer is her favorite sport.
stemZh: ——琳达根本不会踢足球。——怎么会呢？足球是她最喜欢的运动。
explanation: How come?表示“怎么会呢？”，根据“Soccer is her favorite sport”可知表示惊讶。

stem: He is ________ to look after himself.
stemZh: 他足够大了，能照顾自己。
explanation: old enough to do sth.表示“足够大能做某事”。

stem: She ________ eats junk food. She thinks it's unhealthy.
stemZh: 她从不吃垃圾食品。她认为它不健康。
explanation: 根据“She thinks it's unhealthy”可知从不吃垃圾食品。

stem: My sister is a book lover. She ________ reads before going to bed.
stemZh: 我妹妹是个书迷。她总是在睡前读书。
explanation: 根据“book lover”可知她总是在睡前读书。

stem: —How long may I ________ the book? —Just one day. I will return it to Mary tomorrow.
stemZh: ——这本书我可以借多久？——就一天。我明天会把它还给玛丽。
explanation: How long提问一段时间，用延续性动词keep。

stem: —What's the matter with you? —I have a ________. I can't eat anything.
stemZh: ——你怎么了？——我胃痛。我什么都吃不下。
explanation: stomachache表示“胃痛”，根据“can't eat anything”可知。

stem: We have a small ________ room to keep our old clothes and seasonal items.
stemZh: 我们有一个小储藏室来存放旧衣服和季节性物品。
explanation: storage room表示“储藏室”。

stem: —Jack, could you please help me take out the rubbish? —Sorry, I ________, Mum. I ________ my homework now.
stemZh: ——杰克，你能帮我倒垃圾吗？——抱歉，妈妈，我不能。我现在正在做作业。
explanation: 第一空用can't表示不能；第二空用am doing表示正在做作业。

stem: —________ I call you this evening? —Sure. I ________ be free after 7 o'clock, so feel free to call me then.
stemZh: ——我今晚可以给你打电话吗？——当然。我7点后可能有空，所以那时随时给我打电话。
explanation: 第一空May I...?表示请求许可；第二空can表示可能性。

stem: —________ you speak English? —Yes, but only a little.
stemZh: ——你会说英语吗？——是的，但只会一点。
explanation: Can you...?询问能力。

stem: —________ you go to the concert with me this Sunday? —I'd love to, but I have to study for my test.
stemZh: ——这周日你能和我去听音乐会吗？——我想去，但我得为考试学习。
explanation: Can you...?表示邀请。

stem: Mr. Wang ________ write last year, he has been ill for three years.
stemZh: 王先生去年不能写字，他已经病了三年。
explanation: couldn't表示“不能”，根据“he has been ill”可知。

stem: Which of the following underlined parts has the same sound as "borrow"?
stemZh: 下列哪个划线部分的发音与“borrow”相同？
explanation: borrow中的o发音为/ɒ/，block中的o发音也为/ɒ/。

stem: The students are ________ the school trip. They are very excited.
stemZh: 学生们很期待学校旅行。他们非常兴奋。
explanation: look forward to表示“期待”。

stem: —________ can be dangerous. Don't let them cut you. —Thanks. I will take care.
stemZh: ——剪刀可能很危险。别让它们割到你。——谢谢。我会小心的。
explanation: scissors表示“剪刀”，根据“Don't let them cut you”可知。

stem: —________ you help me take out the rubbish? —Sure, no problem.
stemZh: ——你能帮我倒垃圾吗？——当然，没问题。
explanation: Could you...?表示礼貌请求。

stem: It's not good to drink too much coffee. ________, I still want to drink some.
stemZh: 喝太多咖啡不好。然而，我还是想喝一些。
explanation: however表示“然而”，然而我还是想喝一些。

stem: —Do you ________ the bus to school every day? —Yes. It ________ me about 20 minutes.
stemZh: ——你每天坐公交车去学校吗？——是的。它花我大约20分钟。
explanation: 第一空take the bus表示“乘公交车”；第二空It takes sb. some time表示“花费某人多长时间”。

stem: We are ________ moving into our new house next month; we've already bought all the furniture.
stemZh: 我们期待下个月搬进新房子；我们已经买了所有家具。
explanation: look forward to表示“期待”。

stem: —Where ________ she go on vacation last summer? —She ________ to New York City.
stemZh: ——去年夏天她去哪里度假了？——她去了纽约。
explanation: last summer提示用一般过去时，第一空用did，第二空用went。

stem: The little girl looks ________ after seeing the big dog.
stemZh: 小女孩看到大狗后看起来很害怕。
explanation: scared表示“害怕的”，根据“after seeing the big dog”可知。

stem: —________ do you go shopping? —Once a week.
stemZh: ——你多久去购物一次？——每周一次。
explanation: How often提问频率。

stem: —Could you please help me carry the box? —________. I'm glad to help.
stemZh: ——你能帮我搬这个箱子吗？——当然可以。我很乐意帮忙。
explanation: Of course表示“当然可以”，同意对方的请求。

stem: My parents want me ________ more exercise.
stemZh: 我父母想让我多锻炼。
explanation: want sb. to do sth.表示“想要某人做某事”。

stem: —Dad, ________ we hang out with our friends after we clean up the new house? —Of course you can.
stemZh: ——爸爸，我们打扫完新房子后可以和朋友出去玩吗？——当然可以。
explanation: could表示委婉请求许可，答语用can。

stem: —Mom, ________ you go shopping with me this Sunday? —I'm afraid not. I ________ look after your grandma. You can go with your sister.
