stemZh: ——妈妈，这周日你能和我去购物吗？——恐怕不行。我不得不照顾你奶奶。你可以和你姐姐去。
explanation: 第一空can表示请求；第二空have to表示“不得不”。

stem: —Mom, could you help me ________ these photos on the wall? —Sure. But where are the nails?
stemZh: ——妈妈，你能帮我把这些照片挂在墙上吗？——当然。但是钉子在哪儿？
explanation: hang up表示“挂起”，把照片挂在墙上。

stem: You ________ swim in this river. It's dangerous.
stemZh: 你禁止在这条河里游泳。这很危险。
explanation: mustn't表示“禁止”，根据“It's dangerous”可知。

stem: If it ________ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
stemZh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。
explanation: if条件状语从句中，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时。

stem: —________ you swim when you were six years old? —No, I couldn't. I learned it when I was eight.
stemZh: ——你六岁时会游泳吗？——不，我不会。我八岁时学的。
explanation: 根据“when you were six years old”可知询问过去的能力，用Could。

stem: —Could you help me with my English? —________. I'm glad to help.
stemZh: ——你能帮我学英语吗？——当然可以。我很乐意帮忙。
explanation: Of course表示“当然可以”，同意对方的请求。

stem: —Did you go to the mountain with your parents, Tom? —________. We went to the Science Museum.
stemZh: ——汤姆，你和父母去山上了吗？——不，我们没去。我们去了科学博物馆。
explanation: 根据“We went to the Science Museum”可知没去爬山。

stem: Thank you very much for ________ us to your housewarming party.
stemZh: 非常感谢你邀请我们参加你的乔迁聚会。
explanation: for是介词，后接动名词inviting。

stem: ________ I was ill, I still went to school.
stemZh: 尽管我病了，我还是去上学了。
explanation: Although表示“尽管”。

stem: —Can you come to my party tomorrow? —Sorry, I ________. I have to visit my grandparents.
stemZh: ——你明天能来参加我的聚会吗？——抱歉，我不能。我得去看望我的祖父母。
explanation: Can you...?的否定回答用can't。

stem: —Do you know the ________ of the test? —Yes. I got an A.
stemZh: ——你知道考试的结果吗？——是的。我得了一个A。
explanation: result表示“结果”，根据“I got an A”可知询问考试结果。

stem: Vegetables are ________. They are good for our ________.
stemZh: 蔬菜是健康的。它们对我们的健康有好处。
explanation: 第一空be动词后接形容词healthy；第二空our后接名词health。

stem: —________ do you go shopping online? —Twice a week.
stemZh: ——你多久网购一次？——每周两次。
explanation: How often提问频率，答语“Twice a week”表示频率。

stem: I ________ live in a small village, but now I live in a big city.
stemZh: 我过去住在一个小村庄，但现在我住在大城市。
explanation: used to do sth.表示“过去常常做某事”。

stem: —________ you help me answer the telephone? —Sure.
stemZh: ——你能帮我接电话吗？——当然。
explanation: Can you...?表示请求。

stem: —Would you like some more bread? —No, thanks. I'm ________.
stemZh: ——你想再来点面包吗？——不，谢谢。我吃饱了。
explanation: 根据“No, thanks”可知已经吃饱了，full表示“饱的”。

stem: —________ she eats a lot every day, she is not fat at all. —How lucky!
stemZh: ——尽管她每天吃很多，但她一点也不胖。——真幸运！
explanation: although表示“尽管”，尽管她每天吃很多，但她一点也不胖。

stem: The old man ________ goes to the park because he can't walk far.
stemZh: 这位老人几乎不去公园，因为他走不远。
explanation: 根据“he can't walk far”可知几乎不去公园。

stem: —Mom, ________ I invite my friends to a party? —Sorry, you ________. You have a test on Monday.
stemZh: ——妈妈，我可以邀请我的朋友来参加聚会吗？——抱歉，你不能。你周一有考试。
explanation: could表示委婉请求，否定回答用can't。

stem: If the door doesn't open, try to ________ it hard.
stemZh: 如果门打不开，试着用力拉它。
explanation: pull表示“拉”，与open对应。

stem: —________ you go to the traditional craft show with me this Saturday? —I'd love to, but I have to prepare for my English test.
stemZh: ——这周六你能和我一起去看传统手工艺展吗？——我想去，但我得为英语考试做准备。
explanation: Can you...?表示邀请或请求。

stem: —Ms. Lin is very popular among the students. —Yes. Her classes are ________ lively and interesting.
stemZh: ——林老师很受学生欢迎。——是的。她的课总是生动有趣。
explanation: 根据“very popular”可知她的课总是生动有趣，always表示“总是”。

stem: —How often do you read English books? —________.
stemZh: ——你多久读一次英语书？——每周三次。
explanation: How often提问频率，Three times a week表示频率。

stem: In our community, everyone is friendly and always ready to ________ others a hand.
stemZh: 在我们的社区，每个人都很友好，总是乐于帮助别人。
explanation: give sb. a hand表示“帮助某人”。

stem: —Can I take a photo with you? —________.
stemZh: ——我可以和你拍张照吗？——是的，你可以。
explanation: Can I...?的肯定回答用Yes, you can。

stem: ________ I like swing dance, I don't have time to learn it.
stemZh: 尽管我喜欢摇摆舞，但我没时间学。
explanation: although表示“尽管”，尽管我喜欢摇摆舞，但我没时间学。

stem: —Could I borrow your pen? —Sorry, I ________ lend it to you. I'm using it now.
stemZh: ——我可以借你的钢笔吗？——抱歉，我不能借给你。我现在正在用。
explanation: 对Could I...?的否定回答用can't。

stem: This is a basket of apples. Let's ________ them into the box.
stemZh: 这是一篮子苹果。让我们把它们放进盒子里。
explanation: put...into...表示“把……放进……”。

stem: —I had a pleasant summer vacation with my family in the south. —________.
stemZh: ——我和家人在南方度过了一个愉快的暑假。——听到这个很高兴。
explanation: Glad to hear that表示“听到这个很高兴”。

stem: —Could you please ________ the window? It's cold outside. —Sorry. I'll close it right away.
stemZh: ——请你不要打开窗户好吗？外面很冷。——抱歉。我马上关上。
explanation: Could you please not do sth.表示“请你不要做某事”。

stem: The bushes make perfect ________ for many animals to hide in.
stemZh: 灌木丛为许多动物提供了完美的藏身之处。
explanation: cover表示“掩护”，灌木丛为动物提供了完美的藏身之处。

stem: We can't afford to ________ a house in the city center, so we decide to ________ one near the subway station.
stemZh: 我们买不起市中心的房子，所以我们决定在地铁站附近租一个。
explanation: buy表示“买”，rent表示“租”，根据“can't afford”和“decide to”可知。

stem: The teacher told us that the earth ________ around the sun.
stemZh: 老师告诉我们地球绕着太阳转。
explanation: 宾语从句表示客观真理，用一般现在时。

stem: —Can I ________ your bike? —With pleasure.
stemZh: ——我可以借你的自行车吗？——很乐意。
explanation: borrow表示“借入”，根据“With pleasure”可知是请求借入。

stem: About 76 percent of the earth ________ water.
stemZh: 地球大约76%是水。
explanation: 百分数作主语，谓语与of后面的名词一致，earth是单数，用is。

stem: —Do you know the man ________ at the gate? —Yes. He is our new neighbour.
stemZh: ——你认识站在门口的那个男人吗？——认识。他是我们的新邻居。
explanation: standing作后置定语，修饰the man。

stem: —I can't go to the party tonight. —________
stemZh: ——我今晚不能去参加聚会了。——真遗憾！
explanation: What a pity!表示“真遗憾”，根据“I can't go to the party”可知。

stem: Millie goes to the Computer Club ________ a week.
stemZh: 米莉每周去两次电脑俱乐部。
explanation: twice a week表示“一周两次”，是固定表达。

stem: —________ you like to go shopping with me? —Yes, I'd love to.
stemZh: ——你想和我去购物吗？——是的，我想去。
explanation: Would you like to do sth.?是固定句型，表示邀请。

stem: —How often does your father exercise? —________.
stemZh: ——你父亲多久锻炼一次？——每天两次。
explanation: Twice a day表示频率，回答How often的提问。

stem: Don't ________ the small problems. They can be solved easily.
stemZh: 不要担心这些小问题。它们很容易解决。
explanation: worry about表示“担心”，根据“They can be solved easily”可知不要担心。

stem: My mother is busy ________ dinner in the kitchen, so please keep quiet.
stemZh: 我妈妈正在厨房忙着做晚饭，所以请保持安静。
explanation: be busy doing sth.表示“忙于做某事”。

stem: —Could you please help me clean the room? —________. I'll do it right away.
stemZh: ——你能帮我打扫房间吗？——没问题。我马上做。
explanation: No problem表示“没问题”，同意对方的请求。

stem: —May I ________ your bike, Kate? Mine is broken. —Of course. It's over there.
stemZh: ——凯特，我可以借你的自行车吗？我的坏了。——当然。在那边。
explanation: borrow表示“借入”，根据“Mine is broken”可知是借入。

stem: —Can I stay out until ten tonight? —No, you ________. You have to come back before 9:30.
stemZh: ——我今晚可以在外面待到十点吗？——不，你不能。你必须在9:30之前回来。
explanation: Can I...?的否定回答用can't。

stem: —The rubbish gives off a bad ________. —Oh, I'll take it out at once.
stemZh: ——垃圾散发出难闻的气味。——哦，我马上把它拿出去。
explanation: give off a bad smell表示“散发出难闻的气味”。

stem: —________ do you like the movie Ne Zha? —It's wonderful. And I have seen it twice.
stemZh: ——你觉得电影《哪吒》怎么样？——很精彩。我已经看了两遍。
explanation: What do you like about...?表示“你喜欢……的什么”。

stem: The number of the students in our school ________ about 1,000.
stemZh: 我们学校的学生人数大约是1000。
explanation: the number of作主语，谓语用单数。

stem: We ________ play sports on school days. You know, we don't have enough time.
stemZh: 我们在上学日几乎不运动。你知道，我们没有足够的时间。
explanation: 根据“we don't have enough time”可知几乎不运动，用hardly。

stem: —Where is your brother, Jim? —Oh, he is having a bath in the ________.
stemZh: ——吉姆，你哥哥在哪里？——哦，他正在浴室洗澡。
explanation: bathroom表示“浴室”，根据“having a bath”可知。

stem: —Could you please help me take out the rubbish? —________.
stemZh: ——你能帮我倒垃圾吗？——当然，我可以。
explanation: 对Could you please...?的肯定回答用Sure, I can。

stem: —Mum, ________ I borrow your phone to call Grandma? —Of course you may.
stemZh: ——妈妈，我可以借你的手机给奶奶打电话吗？——当然可以。
explanation: may表示请求许可，答语用may。

stem: The teacher told us to ________ the text.
stemZh: 老师让我们大声朗读课文。
explanation: read aloud表示“大声朗读”。

stem: Mum asked me to ________ the flowers in the garden every morning.
stemZh: 妈妈让我每天早上给花园里的花浇水。
explanation: water表示“浇水”，water the flowers表示“给花浇水”。

stem: —This is so difficult that I want to give up. —Take it easy. ________, it takes time to learn something new.
stemZh: ——这太难了，我想放弃。——别紧张。毕竟，学新东西需要时间。
explanation: after all表示“毕竟”，毕竟学新东西需要时间。

stem: —Excuse me, ________ you tell me the way to the post office? —Sorry, I'm new here too.
stemZh: ——打扰一下，你能告诉我去邮局的路吗？——抱歉，我也是新来的。
explanation: Could you...?表示礼貌请求。

stem: —I don't know you take a bus to school. —Oh. I ________ take a bus, but it is snowing today.
stemZh: ——我不知道你坐公交车上学。——哦。我通常不坐公交车，但是今天下雪了。
explanation: 根据“but it is snowing today”可知平时几乎不坐公交车。

stem: You ________ be careful when you cross the road.
stemZh: 过马路时你必须小心。
explanation: must表示“必须”，过马路时必须小心。

stem: —________ you please pass me the book? —Sure. Here you go.
stemZh: ——请你把书递给我好吗？——当然。给你。
explanation: Could you please...?表示礼貌请求。

stem: —I'm going to ________ movies. Could you give me ________ lift there?
stemZh: ——我要去看电影。你能载我去那里吗？
explanation: go to the movies是固定搭配；give sb. a lift是固定搭配。

stem: —Could I use your car? —No, you ________. I have to go out now.
stemZh: ——我可以用你的车吗？——不，你不能。我现在得出去。
explanation: Could I...?的否定回答用can't或couldn't。

stem: My father ________ goes to the gym. He is very busy with his work.
stemZh: 我父亲很少去健身房。他工作很忙。
explanation: 根据“He is very busy with his work”可知很少去健身房，seldom表示“很少”。

stem: A woman jumped into the river and ________ yesterday.
stemZh: 昨天一个女人跳进河里死了。
explanation: die表示“死亡”，根据“jumped into the river”可知是溺水身亡。

stem: —Jim, ________ you give me a rubbish bag? —Sure. Here you are!
stemZh: ——吉姆，你能给我一个垃圾袋吗？——当然。给你！
explanation: can表示请求。

stem: Good habits ________ help us a lot and we will make great progress.
stemZh: 好习惯能够帮助我们很多，我们会取得很大进步。
explanation: can表示客观可能性，好习惯能够帮助我们。

stem: —Learning to love is like learning to walk. —Yes, ________ we step out bravely, we'll find it not so difficult.
stemZh: ——学会爱就像学走路。——是的，只要我们勇敢地迈出一步，就会发现它没那么难。
explanation: as long as表示“只要”，引导条件状语从句。

stem: —How was your summer camp last week? —________.
stemZh: ——你上周的夏令营怎么样？——非常好。
explanation: Really good是对How was...?的恰当回答。

stem: —I'm sorry to trouble you. —________.
stemZh: ——很抱歉麻烦你。——没关系。
explanation: It doesn't matter回答道歉，表示“没关系”。

stem: The journey back to our hometown took almost six hours, but the moment we saw Grandfather waiting at the village entrance, we all felt so ________.
stemZh: 回老家的旅程花了将近六个小时，但当我们看到爷爷在村口等着时，我们都感到非常高兴。
explanation: glad表示“高兴的”，根据“saw Grandfather waiting”可知感到高兴。

stem: ________ have you lived in this town? —For about seven years.
stemZh: ——你在这个小镇住了多久？——大约七年。
explanation: How long提问时间长度，答语“For about seven years”表示一段时间。

stem: The students ________ the classroom every day.
stemZh: 学生们每天打扫教室。
explanation: clean up表示“打扫、清理”。

stem: The movie seems ________ boring. I don't want to watch it again.
stemZh: 这部电影似乎很无聊。我不想再看了。
explanation: seem to be表示“似乎是”，是固定搭配。

stem: —What a sunny day! Why not go camping with your friends? —________.
stemZh: ——多晴朗的一天！为什么不和你的朋友去露营呢？——听起来很棒。
explanation: That sounds great.表示“听起来很棒”，同意对方的建议。

stem: —I am looking for a new magazine in the bookstore but find ________. —Maybe you could go to another one.
stemZh: ——我在书店找一本新杂志但一本也没找到。——也许你可以去另一家。
explanation: none表示“一个也没有”，根据“Maybe you could go to another one”可知一本也没找到。

stem: I ________ live in a small cottage, but now I live in a big apartment in the city.
stemZh: 我过去住在一个小村舍，但现在我住在城里的大公寓。
explanation: used to do sth.表示“过去常常做某事”。

stem: —Did you go anywhere interesting this summer vacation? —________. I only stayed at home to study for the test.
stemZh: ——这个暑假你去了什么有趣的地方吗？——不完全是这样。我只待在家里为考试学习。
explanation: Not really表示“不完全是”，根据“I only stayed at home”可知。

stem: —________ I go out with my friends, Mom? —No, you ________. You must finish your homework first.
stemZh: ——妈妈，我可以和朋友出去吗？——不，你不能。你必须先完成作业。
explanation: Can I...?表示请求许可，否定回答用can't。

stem: —Could you go to the new movie with me now? —Sorry, I ________. Look, it's time for me to watch The Readers on CCTV.
stemZh: ——你现在能和我去看新电影吗？——抱歉，我不能。看，我该看央视的《朗读者》了。
explanation: Could you...?的否定回答用can't。

stem: She ________ goes to the library because she loves reading.
stemZh: 她经常去图书馆，因为她喜欢阅读。
explanation: 根据“she loves reading”可知她经常去图书馆。

stem: There's a new ________ in our house, and it has a modern shower.
stemZh: 我们房子里有一个新浴室，它有一个现代化的淋浴设备。
explanation: bathroom表示“浴室”，有淋浴设备。

stem: —Let's go to look for Alice ________. —Look for Alice? But she is doing her homework in her bedroom ________.
stemZh: ——我们马上去找爱丽丝吧。——找爱丽丝？但她现在正在卧室做作业。
explanation: right away表示“立刻”，right now表示“现在”。

stem: He ________ watches TV. He thinks it's a waste of time.
stemZh: 他几乎从不看电视。他认为这是浪费时间。
explanation: 根据“He thinks it's a waste of time”可知他几乎不看电视。

stem: —________ do you like the movie? —It's wonderful.
stemZh: ——你觉得这部电影怎么样？——很精彩。
explanation: How do you like...?表示“你觉得……怎么样？”

stem: —I wish you can get good grades this time! —________.
stemZh: ——我希望你这次能取得好成绩！——谢谢你。
explanation: Thank you.表示对祝福的感谢。

stem: The father was asleep; the child found a coat and covered him ________ it.
stemZh: 父亲睡着了；孩子找到一件外套盖在他身上。
explanation: cover...with...表示“用……覆盖……”。

stem: —I think friendship is very important in life. —Yes. A good friend can help to ________ the best in us.
stemZh: ——我认为友谊在生活中非常重要。——是的。好朋友能帮助展现出我们最好的一面。
explanation: bring out the best in sb.表示“使某人展现出最好的一面”。

stem: —Sally always shares her new hobbies ________ her best friends. —Yeah. She is very kind and outgoing.
stemZh: ——萨莉总是和她最好的朋友分享她的新爱好。——是的。她非常善良外向。
explanation: share sth. with sb.是固定搭配。

stem: It's not easy for primary students ________ themselves freely in class.
stemZh: 小学生在课堂上自由地表达自己并不容易。
explanation: It is + 形容词 + for sb. + to do sth.句型。

stem: ________ is important for us to learn English well.
stemZh: 学好英语对我们很重要。
explanation: It is important for sb. to do sth.是固定句型，it作形式主语。

stem: My brother uses the Internet every night ________ he has much homework to do.
stemZh: 我哥哥每晚都上网，尽管他有很多作业要做。
explanation: although表示“尽管”，尽管有很多作业，他每晚还是上网。

stem: —________ do you help your mother do housework? —Every day.
stemZh: ——你多久帮妈妈做一次家务？——每天。
explanation: How often提问频率，答语“Every day”表示频率。

stem: We ________ get the chance to go to the cinema, because we are too busy with our work.
stemZh: 我们很少有机会去看电影，因为我们工作太忙了。
explanation: 根据“we are too busy with our work”可知很少有机会去看电影，seldom表示“很少”。

stem: My little sister ________ ride a bike now. She learned it last month.
stemZh: 我妹妹现在会骑自行车了。她上个月学的。
explanation: now提示用一般现在时，can表示现在的能力。

stem: Math, Music, Art and English are all different school ________.
stemZh: 数学、音乐、美术和英语都是学校不同的科目。
explanation: subject表示“学科”，Math、Music、Art、English都是学校开设的不同学科。

stem: —More and more foreigners are becoming interested in Beijing Opera. —That's true. It's an important part of Chinese ________.
stemZh: ——越来越多的外国人对京剧感兴趣。——没错。它是中国文化的重要组成部分。
explanation: culture表示“文化”，京剧是中国文化的一部分。

stem: There ________ a pen and two books on the desk.
stemZh: 桌子上有一支钢笔和两本书。
explanation: there be句型遵循就近原则，a pen是单数，用is。

stem: —________ do you visit your grandparents? —Twice a month.
stemZh: ——你多久看望一次你的祖父母？——每月两次。
explanation: How often提问频率，答语“Twice a month”表示频率。

stem: You ________ go home early, or your parents will worry about you.
stemZh: 你应该早点回家，否则你父母会担心你。
explanation: should表示“应该”，根据“or your parents will worry”可知。

stem: —________ I go out to play basketball, Mom? —No, you ________. You must finish your homework first.
stemZh: ——妈妈，我可以出去打篮球吗？——不，你不能。你必须先完成作业。
explanation: May I...?表示请求许可；否定回答用can't。

stem: My grandparents ________ a two-story house with a vegetable garden in the countryside.
stemZh: 我的祖父母在乡下拥有一栋带菜园的两层房子。
explanation: own表示“拥有”。

stem: —________ you please turn down the TV? I'm doing my homework. —Sorry, I'll do it right now.
stemZh: ——请你把电视调小一点好吗？我在做作业。——抱歉，我马上调小。
explanation: Could you please do sth.表示礼貌请求。

stem: Look at the ________ after the rain. It has seven colors and it looks very beautiful.
stemZh: 看雨后的彩虹。它有七种颜色，看起来非常美丽。
explanation: rainbow表示“彩虹”，雨后出现且有七种颜色。

stem: —________ I use your dictionary? —Of course. Here you are.
stemZh: ——我可以用你的字典吗？——当然。给你。
explanation: May I...?表示请求许可。

stem: —How often do you go to the cinema? —________. I don't like movies.
stemZh: ——你多久去一次电影院？——从不。我不喜欢电影。
explanation: 根据“I don't like movies”可知从不去电影院。

stem: There isn't much ________ in my new bedroom, just a bed and a desk.
stemZh: 我的新卧室里没有太多家具，只有一张床和一张桌子。
explanation: furniture是不可数名词，没有复数形式。

stem: —Why do you like running so much, Mr. Green? —Well, it's good for my ________.
stemZh: ——格林先生，你为什么这么喜欢跑步？——嗯，它对我的健康有好处。
explanation: be good for one's health表示“对某人的健康有好处”。

stem: ________ he is young, he knows a lot about science.
stemZh: 尽管他很年轻，但他对科学了解很多。
explanation: Although表示“尽管”。

stem: —________ you please not make so much noise? The baby is sleeping. —Sorry, I didn't know.
stemZh: ——请你不要弄出这么大的噪音好吗？宝宝在睡觉。——抱歉，我不知道。
explanation: Could you please not do sth.表示“请你不要做某事”。

stem: —Mom, ________ I hang out with my classmates this Sunday afternoon? —Yes, of course you can.
stemZh: ——妈妈，这周日下午我可以和同学出去玩吗？——是的，当然可以。
explanation: Can I...?表示请求许可。

stem: Who has ________ rice of all?
stemZh: 所有人中谁的大米最少？
explanation: of all表示范围，用最高级。rice是不可数名词，用the least。

stem: Could you ________ the rubbish when you go out? It's getting smelly.
stemZh: 你出去时能把垃圾拿出去吗？它开始发臭了。
explanation: take out the rubbish表示“倒垃圾”。

stem: My brother covers the box ________ a piece of paper.
stemZh: 我哥哥用一张纸盖住盒子。
explanation: cover...with...表示“用……覆盖……”。

stem: —Can I use your scissors to cut some paper? —Sorry, I ________ them to my cousin this morning. You can go and ask her.
stemZh: ——我可以用你的剪刀剪纸吗？——抱歉，我今天早上把它们借给我表妹了。你可以去问她。
explanation: lend表示“借出”，lend sth. to sb.表示“把某物借给某人”。

stem: This song sounds very ________. I think I heard it somewhere last month.
stemZh: 这首歌听起来很熟悉。我想我上个月在什么地方听过。
explanation: familiar表示“熟悉的”，根据“I heard it somewhere”可知。

stem: Here are two bags for your brother and you. You can ________ one.
stemZh: 这里有两个包给你和你弟弟。你们可以选一个。
explanation: choose表示“选择”，根据“Here are two bags”可知你可以选择一个。

stem: My cousin ________ play the guitar very well. He won first prize in the school music competition last year.
stemZh: 我表弟吉他弹得很好。他去年在学校音乐比赛中获得了一等奖。
explanation: can表示能力，根据“won first prize”可知他会弹吉他。

stem: It's important for us to ________ our environment.
stemZh: 对我们来说，保护环境很重要。
explanation: protect表示“保护”，保护环境是重要的。

stem: The girl is too ________ to hear the end of the long speech.
stemZh: 这个女孩太困了，没听到长篇演讲的结尾。
explanation: sleepy表示“困倦的”，可作表语。

stem: —Can you help your sister ________ the photos? —No problem!
stemZh: ——你能帮你姐姐挂照片吗？——没问题！
explanation: hang up表示“挂起”。

stem: —How much did you ________ the T-shirt? —It ________ me 100 yuan.
stemZh: ——你买这件T恤花了多少钱？——它花了我100元。
explanation: pay for表示“为……付款”，主语是人；cost表示“花费金钱”，主语是物。

stem: I feel ________ in my new bed; it's soft and fits me perfectly.
stemZh: 我在新床上感觉很舒服；它很软，非常适合我。
explanation: comfortable表示“舒适的”，根据“soft and fits me perfectly”可知。

stem: —________ I move the table in the living room? It takes up too much space. —Yes, you can.
stemZh: ——我可以移动客厅的桌子吗？它占了太多空间。——是的，你可以。
explanation: Can I...?表示请求许可。

stem: We ________ play basketball after school if we finish our homework.
stemZh: 如果我们完成作业，放学后我们可以打篮球。
explanation: can表示“可以、能够”，根据“if we finish our homework”可知是条件许可。

stem: —________ do you go to the movies? —Three times a week.
stemZh: ——你多久去看一次电影？——每周三次。
explanation: How often提问频率，答语“Three times a week”表示频率。

stem: —Would you like to come to my birthday party tonight? —________.
stemZh: ——你今晚想来参加我的生日聚会吗？——是的，我想去。
explanation: Yes, I'd like to.表示接受邀请。

stem: —Thank you for helping me with my English. —________.
stemZh: ——谢谢你帮我学英语。——不客气。
explanation: No problem回答感谢，表示“不客气”。

stem: Mary often does some shopping ________ online on ________ weekends.
stemZh: 玛丽经常在周末网购。
explanation: online是副词，前面不加介词；on weekends是固定搭配，但此处用“/”表示泛指。

stem: —Would you like to go shopping with me? —________. I'd love to.
stemZh: ——你想和我去购物吗？——是的，我想去。
explanation: 根据“I'd love to”可知接受邀请。

stem: —________ you please help me carry the heavy box? —Of course. I'm glad to help.
stemZh: ——请你帮我搬这个重箱子好吗？——当然。我很乐意帮忙。
explanation: Could you please do sth.表示礼貌请求，语气比Can更委婉。

stem: ________ you go, home is always a warm place that is happy to see you.
stemZh: 无论你走到哪里，家永远是一个温暖的地方，乐于见到你。
explanation: Wherever表示“无论哪里”，根据“home is always a warm place”可知。

stem: We didn't go back to the hotel ________ it began to rain heavily.
stemZh: 直到开始下大雨我们才回到酒店。
explanation: not...until...表示“直到……才……”。

stem: Rome was not built in a day. So don't expect ________ your goals in a short time.
stemZh: 罗马不是一天建成的。所以不要期望在短时间内实现你的目标。
explanation: expect to do sth.表示“期望做某事”。

stem: —Remember to finish your homework before dinner. —________. I will.
stemZh: ——记得在晚饭前完成作业。——知道了。我会的。
explanation: Got it表示“知道了”。

stem: The dumplings are ________ than the noodles, I think.
stemZh: 我认为饺子比面条好吃得多。
explanation: than提示用比较级，delicious是多音节词，用much more delicious。

stem: She is quieter than ________ in her class.
stemZh: 她比班上其他任何人都安静。
explanation: anyone else表示“其他任何人”。

stem: Now we can learn about dinosaurs ________ their fossils because all dinosaurs have died out.
stemZh: 现在我们可以通过化石了解恐龙，因为所有恐龙都已灭绝。
explanation: learn from表示“从……中学习”。

stem: If two people are "as slim as" each other, it means they are ________.
stemZh: 如果两个人“as slim as”彼此，意思是他们都________。
explanation: as...as表示"和……一样"，slim意为"苗条的"，所以表示两个人都很苗条。

stem: Which group of the following underlined parts has the different sound?
stemZh: 下列哪一组划线部分的发音不同？
explanation: early中的ear发音为/ɜː/，surprise中的ur发音为/ə/，发音不同。

stem: The streets are much ________ in my hometown than they were ten years ago.
stemZh: 我家乡的街道比十年前宽多了。
explanation: than提示用比较级，much修饰比较级wider。

stem: Sam did ________ in his studies this year than last year.
stemZh: 萨姆今年在学习上比去年做得好。
explanation: 句中than提示用比较级，well的比较级是better。

stem: A true friend will always ________ you when you are in trouble. —That's what friendship means.
stemZh: 真正的朋友在你遇到困难时总会关心你。——这就是友谊的意义。
explanation: care about表示“关心”。

stem: —________ your hard work, we finished the project on time. —It was my pleasure to help.
stemZh: ——多亏了你的努力，我们按时完成了项目。——能帮忙是我的荣幸。
explanation: Thanks to表示多亏了。

stem: The problem is ________ than we thought.
stemZh: 这个问题比我们想象的更难。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: —I think a good friend should be a good listener. —________.
stemZh: ——我认为好朋友应该是一个好的倾听者。——我同意。
explanation: I agree表示同意对方的看法。

stem: This problem is ________ than that one.
stemZh: 这个问题比那个问题更难。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: —The traffic around our school is really heavy when school is over. —Exactly. If there are ________ parents driving, there will be ________ traffic.
stemZh: ——放学时我们学校周围的交通真的很拥挤。——确实。如果开车的家长越少，交通就越少。
explanation: parents是可数名词复数，用fewer修饰；traffic是不可数名词，用less修饰。开车家长越少，交通越少。

stem: You have to be ________ and wait until I finish my work.
stemZh: 你必须有耐心，等到我完成工作。
explanation: patient表示“有耐心的”，根据“wait until I finish my work”可知。

stem: —Ella, you seem to enjoy reading in your spare time. —Yes. Reading can open my mind. ________, the more I read, the more I want to know.
stemZh: ——艾拉，你似乎喜欢在空闲时间阅读。——是的。阅读能开阔我的思维。此外，我读得越多，就越想知道更多。
explanation: Besides表示“此外”，补充说明阅读的好处。

stem: —Who is your best friend? —________.
stemZh: ——谁是你最好的朋友？——他是汤姆。
explanation: 询问“谁”应用人名回答。

stem: —What do you think of your new friend? —She is ________ than me.
stemZh: ——你觉得你的新朋友怎么样？——她比我更友好。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: —Don't compare your performance ________ others'. Just focus on your own progress. —Sorry, I won't.
stemZh: ——不要把你的表现和别人的比较。专注于你自己的进步。——抱歉，我不会了。
explanation: compare...with...表示“把……和……比较”。

stem: She is ________ than her classmate.
stemZh: 她比她的同学更友好。
explanation: than提示用比较级，friendly变y为i再加-er。

stem: —My sister is ________ than me at playing volleyball. —You should practice more to catch up with her.
stemZh: ——我妹妹打排球比我好。——你应该多练习来赶上她。
explanation: than提示用比较级better。

stem: Mark can run as ________ as his brother.
stemZh: 马克能跑得和他哥哥一样快。
explanation: as...as中间用原级，fast是副词原级。

stem: —Is Ella popular in your class? —No, she isn't. That's because she doesn't ________ others' problems.
stemZh: ——艾拉在你们班受欢迎吗？——不，她不受欢迎。那是因为她不关心别人的问题。
explanation: care about表示关心，根据others' problems可知她不关心别人的问题。

stem: She is popular ________ her classmates.
stemZh: 她受同学们的欢迎。
explanation: be popular with表示“受……欢迎”。

stem: The more careful you are, ________ mistakes you will make.
stemZh: 你越仔细，你犯的错误就越少。
explanation: the + 比较级，the + 比较级；mistakes是可数名词，用fewer。

stem: —Tim, do you think time is money? —Yes, but I think it is ________ money.
stemZh: ——蒂姆，你认为时间就是金钱吗？——是的，但我认为它比金钱更重要。
explanation: 根据"Yes, but"可知认为时间比金钱更重要，用more important than。

stem: I think English is as ________ as math.
stemZh: 我认为英语和数学一样重要。
explanation: as...as中间用原级。

stem: The actors will ________ the play for next Friday night's show.
stemZh: 演员们将为下周五晚上的演出表演这部戏剧。
explanation: perform表示表演。

stem: A good friend cares ________ you.
stemZh: 好朋友会关心你。
explanation: care about表示关心。

stem: Jack is ________ honest boy, and he has ________ good sense of humour.
stemZh: 杰克是一个诚实的男孩，他有很好的幽默感。
explanation: honest以元音音素开头，用an；have a good sense of humour是固定搭配。

stem: —Dad, could I spend my pocket money on beautiful dresses? —It's OK. But I think spending it on books is ________.
stemZh: ——爸爸，我可以把零花钱花在漂亮的裙子上吗？——可以。但我认为花在书上更有意义。
explanation: 根据It's OK. But...可知爸爸认为买书更有意义。

stem: He is as ________ as his brother.
stemZh: 他和他哥哥一样高。
explanation: as...as中间用原级tall。

stem: —________ your new neighbourhood ________? —It's very modern and beautiful.
stemZh: ——你的新社区是什么样子的？——它非常现代和美丽。
explanation: What's...like?是询问事物怎么样的固定句型。

stem: The new method is completely different ________ the old one because it uses new tools and has more steps.
stemZh: 新方法与旧方法完全不同，因为它使用新工具并且有更多步骤。
explanation: be different from表示“与……不同”。

stem: ________ the mountain is, ________ the air is.
stemZh: 山越高，空气越稀薄。
explanation: "the + 比较级，the + 比较级"结构。

stem: ________ carefully you take notes, ________ mistakes you will have.
stemZh: 你做笔记越仔细，你犯的错误就越少。
explanation: "the+比较级..., the+比较级..."为固定句型。第一空修饰副词carefully用The more；第二空修饰可数名词复数mistakes用the fewer。

stem: This book is ________ interesting than that one.
stemZh: 这本书没有那本有趣。
explanation: than提示用比较级，less是little的比较级。

stem: Math, Chinese and English are important school ________.
stemZh: 数学、语文和英语是学校的重要科目。
explanation: subject表示“学科”，Math、Chinese、English都是学校的重要学科。

stem: Lily thinks swimming is ________ than running and I agree with her.
stemZh: 莉莉认为游泳比跑步更难，我同意她的看法。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: It's necessary for us to ________ our ideas before making a decision.
stemZh: 在做决定之前，我们有必要比较一下我们的想法。
explanation: compare表示比较，根据before making a decision可知。

stem: —I met my primary school teacher ________ in the supermarket yesterday. —What a sweet surprise!
stemZh: ——昨天我在超市偶然遇到了我的小学老师。——多么甜蜜的惊喜啊！
explanation: by accident表示“偶然地”。

stem: Our neighborhood is becoming more and more ________.
stemZh: 我们的社区变得越来越友好。
explanation: “比较级 + and + 比较级”表示“越来越……”，friendly的比较级是friendlier。

stem: Tom's bike is the same ________ mine, but his bag is different ________ mine.
stemZh: 汤姆的自行车和我的一样，但他的包和我的不同。
explanation: the same as表示“和……一样”；be different from表示“与……不同”。

stem: Learning new things gets ________ as we grow older because we need more time to remember and practice them.
stemZh: 随着年龄增长，学习新事物变得越来越难，因为我们需要更多时间来记住和练习它们。
explanation: 根据we need more time to remember and practice them可知学习新事物变得越来越难。

stem: I play the flute in my ________ time. It makes my life more colourful.
stemZh: 我在空闲时间吹长笛。它让我的生活更加丰富多彩。
explanation: spare time表示“空闲时间”。

stem: —________ is the population of the town? —Over 20,000. And a third of the population ________ workers of the car factory.
stemZh: ——这个镇的人口是多少？——超过两万。三分之一的人口是汽车厂的工人。
explanation: 第一空询问人口用What；第二空a third of the population作主语，population指人时谓语用复数are。

stem: My father is as ________ as my mother, and they both work hard every day.
stemZh: 我父亲和我母亲一样忙碌，他们每天都很努力地工作。
explanation: as...as中间用原级busy。

stem: She is ________ than her mother.
stemZh: 她比她妈妈更漂亮。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: He is talented ________ music.
stemZh: 他在音乐方面有天赋。
explanation: be talented in表示“在……方面有天赋”。

stem: —I think friends should be different ________ each other. —I don't agree with you. I think friends should be similar ________ each other.
stemZh: ——我认为朋友应该彼此不同。——我不同意你的看法。我认为朋友应该彼此相似。
explanation: be different from表示"与……不同"；be similar to表示"与……相似"。

stem: My best friend is similar ________ me. We both love sports.
stemZh: 我最好的朋友和我相似。我们都喜欢运动。
explanation: be similar to表示“与……相似”。

stem: She has such a kind and friendly ________ that every classmate wants to make friends with her.
stemZh: 她有这么善良友好的性格，每个同学都想和她交朋友。
explanation: personality表示“性格”，根据“kind and friendly”可知。

stem: Which do you like ________, English or Chinese?
stemZh: 你更喜欢哪一个，英语还是语文？
explanation: 两者比较用比较级better。

stem: Our sons are very different ________ each other. They don't have interests ________ common.
stemZh: 我们的儿子彼此很不同。他们没有共同的兴趣。
explanation: be different from表示“与……不同”；have...in common表示“有……共同之处”。

stem: He has ________ books than I do.
stemZh: 他的书比我多。
explanation: than提示用比较级，many的比较级是more。

stem: This room is ________ than that one, but it's more comfortable.
stemZh: 这个房间比那个小，但更舒适。
explanation: than提示用比较级smaller。

stem: —Do you and your sister have anything in common? —Yes, we ________.
stemZh: ——你和你妹妹有什么共同之处吗？——是的，我们有。
explanation: 对Do you...?的肯定回答用Yes, we do。

stem: My deskmate's hobby is ________ mine. We both love taking photos in our free time.
stemZh: 我同桌的爱好和我的一样。我们都喜欢在空闲时间拍照。
explanation: the same as表示“和……一样”。

stem: —Why don't you talk to your parents about your plan? —________. They always understand me.
stemZh: ——你为什么不和你父母谈谈你的计划呢？——好主意。他们总是理解我。
explanation: Good idea表示“好主意”。

stem: ________ my father ________ my mother love me, I love them, too.
stemZh: 我爸爸和我妈妈都爱我，我也爱他们。
explanation: Both...and...表示"两者都"，连接主语时谓语用复数。

stem: Lucy and Lily are twin sisters, but they have some ________. Lucy is quieter, while Lily is more outgoing.
stemZh: 露西和莉莉是双胞胎姐妹，但她们有一些不同之处。露西更安静，而莉莉更外向。
explanation: differences表示"不同之处"，根据"Lucy is quieter, while Lily is more outgoing"可知。

stem: Which do you like ________, tea or coffee?
stemZh: 你更喜欢哪一个，茶还是咖啡？
explanation: 两者比较用比较级better。

stem: —Remember to put on warm clothes. It's getting ________ these days. —I wish the weather in winter could be as ________ as that in spring.
stemZh: ——记得穿上暖和的衣服。这些天变冷了。——我希望冬天的天气能像春天一样暖和。
explanation: 第一空根据"put on warm clothes"可知天气变冷了，用colder；第二空as...as中间用原级warm。

stem: Her English is ________ than mine.
stemZh: 她的英语比我的好。
explanation: than提示用比较级，good的比较级是better。

stem: The little dog is afraid ________ thunder.
stemZh: 这只小狗害怕打雷。
explanation: be afraid of表示“害怕”。

stem: I'm ________ than my sister.
stemZh: 我比我妹妹更外向。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: Tom speaks Chinese ________ better than Jimmy.
stemZh: 汤姆中文说得比吉米好得多。
explanation: much可以修饰比较级better。

stem: My brother's hobby is different ________ mine. I like reading, but he likes playing football.
stemZh: 我哥哥的爱好和我的不同。我喜欢阅读，但他喜欢踢足球。
explanation: be different from表示"与……不同"。

stem: Leo can play the piano ________ than his sister.
stemZh: 利奥弹钢琴比他姐姐好。
explanation: than提示用比较级，well的比较级是better。

stem: —Do you need any help? —Yes, the job is ________ I could do myself.
stemZh: ——你需要帮助吗？——是的，这份工作超出了我独自能完成的范围。
explanation: more than表示"超出"，这份工作超出了我独自能完成的范围。

stem: Thanks to the Internet, we can do all our shopping at home.
stemZh: 由于互联网，我们可以在家完成所有购物。
explanation: Because of表示“由于”，thanks to与because of意思相近。

stem: Her kind and caring ________ makes her a great friend to everyone.
stemZh: 她善良体贴的性格使她成为每个人的好朋友。
explanation: character表示性格，根据kind and caring可知。

stem: She is ________ than any other student in her class.
stemZh: 她比班上任何其他学生都高。
explanation: than any other student提示用比较级。

stem: —My zipper won't work. Could you help me repair it, Bill? —________
stemZh: ——我的拉链坏了。比尔，你能帮我修一下吗？——当然，乐意效劳。
explanation: Sure, with pleasure表示"当然，乐意效劳"，同意帮助对方。

stem: I am more confident ________ I was last year.
stemZh: 我比去年更自信了。
explanation: 比较级more confident后接than引出比较对象。

stem: This bag is ________ than that one.
stemZh: 这个包比那个重。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: Please speak aloud so that everyone can hear you.
stemZh: 请大声说话，以便每个人都能听到你。
explanation: aloud与in a loud voice意思相近，表示“大声地”。

stem: The team then searched the whole cave ________ but did not find anything ________ an empty tin trunk.
stemZh: 然后团队彻底搜索了整个洞穴，但除了一个空锡箱外什么也没找到。
explanation: thoroughly表示“彻底地”；except表示“除……之外（不包括）”。

stem: Mark is 1.65m. Peter is 1.60m. Mark is ________ than Peter.
stemZh: 马克身高1.65米。彼得身高1.60米。马克比彼得高。
explanation: 两者比较用比较级taller。

stem: Li Lei is heavier than his twin brother. Li Lei's twin brother is ________ than Li Lei.
stemZh: 李磊比他双胞胎兄弟重。李磊的双胞胎兄弟比李磊轻。
explanation: 根据Li Lei is heavier可知他的双胞胎兄弟比他轻，用lighter。

stem: You should listen to your teacher ________.
stemZh: 你应该仔细听老师讲课。
explanation: 修饰动词listen用副词carefully。

stem: This movie is ________ than that one.
stemZh: 这部电影比那部好。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: My sister is ________ outgoing than me, so she has more friends.
stemZh: 我妹妹比我更外向，所以她有更多朋友。
explanation: than提示用比较级，outgoing是多音节词，用more outgoing。

stem: The red dress looks new. The blue one looks newer. The blue dress looks ________ than the red one.
stemZh: 红色连衣裙看起来很新。蓝色看起来更新。蓝色连衣裙比红色看起来更新。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: Can you tell me your best friend is ________ as you or ________ from you?
stemZh: 你能告诉我你最好的朋友是和你一样还是和你不同吗？
explanation: the same as表示“和……一样”；be different from表示“与……不同”。

stem: Which subject is ________, math or English?
stemZh: 哪门学科更有趣，数学还是英语？
explanation: 两者比较用比较级more interesting。

stem: —Who is ________, Mary or Peter? —It's Mary, of course.
stemZh: ——谁更安静，玛丽还是彼得？——当然是玛丽。
explanation: 两者比较用比较级quieter。

stem: —I found some ________ between these two cities. —Yeah, it's quite amazing. Different places can have something in common.
stemZh: ——我发现这两座城市之间有一些相似之处。——是的，这很令人惊讶。不同的地方可以有共同之处。
explanation: differences表示“不同之处”，根据“Different places”可知。

stem: —If ________ people drive cars, there will be ________ air pollution. —I think so. I hope our environment will be better and better.
stemZh: ——如果开车的人越少，空气污染就越少。——我也这么认为。我希望我们的环境越来越好。
explanation: people是可数名词，用fewer修饰；pollution是不可数名词，用less修饰。

stem: Linda is as ________ as her mother, and they both like helping others.
stemZh: 琳达和她妈妈一样善良，她们都喜欢帮助别人。
explanation: as...as中间用原级kind。

stem: We'll try to do ________ work with ________ time than before.
stemZh: 我们将努力用更少的时间做更多的工作。
explanation: 根据句意，用更少的时间做更多的工作，more work with less time。

stem: If I don't talk ________, my grandmother can't hear me.
stemZh: 如果我不大声说话，我奶奶就听不到我说话。
explanation: 修饰动词talk用副词，根据"grandmother can't hear me"可知需要大声说话，用loudly。

stem: We can swim in the river. It is much ________ than before.
stemZh: 我们可以在河里游泳。它比以前干净多了。
explanation: than提示用比较级，much修饰比较级cleaner。

stem: —What does your friend look like? —________.
stemZh: ——你的朋友长什么样？——他又高又瘦。
explanation: What...look like询问外貌。

stem: The twin sisters are similar ________ each other.
stemZh: 这对双胞胎姐妹彼此相似。
explanation: be similar to表示与……相似。

stem: We have a lot ________ common.
stemZh: 我们有很多共同之处。
explanation: have...in common表示有……共同之处。

stem: Tom is ________ than his brother. He talks more.
stemZh: 汤姆比他哥哥更外向。他说得更多。
explanation: than提示用比较级，outgoing是多音节词，用more outgoing。

stem: Jack is good at playing the guitar and we all believe he can win the ________ of the music competition.
stemZh: 杰克擅长弹吉他，我们都相信他能在音乐比赛中获奖。
explanation: prize表示“奖品”，根据“win”和“music competition”可知。

stem: —________ is more outgoing, Tina or Tara? —Tina is.
stemZh: ——谁更外向，蒂娜还是塔拉？——蒂娜。
explanation: 询问谁更外向，用Who。

stem: —Who is ________ student in your class? —Lisa. She gets the highest scores every time.
stemZh: ——你们班谁是最聪明的学生？——丽莎。她每次都拿最高分。
explanation: in your class表示范围，用最高级the smartest。

stem: My deskmate is different ________ me, but we are good friends.
stemZh: 我的同桌和我不同，但我们是好朋友。
explanation: be different from表示与……不同。

stem: The harder you work, ________ grades you will get.
stemZh: 你越努力，你取得的成绩就越好。
explanation: the + 比较级，the + 比较级 结构。

stem: Travelling by train is slower than by plane. But it's ________ than by plane.
stemZh: 坐火车旅行比坐飞机慢。但它比坐飞机更有趣。
explanation: than提示用比较级，interesting是多音节词，用more interesting。

stem: My cousin is ________. He likes making friends with others.
stemZh: 我表弟很外向。他喜欢和别人交朋友。
explanation: outgoing表示"外向的"，根据"likes making friends with others"可知。

stem: City life is full of opportunities. Country life, however, is ________ and more peaceful.
stemZh: 城市生活充满机遇。然而，乡村生活更安静、更平和。
explanation: 与more peaceful并列，用比较级quieter。

stem: I think swimming is ________ dangerous than climbing mountains.
stemZh: 我认为游泳比爬山危险小。
explanation: than提示用比较级，little的比较级是less。

stem: She sings ________ than any other girl in the class.
stemZh: 她唱得比班上任何其他女孩都好。
explanation: than any other girl提示用比较级。

stem: The weather today is ________ than yesterday.
stemZh: 今天的天气比昨天更糟糕。
explanation: than提示用比较级，bad的比较级是worse。

stem: He is ________ taller than his brother.
stemZh: 他比他哥哥高得多。
explanation: much可以修饰比较级，表示……得多。

stem: Tina works as ________ as Anna.
stemZh: 蒂娜和安娜工作一样努力。
explanation: as...as中间用原级hard。

stem: —Thanks for helping me. —________.
stemZh: ——谢谢你帮我。——不客气。
explanation: No problem回答感谢，表示“不客气”。

stem: This book is interesting. That book is more interesting. That book is ________ than this one.
stemZh: 这本书很有趣。那本书更有趣。那本书比这本更有趣。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: —Is Tom as funny as his brother? —No, he is ________ than his brother.
stemZh: ——汤姆和他哥哥一样有趣吗？——不，他比他哥哥更有趣。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: This test is ________ than the last one.
stemZh: 这次考试比上次容易。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: The funny story made everyone ________ laugh out loud.
stemZh: 这个有趣的故事让每个人都大声笑了出来。
explanation: make sb. do sth.中不带to。

stem: Her ________ changed completely after she got a new haircut and wore a red skirt.
stemZh: 在她剪了新发型并穿上红裙子之后，她的外貌完全变了。
explanation: appearance表示外貌，根据new haircut and wore a red skirt可知。

stem: Today is ________ than yesterday.
stemZh: 今天比昨天更热。
explanation: than提示用比较级，hot双写t再加-er。

stem: Cindy is a ________ girl and she always feels nervous when speaking in public.
stemZh: 辛迪是一个害羞的女孩，她在公开场合讲话时总是感到紧张。
explanation: shy表示“害羞的”，根据“feels nervous when speaking in public”可知。

stem: —The food is delicious and the weather is quite fine. —Yes, this holiday is so great. We never had ________ before.
stemZh: ——食物很美味，天气也相当好。——是的，这个假期太棒了。我们从来没有过比这更好的假期。
explanation: 否定词never + 比较级a better one表示最高级含义，意为"从没度过比这更好的假期"。

stem: The weather in Guangzhou is ________ than that in Harbin in winter.
stemZh: 冬天广州的天气比哈尔滨暖和。
explanation: than提示用比较级warmer。

stem: "Beijing is the capital of China." is a(n) ________. "Life is getting better in some ways." is a(n) ________.
stemZh: “北京是中国的首都”是一个事实。“生活在某些方面变得更好”是一个观点。
explanation: 第一句是事实，第二句是观点。

stem: Mike swims fast. Jack swims faster. Jack swims ________ than Mike.
stemZh: 迈克游得快。杰克游得更快。杰克比迈克游得快。
explanation: 两者比较用比较级faster。

stem: Lily runs ________ than Lucy.
stemZh: 莉莉跑得比露西快。
explanation: than提示用比较级，fast的比较级是faster。

stem: —Are you relaxing yourself here? —Yes. It is ________ to walk along the river.
stemZh: ——你在这里放松吗？——是的。沿着河边散步很惬意。
explanation: fantastic表示"极好的"，根据"Yes"可知是令人愉快的体验。

stem: —Dad, my teacher said I did my homework ________ in our class. —Well done, Ted!
stemZh: ——爸爸，我老师说我在班上做作业最仔细。——干得好，特德！
explanation: 修饰动词did用副词，in our class表示范围，用最高级most carefully。

stem: Let's make full use of our ________ time and form a habit of learning English well.
stemZh: 让我们充分利用空闲时间，养成学好英语的习惯。
explanation: spare time表示“空闲时间”。

stem: She is good ________ English.
stemZh: 她擅长英语。
explanation: be good at表示“擅长”。

stem: —Do you love your parents? —Yes, of course. ________ in my life is more important than them.
stemZh: ——你爱你的父母吗？——是的，当然。在我生命中没有比他们更重要的了。
explanation: Nobody is more important than them表示"没有人比他们更重要"。

stem: West Lake to West Beauty, both are charming in light dress as well in bright. (欲把西湖比西子，淡妆浓抹总相宜。)
stemZh: 欲把西湖比西子，淡妆浓抹总相宜。
explanation: Comparing表示“比较”，将西湖比作西施。

stem: —I think friends should be the same. —________. I think friends should be different.
stemZh: ——我认为朋友应该是一样的。——我不同意。我认为朋友应该是不同的。
explanation: 根据I think friends should be different可知对方不同意。

stem: The Internet makes the world ________.
stemZh: 互联网使世界变得越来越小。
explanation: 比较级 + and + 比较级 表示越来越……。

stem: This question is ________ than that one.
stemZh: 这个问题比那个问题更简单。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: Mike works as ________ as his sister.
stemZh: 迈克和他姐姐工作一样仔细。
explanation: as...as中间用原级，修饰动词works用副词carefully。

stem: The more you smile, ________ you will feel.
stemZh: 你笑得越多，你就会感到越快乐。
explanation: the + 比较级，the + 比较级 结构。

stem: How lucky we are! We got home a few minutes early. The rain is ________ now.
stemZh: 我们多幸运啊！我们提前几分钟到家了。现在雨变小了。
explanation: 根据We got home a few minutes early可知雨变小了，lighter表示更小的。

stem: He is ________ than I am.
stemZh: 他比我强壮。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: The T-shirt is too small for me, so I need to ________ it for a larger size.
stemZh: 这件T恤对我来说太小了，所以我需要换一件大一点的。
explanation: exchange表示“交换”，根据“too small”和“for a larger size”可知。

stem: —Look! Cindy can't carry these bags to the fifth floor by herself. —Let's ________.
stemZh: ——看！辛迪一个人搬不动这些包到五楼。——让我们帮她一把吧。
explanation: lend sb. a hand表示“帮助某人”。

stem: His English is ________ better than mine.
stemZh: 他的英语比我的好得多。
explanation: much可以修饰比较级，表示“……得多”。

stem: A true friend will always ________ you when you are in trouble.
stemZh: 真正的朋友在你遇到困难时总会关心你。
explanation: care about表示“关心”。

stem: —Is your classroom ________ than ours? —Yes, it's much bigger.
stemZh: ——你们的教室比我们的大吗？——是的，大得多。
explanation: than提示用比较级bigger。

stem: The population of Beijing is ________ than that of Tianjin.
stemZh: 北京的人口比天津多。
explanation: than提示用比较级larger。

stem: Peter is 1.60m. Mark is 1.65m. Mark is ________ than Peter.
stemZh: 彼得身高1.60米。马克身高1.65米。马克比彼得高。
explanation: 两者比较用比较级taller。

stem: He is ________ than his friend.
stemZh: 他比他的朋友更细心。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: My deskmate's hobby is ________ mine.
stemZh: 我同桌的爱好和我的一样。
explanation: the same as表示和……一样。

stem: —How was your trip to the World Park? —It couldn't be ________. The weather was terrible and there was a lot of traffic on the way.
stemZh: ——你去世界公园的旅行怎么样？——再糟糕不过了。天气很糟糕，路上交通很拥堵。
explanation: couldn't be worse表示"再糟糕不过了"，用比较级表示最高级含义。

stem: This film is ________ than that one.
stemZh: 这部电影比那部好。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: —Is your sister as tall as you? —No, she is ________ than me.
stemZh: ——你妹妹和你一样高吗？——不，她比我矮。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: She is ________ than her sister, so she has more friends.
stemZh: 她比她姐姐更外向，所以她有更多朋友。
explanation: than提示用比较级，outgoing是多音节词，用more outgoing。

stem: This street is three times ________ than that one.
stemZh: 这条街比那条宽三倍。
explanation: 倍数 + 比较级 + than 结构。

stem: This book is ________ than that one, so I like it better.
stemZh: 这本书比那本更有趣，所以我更喜欢它。
explanation: than提示用比较级more interesting。

stem: —Thanks for helping me with my math homework. —________! It was really nothing.
stemZh: ——谢谢你帮我做数学作业。——不客气！真的没什么。
explanation: My pleasure表示“不客气”，回答感谢。

stem: —Is Tom as ________ as Sam? —Yes. They are both 1.72 meters tall.
stemZh: ——汤姆和萨姆一样高吗？——是的。他们都身高1.72米。
explanation: as...as中间用原级tall。

stem: I expect ________ my pen pal from Canada this summer vacation.
stemZh: 我期待今年暑假见到我来自加拿大的笔友。
explanation: expect to do sth.表示"期望做某事"。

stem: Someone says "Time is money". But I think time is ________ important than money.
stemZh: 有人说“时间就是金钱”。但我认为时间比金钱更重要。
explanation: than提示用比较级，even修饰比较级more important。

stem: Thanks ________ your help, we finished the project on time.
stemZh: 多亏了你的帮助，我们按时完成了项目。
explanation: thanks to表示“多亏了”。

stem: He was reading a story ________ to his little son when suddenly there was ________ noise outside the window.
stemZh: 他正在给儿子大声读故事，突然窗外传来一声巨响。
explanation: 第一空修饰read用aloud（出声地）；第二空修饰noise用loud（响亮的）。

stem: This box is ________ than that one.
stemZh: 这个箱子比那个重。
explanation: than提示用比较级，heavy变y为i再加-er。

stem: My friend is ________ than me, so she has more friends.
stemZh: 我的朋友比我更外向，所以她有更多朋友。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: He is ________ than his father.
stemZh: 他比他父亲高。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: —Mom, I got the first place in the English speech competition. —________! That's really good news, dear!
stemZh: ——妈妈，我在英语演讲比赛中得了第一名。——恭喜！这真是好消息，亲爱的！
explanation: Congratulations表示祝贺。

stem: He is good ________ children.
stemZh: 他很善于和孩子相处。
explanation: be good with表示“与……相处好”。

stem: Don't laugh. This is a(n) ________ question. Do you really want to leave your job?
stemZh: 别笑。这是一个严肃的问题。你真的想辞职吗？
explanation: serious表示“严肃的”，根据“Do you really want to leave your job”可知。

stem: —Why not ________ volleyball with us?
stemZh: ——为什么不和我们一起打排球呢？
explanation: Why not do sth.?表示“为什么不做某事？”，后接动词原形。

stem: —If you always ________ yourself with others, you may have tons of pressure. —I agree. We should believe in ourselves.
stemZh: ——如果你总是把自己和别人比较，你可能有很大的压力。——我同意。我们应该相信自己。
explanation: compare...with...表示“把……和……比较”。

stem: She is ________ than her sister.
stemZh: 她比她姐姐更受欢迎。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: The weather in Beijing in summer is ________ than that in Shanghai.
stemZh: 北京夏天的天气比上海凉爽得多。
explanation: than提示用比较级，much修饰比较级cooler。

stem: Martin is not ________ his father. He should learn from his father.
stemZh: 马丁不如他父亲有趣、外向。他应该向他父亲学习。
explanation: not as...as表示“不如……”。

stem: In Martin's class, he is taller than any other ________ and he runs faster than the other ________.
stemZh: 在马丁的班上，他比任何其他男孩都高，他跑得比其他学生都快。
explanation: any other后接单数名词boy；the other后接复数名词students。

stem: This apple is bigger ________ that pear.
stemZh: 这个苹果比那个梨大。
explanation: 比较级 + than 表示比……更……。

stem: He is ________ than his brother.
stemZh: 他比他哥哥年龄更大。
explanation: older表示“年龄更大”，elder通常只作定语，不能与than连用。

stem: —Good news! You passed the PE test. —Hooray! ________, I was worried about it because of my weight.
stemZh: ——好消息！你通过了体育测试。——万岁！说实话，我因为体重一直担心它。
explanation: To be honest表示"说实话"，根据"I was worried about it"可知。

stem: —Can you help me with this project? —________, and just let me know what I can do.
stemZh: ——你能帮我做这个项目吗？——乐意效劳，告诉我我能做什么。
explanation: With my pleasure表示“乐意效劳”。

stem: This book is not as ________ as that one.
stemZh: 这本书没有那本有趣。
explanation: not as...as中间用原级。

stem: Thanks ________ your help, I finished the work on time.
stemZh: 多亏了你的帮助，我按时完成了工作。
explanation: thanks to表示多亏了。

stem: My sister is as ________ as her classmate Joe.
stemZh: 我妹妹和她的同学乔一样高。
explanation: as...as中间用原级。

stem: My English teacher is as ________ as our math teacher, but she is ________ than him.
stemZh: 我的英语老师和我们数学老师一样友好，但她比他更友好。
explanation: 第一空as...as中间用原级friendly；第二空than提示用比较级friendlier。

stem: The blue pen is ________ cheaper.
stemZh: 蓝色钢笔稍微便宜一点。
explanation: a little可以修饰比较级，表示稍微。

stem: Lily runs ________ than Lucy, so she always wins the running race.
stemZh: 莉莉跑得比露西快，所以她总是赢得跑步比赛。
explanation: than提示用比较级faster。

stem: —Which is ________, the red one or the blue one? —The red one, I think.
stemZh: ——哪一个更漂亮，红色的还是蓝色的？——我认为是红色的。
explanation: 两者比较用比较级more beautiful。

stem: —Don't give up, Andy. ________ you work, ________ grades you will get. —Thanks a lot, Mr. Cook. I'll give it a try.
stemZh: ——不要放弃，安迪。你越努力，你取得的成绩就越好。——非常感谢，库克先生。我会试一试的。
explanation: the + 比较级，the + 比较级 表示越……越……。

stem: —I'm not sure about my future. —________. You are young and you have many chances.
stemZh: ——我对我的未来不确定。——别担心。你还年轻，你有很多机会。
explanation: Don't worry表示“别担心”。

stem: —Who runs ________ in your class? —Jack. He can run faster than any other student.
stemZh: ——你们班谁跑得最快？——杰克。他能跑得比任何其他学生都快。
explanation: in your class表示范围，用最高级fastest。

stem: —How does your teacher speak? —She speaks ________.
stemZh: ——你的老师怎么说话？——她说话既大声又缓慢。
explanation: 修饰动词speak用副词loudly和slowly。

stem: This room is ________ than that one.
stemZh: 这个房间比那个大。
explanation: than提示用比较级。

stem: I think playing basketball is ________ exciting than watching TV.
stemZh: 我认为打篮球比看电视更令人兴奋。
explanation: than提示用比较级more exciting。

stem: Lucy runs much faster than ________ in her class.
stemZh: 露西跑得比班上任何其他女孩都快得多。
explanation: than any other girl表示"比班里任何其他女孩都跑得快"，用比较级表达最高级含义。

stem: She has ________ money than her brother.
stemZh: 她的钱比她哥哥少。
explanation: than提示用比较级，little的比较级是less。

stem: Our teacher encourages us ________ it again.
stemZh: 我们老师鼓励我们再试一次。
explanation: encourage sb. to do sth.表示“鼓励某人做某事”。

stem: He is ________ of the two.
stemZh: 他是两个人中较好的一个。
explanation: of the two表示两者比较，用the + 比较级，表示“两者中较……的一个”。

stem: —Don't worry. I'll help you. —________.
stemZh: ——别担心。我会帮你的。——非常感谢。
explanation: Thanks a lot表示对对方的感谢。

stem: The more you read, ________ you will be.
stemZh: 你读得越多，你就会有越多的知识。
explanation: “the + 比较级，the + 比较级”结构。

stem: Before the Spring festival, ________ persons will come home to stay with their family.
stemZh: 春节前，越来越多的人会回家和家人待在一起。
explanation: "比较级 + and + 比较级"表示"越来越多"，more and more persons。

stem: The book is ________ of the two.
stemZh: 这本书是两本中较薄的那本。
explanation: of the two表示两者比较，用the + 比较级，表示"两者中较……的一个"。

stem: —Whose handwriting is better, yours or Lucy's? —Lucy's is much ________.
stemZh: ——谁的书法更好，你的还是露西的？——露西的好得多。
explanation: much修饰比较级better。

stem: —Why are there ________ birds in the sky and less clean water in the river? —Because of the pollution.
stemZh: ——为什么天空中的鸟更少，河里干净的水也更少？——因为污染。
explanation: birds是可数名词复数，用fewer修饰，表示“更少的”。

stem: —Why does this bag cost ________ than the other one? —Because it's on sale today.
stemZh: ——为什么这个包比另一个便宜？——因为它今天打折。
explanation: 根据on sale可知这个包更便宜，用less表示更少的钱。

stem: Linda has enough money, so she doesn't ________ the price of the dictionary.
stemZh: 琳达有足够的钱，所以她不关心字典的价格。
explanation: care about表示"关心"，根据"has enough money"可知不关心价格。

stem: —Thank you for your help. —________.
stemZh: ——谢谢你的帮助。——不客气。
explanation: No problem回答感谢。

stem: The boy is ________ than me.
stemZh: 这个男孩比我矮。
explanation: than提示用比较级shorter。

stem: My deskmate is different ________ me.
stemZh: 我的同桌和我不同。
explanation: be different from表示“与……不同”。

stem: The weather in winter in Changchun is much ________ than that in Guangzhou.
stemZh: 长春冬天的天气比广州冷得多。
explanation: than提示用比较级，much修饰比较级colder。

stem: —I think friends should be different. —________. I think friends should be the same.
stemZh: ——我认为朋友应该不同。——我不同意。我认为朋友应该一样。
explanation: 根据I think friends should be the same可知对方不同意。

stem: —Ms Miller is very ________ in our school. —Yes. Everyone can't wait to have her classes.
stemZh: ——米勒老师在我们学校非常受欢迎。——是的。每个人都迫不及待地想上她的课。
explanation: popular表示"受欢迎的"，根据"Everyone can't wait to have her classes"可知。

stem: Of all the girls, Lily has eaten ________ rice because she cares much about her weight.
stemZh: 在所有女孩中，莉莉吃的大米最少，因为她很在意自己的体重。
explanation: Of all the girls表示范围，用最高级the least。

stem: The cheetah runs very ________. It is one of the fastest land animals.
stemZh: 猎豹跑得非常快。它是最快的陆地动物之一。
explanation: 修饰动词runs用副词原级fast。

stem: The weather in Beijing is colder than ________ in Guangzhou.
stemZh: 北京的天气比广州冷。
explanation: 比较对象要一致，用that代替前面提到的weather。

stem: Healthy eating is important. It is best ________ your eating habits early!
stemZh: 健康饮食很重要。尽早改善你的饮食习惯是最好的！
explanation: It is best to do sth.是固定句型。

stem: We can use bamboo ________ houses and tools.
stemZh: 我们可以用竹子建造房屋和工具。
explanation: use sth. to do sth.表示"用某物做某事"。

stem: —This dress is too expensive. Do you have a cheaper one? —Sorry, but that's the ________ one.
stemZh: ——这件连衣裙太贵了。你们有便宜一点的吗？——抱歉，那是最便宜的一件了。
explanation: 根据"cheaper"可知询问更便宜的，回答是最便宜的那件，用cheapest。

stem: The ginkgo tree is one of ________ living trees on earth.
stemZh: 银杏树是地球上最古老的活树之一。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

stem: —Who sings ________ in your class? —Li Mei does. She has a beautiful voice.
stemZh: ——你们班谁唱歌最好？——李梅。她有一副好嗓子。
explanation: in your class表示范围，用最高级best。

stem: All living things ________ each other in nature.
stemZh: 自然界中所有生物都彼此相连。
explanation: be connected with表示"与……相连"。

stem: What makes us truly beautiful is not our appearance, but the ________ inside our hearts.
stemZh: 真正让我们美丽的不是我们的外表，而是我们内心的善良。
explanation: goodness表示"善良"。

stem: I went to Dali last week. It's one of ________ I have ever seen.
stemZh: 我上周去了大理。它是我见过的最美丽的地方之一。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。
keywords: one of the most beautiful places

stem: The ________ of the mountain is about 2,000 meters.
stemZh: 这座山的高度大约是2000米。
explanation: height表示"高度"，根据"about 2,000 meters"可知。

stem: Fishing is one of ________ activities among the middle-aged people.
stemZh: 钓鱼是中年人中最受欢迎的活动之一。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

stem: Lucy works ________ than her brother, but she is not ________ student in her class.
stemZh: 露西比她哥哥学习更努力，但她不是班上最努力的学生。
explanation: 第一空than提示用比较级harder；第二空in her class表示范围，用最高级the hardest。

stem: —Is Jay Chou ________ singer of all the singers? —Of course. He is my favorite.
stemZh: ——周杰伦是所有歌手中最受欢迎的吗？——当然。他是我最喜欢的。
explanation: of all the singers表示范围，用最高级the most popular。

stem: Giraffes have long necks that allow them to ________ the leaves on tall trees easily.
stemZh: 长颈鹿有长脖子，使它们能够轻松够到高树上的叶子。
explanation: reach表示"够到"。

stem: The Internet is closely ________ with our daily life. Can you imagine life without it?
stemZh: 互联网与我们的日常生活紧密相连。你能想象没有它的生活吗？
explanation: be connected with表示"与……相连"。

stem: Of all the animals, the cheetah runs ________.
stemZh: 在所有动物中，猎豹跑得最快。
explanation: Of all the animals表示范围，用最高级the fastest。

stem: Hua Tuo was one of ________ doctors in ancient China.
stemZh: 华佗是中国古代最伟大的医生之一。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词，表示"最……之一"。

stem: To save energy, our company chose this model because it uses ________ power among all computers.
stemZh: 为了节约能源，我们公司选择了这款型号，因为它在所有电脑中耗电最少。
explanation: among all computers表示范围，用最高级the least。

stem: Success is connected ________ hard work.
stemZh: 成功与努力相连。
explanation: be connected to表示"与……相连"。

stem: It was funny to find an olive ________ the grapes.
stemZh: 在一串葡萄中发现一颗橄榄很有趣。
explanation: among用于三者或三者以上之间，表示"在……之中"。

stem: Bamboo is one of ________ useful plants in the world.
stemZh: 竹子是世界上最有用的植物之一。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

stem: —Oh, no! I have to lose weight. The sweater doesn't fit me. Could you show me a ________ one?
stemZh: ——哦，不！我得减肥了。这件毛衣不适合我。你能给我看一件小一点的吗？
explanation: 根据"have to lose weight"可知需要更小的一件，用比较级smaller。

stem: This kind of plant ________ insects by closing its leaves quickly when they land on it.
stemZh: 这种植物在昆虫落到它上面时迅速合上叶子来捕捉昆虫。
explanation: catch表示"捕捉"，根据"closing its leaves quickly"可知。

stem: The weather in Beijing is much ________ than in Guangzhou in winter.
stemZh: 北京冬天的天气比广州冷得多。
explanation: than提示用比较级，much修饰colder。

stem: —What do you think of the movie about animals? —It's ________ one I have ever seen.
stemZh: ——你觉得这部关于动物的电影怎么样？——它是我看过的最有趣的一部。
explanation: I have ever seen表示范围，用最高级the most interesting。

stem: This is one of ________ parks in our city.
stemZh: 这是我们城市最美丽的公园之一。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

stem: —Do you know Shanghai is one of ________ in the world? —Yes, it's bigger than ________ city I know.
stemZh: ——你知道上海是世界上最大的城市之一吗？——是的，它比我认识的任何城市都大。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词；than any other city表示"比其他任何城市都大"。

stem: —Which mountain is ________, Mount Tai, Mount Huang or Mount Tianzi? —Mount Tianzi, I think.
stemZh: ——哪座山最高，泰山、黄山还是天子山？——我认为是天子山。
explanation: 三者比较用最高级the highest。

stem: Bamboo is one of the most popular ________ in many Chinese gardens.
stemZh: 竹子是中国许多园林中最受欢迎的植物之一。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

stem: The girl sitting ________ to you is one of my ________ friends.
stemZh: 坐在你旁边的那个女孩是我最亲密的朋友之一。
explanation: 第一空close to表示"靠近"；第二空one of my closest friends表示"我最亲密的朋友之一"。

stem: —Which is ________, the Yangtze River or the Yellow River? —The Yangtze River, of course. It is the ________ river in China.
stemZh: ——哪条河更长，长江还是黄河？——当然是长江。它是中国最长的河流。
explanation: 第一空两者比较用比较级longer；第二空in China表示范围，用最高级longest。

stem: The butterflies are still ________ after the cold winter. Now the forest is ________.
stemZh: 蝴蝶在寒冬之后仍然活着。现在森林充满生机。
explanation: 第一空表示"活着的"用alive；第二空表示"充满活力的"用lively。

stem: The boy is ________ to go to school.
stemZh: 这个男孩足够大了，能去上学。
explanation: old enough to do sth.表示"足够大能做某事"。

stem: —What's ________ animal in the world? —The blue whale. It can weigh up to 200 tons.
stemZh: ——世界上最大的动物是什么？——蓝鲸。它能重达200吨。
explanation: in the world表示范围，用最高级the heaviest。

stem: —Humans cannot live ________ animals or plants. —Right. They play an important part in the world.
stemZh: ——没有动物和植物人类无法生存。——对。它们在世界中发挥着重要作用。
explanation: without表示"没有"。

stem: The population of Beijing is ________ larger than ________ of Xi'an.
stemZh: 北京的人口比西安多得多。
explanation: 第一空much修饰比较级；第二空用that代替the population。

stem: There are many new inventions that make our life much ________ and more interesting.
stemZh: 有许多新发明使我们的生活更加轻松、更加有趣。
explanation: much修饰比较级easier。

stem: The Great Wall is one of the ________ in the world.
stemZh: 长城是世界上最伟大的奇迹之一。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

stem: —Could you tell me some facts about wild plants?
stemZh: ——你能告诉我一些关于野生植物的事实吗？——随便问我任何事。
options: Feel free to ask me anything.
explanation: Feel free to ask me anything表示"随便问我任何事"。

stem: China is over 5,000 years old. It's one of ________ countries in the world.
stemZh: 中国有5000多年的历史。它是世界上最古老的国家之一。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

stem: China is almost as ________ as the US, and it is the ________ country in Asia.
stemZh: 中国几乎和美国一样大，它是亚洲最大的国家。
explanation: 第一空as...as中间用原级big；第二空in Asia表示范围，用最高级biggest。

stem: —The apple pies here taste ________ than those from anywhere else. —Yes. But it will be better if they are less expensive.
stemZh: ——这里的苹果派比别处的味道好。——是的。但如果它们便宜一点就更好了。
explanation: than提示用比较级，根据"less expensive"可知前面说的是味道更好。

stem: Many pine trees can ________ hundreds of years.
stemZh: 许多松树能活几百年。
explanation: live up to表示"活到"。

stem: Who sings ________ in the group?
stemZh: 在这个小组中谁唱得最好？
explanation: in the group表示范围，用最高级best。

stem: Many animals ________ themselves by changing their colors to match the environment.
stemZh: 许多动物通过改变颜色来与环境匹配以隐藏自己。
explanation: hide表示"隐藏"。

stem: —I want to buy a shirt. But I have a little money. —The shirts here are all very cheap. And the yellow one is ________. Do you like it?
stemZh: ——我想买一件衬衫。但我只有一点钱。——这里的衬衫都很便宜。而且黄色那件是最便宜的。你喜欢吗？
explanation: 根据"all very cheap"可知黄色的是最便宜的，用the cheapest。

stem: How to connect this part ________ that part is a big problem.
stemZh: 如何把这部分和那部分连接起来是个大问题。
explanation: connect...with...表示"把……和……连接起来"。

stem: —Why is the blue whale important to the ocean? —Because when it dies, it becomes food for many sea animals and helps create a ________ ecosystem.
stemZh: ——为什么蓝鲸对海洋很重要？——因为当它死亡时，它成为许多海洋动物的食物，并帮助创造一个更有活力的生态系统。
explanation: 比较级more lively表示"更加充满活力的"。

stem: Many fruits can't grow well ________ bees' pollination.
stemZh: 没有蜜蜂授粉，许多水果无法良好生长。
explanation: without表示"没有"，根据"can't grow well"可知。

stem: —How do bees communicate with each other? —They use a special dance to tell others where the food is and how ________ it is.
stemZh: ——蜜蜂如何彼此交流？——它们用一种特殊的舞蹈告诉其他蜜蜂食物在哪里以及有多远。
explanation: how far表示"多远"。

stem: The two apples are both pretty. Please feel free ________ one of them.
stemZh: 这两个苹果都很漂亮。请随便选一个。
explanation: feel free to do sth.表示"可以随便做某事"。

stem: When seeing the Shenzhou-18 manned spaceship flying into the sky, my mother was ________ than any one of us.
stemZh: 看到神舟十八号载人飞船飞向天空时，我妈妈比我们任何人都激动。
explanation: than提示用比较级，修饰人用excited。

stem: —You seem ________ a lot about the zoo. —That's true. Because I visited it last week.
stemZh: ——你似乎对动物园了解很多。——没错。因为我上周参观过它。
explanation: seem to do sth.表示"似乎做某事"。

stem: —Kate, is Ma Long popular among young people? —Of course. I think I can't find a ________ table tennis player in China.
stemZh: ——凯特，马龙在年轻人中受欢迎吗？——当然。我认为在中国找不到一个更好的乒乓球运动员了。
explanation: 否定词can't + 比较级better表示最高级含义。

stem: The 2025 Harbin Asian Winter Games was one of ________ sports events in China this year.
stemZh: 2025年哈尔滨亚冬会是今年中国最受欢迎的体育赛事之一。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

stem: I'm sure ________ to college.
stemZh: 我一定会被大学录取。
explanation: be sure to do sth.表示"一定会做某事"。

stem: —How do you like The Chinese Poetry Competition on CCTV? —Wonderful! It's the ________ programme I've ever watched.
stemZh: ——你觉得央视的《中国诗词大会》怎么样？——太棒了！它是我看过的最好的节目。
explanation: I've ever watched表示范围，用最高级best。

stem: Elephants are ________ land animals in the world.
stemZh: 大象是世界上最大的陆地动物。
explanation: in the world表示范围，用最高级the biggest。

stem: My sister sings ________ in her class.
stemZh: 我妹妹在她班上唱歌最好听。
explanation: 修饰动词sings用副词，in her class表示范围，用最高级the most beautifully。

stem: —What do you think we should do to protect our earth? —We can start from small ________. For example, we can pick up litter in the park.
stemZh: ——你认为我们应该做什么来保护地球？——我们可以从小的行动开始。例如，我们可以在公园里捡垃圾。
explanation: actions表示"行动"，根据"pick up litter"可知。

stem: Paul loves animals, so he looks after Mary's pet dog ________ of all her friends.
stemZh: 保罗喜欢动物，所以在她所有朋友中他照顾玛丽的宠物狗最仔细。
explanation: 修饰动词looks after用副词，of all her friends表示范围，用最高级the most carefully。

stem: —Do you know ________ African elephant? —Yes. It's ________ huge animal living on grasslands.
stemZh: ——你知道那头非洲象吗？——知道。它是一种生活在草原上的巨大动物。
explanation: 第一空African以元音音素开头，用an；第二空huge以辅音音素开头，用a。

stem: Canada is the second ________ country of the world.
stemZh: 加拿大是世界第二大国。
explanation: 序数词 + 最高级，用the second largest。

stem: Your silly mistake let everyone down. (替换画线部分)
stemZh: 你愚蠢的错误让每个人失望。
explanation: let sb. down与make sb. disappointed意思相近，表示"让某人失望"。

stem: Of the four bags, this one is the ________.
stemZh: 在四个包中，这个是最重的。
explanation: Of the four bags表示四者比较，用最高级heaviest。

stem: —Which is ________, the sun, the moon or the earth? —The sun, of course.
stemZh: ——哪一个最大，太阳、月亮还是地球？——当然是太阳。
explanation: 三者比较用最高级the biggest。

stem: Emily likes Frozen and she thinks it's ________ of all cartoons.
stemZh: 艾米丽喜欢《冰雪奇缘》，她认为它是所有动画片中最有趣的。
explanation: of all cartoons表示范围，用最高级the most interesting。

stem: I think bamboo is ________ plant in the world.
stemZh: 我认为竹子是世界上最有用的植物。
explanation: in the world表示范围，用最高级the most useful。

stem: The umbrella will protect you ________ the rain.
stemZh: 雨伞会保护你不被雨淋。
explanation: protect...from...表示"保护……免受……"。

stem: —Who do you think will win the singing competition, Bob, Timo or Tom? —It must be Bob. I think he sings ________.
stemZh: ——你认为谁会赢得歌唱比赛，鲍勃、蒂莫还是汤姆？——一定是鲍勃。我认为他唱得最美妙。
explanation: 三者比较，修饰动词sings用副词最高级the most beautifully。

stem: I ________ believe he ________ speak three languages.
stemZh: 我不相信他会说三种语言。
explanation: 根据语境，我不相信他会说三种语言，用don't believe和can。

stem: Not all people realize the importance of ________ animals.
stemZh: 并非所有人都意识到保护动物的重要性。
explanation: protect表示"保护"。

stem: Jim runs ________ than Tony, but Frank runs ________ of them.
stemZh: 吉姆跑得比托尼快，但弗兰克是他们中跑得最快的。
explanation: 第一空than提示用比较级faster；第二空of them表示范围，用最高级fastest。

stem: I find it ________ that he passed the exam.
stemZh: 我发现他通过考试很令人惊讶。
explanation: find it + 形容词 + that从句，it是形式宾语，amazing表示"令人惊奇的"。

stem: Winter is the ________ season of the year in China.
stemZh: 冬天是中国一年中最冷的季节。
explanation: 根据常识，冬天是中国最冷的季节，用coldest。

stem: The new movie star is really popular. Yes, and he will ________ on the talk show this evening.
stemZh: 这位新电影明星真的很受欢迎。是的，他今晚会出现在脱口秀节目中。
explanation: appear表示"出现"。

stem: Which subject do you like ________, English, math or Chinese?
stemZh: 你最喜欢哪门学科，英语、数学还是语文？
explanation: 三者比较用最高级best。

stem: —What are you going to do this weekend? —I'm going to the library ________ find some information about my work.
stemZh: ——这个周末你打算做什么？——我打算去图书馆找一些关于我工作的信息。
explanation: in order to表示"为了"，引导目的状语。

stem: Playing phone games is ________ with many students, but don't spend too much time on it.
stemZh: 玩手机游戏受许多学生欢迎，但不要花太多时间在上面。
explanation: be popular with表示"受……欢迎"。

stem: It's impolite to drop ________ a friend's home ________ calling first in my country.
stemZh: 在我的国家，不先打电话就顺道拜访朋友家是不礼貌的。
explanation: drop by表示"顺道拜访"；without calling表示"没有打电话"。

stem: We should protect frogs because they help ________ insects and keep the ecosystem balanced.
stemZh: 我们应该保护青蛙，因为它们帮助吃昆虫并保持生态平衡。
explanation: help do sth.中不带to。

stem: CITI Tower in Beijing is probably one of ________ buildings in the whole world.
stemZh: 北京中信大厦可能是全世界最高的建筑之一。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

stem: Do you often communicate ________ English ________ your classmates?
stemZh: 你经常用英语和你的同学交流吗？
explanation: communicate in English表示"用英语交流"；communicate with sb.表示"与某人交流"。

stem: I failed the exam. What ________ news! I worried that my parents would be ________ at my grades.
stemZh: 我考试不及格。多么令人失望的消息！我担心我父母会对我的成绩感到失望。
optionsZh: 令人失望的；令人失望的
explanation: 第一空修饰物用disappointing；第二空修饰人用disappointed。

stem: We must give thanks to the teachers who ________ teach us knowledge and help us to grow.
stemZh: 我们必须感谢那些实际上教我们知识并帮助我们成长的老师。
explanation: actually表示"实际上"。

stem: The African elephant is the second ________ land animal in the world, just behind the Asian elephant.
stemZh: 非洲象是世界上第二大的陆地动物，仅次于亚洲象。
explanation: 序数词 + 最高级，用the second largest。

stem: Among all the schools in our city, this school gives students ________ weeks off for summer holiday, so its students have the shortest holiday.
stemZh: 在我们城市所有学校中，这所学校给学生放的暑假周数最少，所以它的学生假期最短。
explanation: 由后半句the shortest holiday可知放假周数最少，用最高级the fewest。

stem: My sister is interested in ________ all kinds of amazing plants and takes photos of them.
stemZh: 我妹妹对收集各种奇妙的植物感兴趣，并给它们拍照。
explanation: be interested in doing sth.中in是介词，后接动名词。

stem: —Judy, which place do you like staying better, in the city or in the countryside? —In the countryside. The air there is a lot ________ than that in the city.
stemZh: ——朱迪，你更喜欢待在哪里，城市还是乡村？——乡村。那里的空气比城市新鲜得多。
explanation: than提示用比较级fresher。

stem: There are already over two ________ workers in this factory, and ________ of young people still want to work in it.
stemZh: 这家工厂已经有两千多名工人，还有成千上万的年轻人仍想在这里工作。
explanation: 第一空具体数字后thousand用单数；第二空thousands of表示"成千上万的"。

stem: The report about rare plants is so ________ that I feel really ________.
stemZh: 关于珍稀植物的报告如此感人，以至于我真的感到很激动。
explanation: 第一空修饰物用moving；第二空修饰人用excited。

stem: —You mean that we'll work on the farm tomorrow. —________. That's what I'm trying to say.
stemZh: ——你的意思是我们明天要在农场工作。——正是如此。那就是我想说的。
explanation: Exactly表示"正是如此"，同意对方的说法。

stem: Among all the dresses you tried on, this is the ________ expensive one in our shop, and honestly, you look amazing ________ it.
stemZh: 在你试穿的所有连衣裙中，这是我们店里第二贵的，说实话，你穿它看起来很美。
explanation: the second most expensive表示"第二贵的"；in表示"穿着"。

stem: Mary cleans the shoes ________ in her family and a lot more carefully than her parents.
stemZh: 玛丽在家里擦鞋最仔细，比她父母仔细得多。
explanation: 修饰动词cleans用副词，in her family表示范围，用最高级the most carefully。

stem: —This story is not funny at all. —OK. Now I'll tell you ________ one.
stemZh: ——这个故事一点也不有趣。——好吧。现在我给你讲一个有趣得多的。
explanation: 两者比较用比较级，a much funnier one表示"一个有趣得多的"。

stem: —What do you think of the cheetah? —It's amazing! It runs ________ than any other land animal.
stemZh: ——你觉得猎豹怎么样？——太神奇了！它跑得比任何其他陆地动物都快。
explanation: than any other land animal提示用比较级faster。

stem: Tony likes swimming and he thinks it's ________ of all sports.
stemZh: 托尼喜欢游泳，他认为它是所有运动中最令人放松的。
explanation: of all sports表示范围，用最高级the most relaxing。

stem: Julie sings ________ of the three.
stemZh: 朱莉是三个人中唱得最美妙的。
explanation: 修饰动词sings用副词，of the three表示范围，用最高级the most beautifully。

stem: Our city is becoming ________.
stemZh: 我们的城市变得越来越美丽。
explanation: "比较级 + and + 比较级"表示"越来越……"。

stem: Pandas are one of ________ animals in the world. Many people like them.
stemZh: 熊猫是世界上最可爱的动物之一。许多人喜欢它们。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

stem: —Why do birds fly to the south in winter? —Because they want to ________ the cold weather.
stemZh: ——为什么鸟儿在冬天飞往南方？——因为它们想逃离寒冷的天气。
explanation: run away from表示"逃离"。

stem: DeepSeek is a ________ AI tool. I ________ it to help me finish my homework yesterday.
stemZh: DeepSeek是一个有用的AI工具。我昨天用它帮我完成作业。
explanation: 第一空根据语境用useful；第二空yesterday提示用一般过去时used。

stem: —Did you visit the Bamboo Sea in Sichuan? —Yes. It's ________ bamboo forest in China and I learnt a lot there.
stemZh: ——你参观过四川的竹海吗？——是的。它是中国最大的竹林，我在那里学到了很多。
explanation: in China表示范围，用最高级the largest。

stem: Friendship requires ________, especially when our friends' ideas are different from ours.
stemZh: 友谊需要沟通，尤其是当朋友的想法与我们的不同时。
explanation: communication表示"沟通"。

stem: ________ people live in this big city.
stemZh: 数百万人住在这个大城市里。
explanation: millions of表示"数百万的"。

stem: —It seems that you're ________ in the book. —Yes, I can learn many facts about nature from it.
stemZh: ——你似乎对这本书感兴趣。——是的，我可以从中学到许多关于自然的事实。
explanation: 第一空be interested in表示"对……感兴趣"；第二空修饰物用interesting。

stem: The teacher ________ us ________ harder.
stemZh: 老师希望我们更努力学习。
explanation: wish sb. to do sth.表示"希望某人做某事"；hope不能接sb. to do sth.。

stem: English is used ________ talking with others ________ a second language by travellers and business people all over the world.
stemZh: 英语被全世界的旅行者和商务人士用作第二语言来与他人交谈。
explanation: 第一空be used for doing sth.表示"被用于做某事"；第二空as表示"作为"。

stem: The air is ________ polluted so each of us should ________ in the environmental protection.
stemZh: 空气被严重污染，所以我们每个人都应该在环境保护中发挥作用。
explanation: 第一空badly表示"严重地"；第二空play a part表示"发挥作用"。

stem: —Your parents always say you are excellent. Can you ________ their praise? —I'll try my best. I don't want to let them down.
stemZh: ——你父母总是说你很优秀。你能不辜负他们的赞扬吗？——我会尽力的。我不想让他们失望。
explanation: live up to表示"不辜负"，根据"I don't want to let them down"可知。

stem: Bamboo is ________ for building houses.
stemZh: 竹子被用于建造房屋。
explanation: be used for表示"被用于"。

stem: Many animals are in ________ because of the pollution.
stemZh: 由于污染，许多动物处于危险中。
explanation: in danger表示"处于危险中"。

stem: —Did you see the TV series called She and Her Girls last night? —Yes, it's so great. I have never seen a ________ one.
stemZh: ——你昨晚看《山花烂漫时》这部电视剧了吗？——是的，太棒了。我从没看过比这更好的。
explanation: 否定词never + 比较级better表示最高级含义。

stem: Koalas are ________ for sleeping up to 20 hours a day in the eucalyptus trees.
stemZh: 考拉因每天在桉树上睡长达20个小时而闻名。
explanation: be famous for表示"因……而闻名"。

stem: —Whose home is ________ from school in your class?
stemZh: ——你们班谁家离学校最远？
explanation: in your class表示范围，用最高级the farthest。

stem: ________ a party member, I must be strict with myself.
stemZh: 作为一名党员，我必须严格要求自己。
explanation: as表示"作为"。

stem: Ma Yun, the head of Alibaba, is one of ________ people in the world.
stemZh: 马云，阿里巴巴的负责人，是世界上最富有的人之一。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

stem: I studied so hard, but I didn't pass the exam. Oh no! That's too bad. You must be really ________.
stemZh: 我学习那么努力，但我没有通过考试。哦不！太糟糕了。你一定很失望。
explanation: disappointed表示"失望的"。

stem: —Our classroom is so dirty. Shall we clean it this afternoon or tomorrow? —________. Any time is OK.
stemZh: ——我们的教室太脏了。我们下午打扫还是明天打扫？——由你决定。任何时间都行。
explanation: It's up to you表示"由你决定"。

stem: This kind of plant grows ________ in our country. You can see it everywhere.
stemZh: 这种植物在我们国家生长得很好。你到处都能看到它。
explanation: 修饰动词grows用副词well。

stem: —Why do pandas love bamboo so much? —Because it's their favourite food and it ________ quickly, so there's plenty for them to eat.
stemZh: ——为什么熊猫那么喜欢竹子？——因为它是它们最喜欢的食物，而且它生长得很快，所以有足够的竹子给它们吃。
explanation: 根据"so there's plenty for them to eat"可知用一般现在时。

stem: We should play a role ________ helping the old and caring ________ the young.
stemZh: 我们应该在帮助老人和关心年轻人方面发挥作用。
explanation: play a role in表示"在……中发挥作用"；care about表示"关心"。

stem: Which underlined sound is different?
stemZh: 下列哪个划线部分的发音不同？
explanation: title中的i发音为/aɪ/，其他三个发音为/ɪ/。

stem: The blue whale is ________ animal on the earth.
stemZh: 蓝鲸是地球上最大的动物。
explanation: on the earth表示范围，用最高级the largest。

stem: ________ runs the fastest, Jim, Tim or Julie?
stemZh: 谁跑得最快，吉姆、蒂姆还是朱莉？
explanation: 询问"谁"跑得最快，用Who。

stem: —Which game do you like to watch better, football or baseball? —Football. I think it's ________.
stemZh: ——你更喜欢看哪场比赛，足球还是棒球？——足球。我认为它更令人兴奋。
explanation: 两者比较用比较级more exciting。

stem: All of us were ________ when we watched the ________ match.
stemZh: 当我们观看这场令人失望的比赛时，我们所有人都感到失望。
optionsZh: 令人失望的，令人失望的
explanation: 第一空修饰人用disappointed；第二空修饰物用disappointing。

stem: Which is ________, the first, second or third tree?
stemZh: 哪棵树最高，第一棵、第二棵还是第三棵？
explanation: 三者比较用最高级the tallest。

stem: This is ________ oldest tree in our city.
stemZh: 这是我们城市最古老的树。
explanation: 最高级前加定冠词the。

stem: —Which is ________ season in your hometown? —Summer.
stemZh: ——你家乡最热的季节是哪个？——夏天。
explanation: in your hometown表示范围，用最高级the hottest。

stem: This is ________ book in our library.
stemZh: 这是我们图书馆最有用的书。
explanation: in our library表示范围，用最高级the most useful。

stem: —Thank you, Mum. Whenever I meet trouble, you will ________ to help me. —Because you are my dearest baby.
stemZh: ——谢谢你，妈妈。每当我遇到困难，你都会出现来帮我。——因为你是我最亲爱的宝贝。
explanation: appear表示"出现"，每当遇到困难时妈妈总会出现在我身边帮助我。

stem: —You look so tired. What's wrong? —I ________ late last night to finish my homework.
stemZh: ——你看起来很累。怎么了？——我昨晚熬夜完成作业。
explanation: stay up late表示"熬夜到很晚"。

stem: Can you imagine ________ deep into the rainforest to study flowers?
stemZh: 你能想象深入雨林研究花卉吗？
explanation: imagine doing sth.表示"想象做某事"。

stem: I heard your team lost the basketball game yesterday. That's too bad. Well, ________, we didn't lose. We won!
stemZh: 我听说你们队昨天输了篮球比赛。太糟糕了。嗯，实际上，我们没输。我们赢了！
explanation: actually表示"实际上"。

stem: —What kind of person do you expect ________? —The one who can sing ________ in our school. I really love to sing.
stemZh: ——你期望成为什么样的人？——我们学校唱歌最美妙的那个人。我真的很喜欢唱歌。
explanation: 第一空expect to do sth.；第二空修饰动词sing用副词最高级most beautifully。

stem: Bees are very important to our ecosystem. ________ them, many plants can't grow.
stemZh: 蜜蜂对我们的生态系统非常重要。没有它们，许多植物无法生长。
explanation: Without表示"没有"。

stem: —Which do you like ________, fish, birds or dogs? —I like dogs best.
stemZh: ——你最喜欢哪一个，鱼、鸟还是狗？——我最喜欢狗。
explanation: 三者比较用最高级best。

stem: The ginkgo tree is one of the most ancient living ________ on earth.
stemZh: 银杏树是地球上最古老的活树之一。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词，用trees。

stem: —Why didn't Mr. Wu choose Jack to do the class project? —Because he always does things ________ in his class.
stemZh: ——为什么吴老师没有选杰克做班级项目？——因为他总是班上做事最不仔细的。
explanation: 根据"Why didn't Mr. Wu choose Jack"可知他做事最不认真，用the least carefully。

stem: Of all the seats on the high speed train, the ones by the windows are the ________.
stemZh: 在高铁上所有的座位中，靠窗的座位是最舒适的。
explanation: Of all the seats表示范围，用最高级most comfortable。

stem: ________ their work, about 80 per cent of the plants cannot grow.
stemZh: 没有它们的工作，大约80%的植物无法生长。
explanation: Without表示"没有"。

stem: Most birds fly south in winter ________ the snowy owl.
stemZh: 大多数鸟在冬天飞往南方，除了雪鸮。
explanation: except表示"除……之外（不包括）"。

stem: Nowadays museums are becoming more popular ________ people want to learn more about culture and history.
stemZh: 如今博物馆越来越受欢迎，因为人们想更多地了解文化和历史。
explanation: as引导原因状语从句。

stem: ________ make her dream come true, she worked day and night.
stemZh: 为了实现她的梦想，她日夜工作。
explanation: In order to表示"为了"，引导目的状语。

stem: The cactus can store a large amount of water in its thick stem to survive in the desert.
stemZh: 仙人掌能在其粗壮的茎中储存大量水分以在沙漠中生存。
explanation: cactus表示"仙人掌"，能在沙漠中储存大量水分。

stem: Among all the students, Tom studies ________.
stemZh: 在所有学生中，汤姆学习最努力。
explanation: Among all the students表示范围，用最高级。副词最高级前the可省略。

stem: The little boy was so excited when he ________ a rare bird in the forest last weekend.
stemZh: 上周末那个小男孩在森林里发现一只稀有鸟类时非常兴奋。
explanation: last weekend提示用一般过去时found。

stem: I'll have trouble ________ the math problem ________ your help.
stemZh: 没有你的帮助，我解这道数学题会有困难。
explanation: have trouble doing sth.表示"做某事有困难"；without your help表示"没有你的帮助"。

stem: The redwood tree is ________ tree in the world.
stemZh: 红杉是世界上最高的树。
explanation: in the world表示范围，用最高级the tallest。

stem: —What's the ________ of the elephant? —About two tons.
stemZh: ——这头大象的重量是多少？——大约两吨。
explanation: weight表示"重量"，根据"About two tons"可知。

stem: He is ________ student in our class.
stemZh: 他是我们班最高的学生。
explanation: in our class表示范围，用最高级the tallest。

stem: Computers play an important ________ in our daily life. We can't live without them.
stemZh: 电脑在我们的日常生活中发挥着重要作用。没有它们我们无法生活。
explanation: play an important role in表示"在……中发挥重要作用"。

stem: —Kitty, how much do you know about The Book of Songs? —It is the ________ collection of poems in China and the beginning of China's poetry tradition.
stemZh: ——基蒂，你对《诗经》了解多少？——它是中国最早的诗集，是中国诗歌传统的开端。
explanation: in China表示范围，用最高级earliest。

stem: Which animal jumps ________, the lion, the monkey or the tree frog?
stemZh: 哪种动物跳得最高，狮子、猴子还是树蛙？
explanation: 三者比较用最高级the highest。

stem: —How often do you go skating? —Never. ________, I can't skate at all.
stemZh: ——你多久去滑一次冰？——从不。实际上，我根本不会滑冰。
explanation: Actually表示"实际上"，根据"I can't skate at all"可知。

stem: —Do you think Mike is the ________ in our class? —No. Dave is ________ than him.
stemZh: ——你认为迈克是我们班最高的吗？——不。戴夫比他高。
explanation: 第一空in our class表示范围，用最高级tallest；第二空than提示用比较级taller。

stem: —Is Jack one of ________ runners in your class? —Of course! And he runs much ________ than me.
stemZh: ——杰克是你们班跑得最快的之一吗？——当然！而且他跑得比我快得多。
explanation: 第一空one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词；第二空than提示用比较级faster。

stem: Who will go to the cinema tonight? Everyone in our class will go there ________ Frank. He is ill at home.
stemZh: 今晚谁去看电影？我们班除了弗兰克之外每个人都会去那里。他在家生病了。
explanation: except表示"除……之外（不包括）"。

stem: The little monkey ________ only 1 kilo at birth. Now we know its ________ is 12 kilos.
stemZh: 这只小猴子出生时只有1公斤。现在我们知道它的重量是12公斤。
explanation: 第一空用过去式weighed；第二空用名词weight。

stem: —Wang Lin did ________ in the final exam this term again. —That's not strange. He always gets full marks in all of his subjects.
stemZh: ——王林这学期期末考试又考得最好。——不奇怪。他所有科目总是得满分。
explanation: 根据"gets full marks"可知他考得最好，用best。

stem: ________ get lost in the forest, we'd better take a compass with us.
stemZh: 为了不在森林中迷路，我们最好带一个指南针。
explanation: in order not to do sth.表示"为了不做某事"。

stem: Wild pandas feed ________ fresh bamboo.
stemZh: 野生熊猫以新鲜竹子为食。
explanation: feed on表示"以……为食"。

stem: —Your friend Jeff is good at telling jokes. —Yes. He is ________ person I know.
stemZh: ——你的朋友杰夫擅长讲笑话。——是的。他是我认识的最有趣的人。
explanation: I know表示范围，用最高级the funniest。

stem: Basketball is so popular a game in the world and ________ people play it for fun and exercise.
stemZh: 篮球是世界上如此受欢迎的一项运动，数百万的人为了娱乐和锻炼而打篮球。
explanation: millions of表示"数百万的"。

stem: The guide told us that this kind of flower ________ only at night.
stemZh: 导游告诉我们这种花只在夜间开放。
explanation: 宾语从句表示客观事实，用一般现在时。

stem: If someone is against your idea, it's wise to communicate ________ him.
stemZh: 如果有人反对你的想法，和他沟通是明智的。
explanation: communicate with sb.表示"与某人交流"。

stem: —Look! I think this clear river is the second ________ river in our area. —Yes, you're right.
stemZh: ——看！我认为这条清澈的河是我们地区第二长的河。——是的，你说得对。
explanation: 序数词 + 最高级，用the second longest。

stem: The ________ of the tree is very thick.
stemZh: 这棵树的树干很粗。
explanation: trunk表示"树干"，根据"very thick"可知。

stem: The elephant birds were ________ birds ever on the earth.
stemZh: 象鸟是地球上有史以来最大的鸟。
explanation: ever表示范围，用最高级the largest。

stem: The rose is one of ________ flowers in our daily life.
stemZh: 玫瑰是我们日常生活中最有用的花之一。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

stem: It's important for us to ________ wild animals instead of hunting them for money.
stemZh: 对我们来说，关心野生动物而不是为了钱猎杀它们很重要。
explanation: care for表示"关心、照顾"。

stem: I like doing sports. I think swimming is ________ than skiing.
stemZh: 我喜欢运动。我认为游泳比滑雪容易。
explanation: than提示用比较级easier。

stem: The ________ of the baby elephant is about 200 kilos.
stemZh: 这只小象的重量大约是200公斤。
explanation: weight表示"重量"，根据"about 200 kilos"可知。

stem: Some sea animals have special lights on their bodies to ________ in the dark deep sea.
stemZh: 一些海洋动物身体上有特殊的灯光，用于在黑暗的深海中捕猎食物。
explanation: hunt food表示"捕猎食物"，根据"special lights"可知。

stem: —Which subject is ________, Chinese, math or English? —It's hard to say.
stemZh: ——哪门学科最重要，语文、数学还是英语？——很难说。
explanation: 三者比较用最高级the most important。

stem: These birds always ________ in warm weather. So you can see them in early summer.
stemZh: 这些鸟总是在温暖的天气出现。所以你可以在初夏看到它们。
explanation: appear表示"出现"，根据"you can see them in early summer"可知。

stem: English is used ________ talking with people from other countries.
stemZh: 英语被用于与来自其他国家的人交谈。
explanation: be used for doing sth.表示"被用于做某事"。

stem: —Of the three boys, Jim is ________ one. —Yes, he is shorter than Tom and me.
stemZh: ——在三个男孩中，吉姆是最矮的一个。——是的，他比汤姆和我都矮。
explanation: Of the three boys表示三者比较，用最高级the shortest。

stem: To save the earth, we'd better use less water and plant ________ trees.
stemZh: 为了拯救地球，我们最好少用水，多种树。
