explanation: 根据语境，应该种更多的树，用more。

stem: The Amazon rainforest ________ thousands of kinds of plants and animals.
stemZh: 亚马逊雨林充满了数千种动植物。
explanation: be full of表示"充满"。

stem: The fans ________ bamboo look very beautiful.
stemZh: 由竹子制成的扇子看起来非常漂亮。
explanation: be made of表示"由……制成"，能看出原材料。

stem: Jenny became ________ girl in her class in Grade Six.
stemZh: 珍妮在六年级时成为她班上最高的女孩。
explanation: in her class表示范围，用最高级the tallest。

stem: We should protect bees ________ they are very important to our life.
stemZh: 我们应该保护蜜蜂，因为它们对我们的生活非常重要。
explanation: because引导原因状语从句。

stem: I can't imagine my life ________ my pets.
stemZh: 我无法想象没有宠物的生活。
explanation: without表示"没有"。

stem: The panda ________ 100 grams at birth. But now the ________ of it is 100 kilograms.
stemZh: 熊猫出生时重100克。但现在它的重量是100公斤。
explanation: 第一空用动词weighs；第二空用名词weight。

stem: The flowers in the garden smell so ________.
stemZh: 花园里的花闻起来很香。
explanation: smell是系动词，后接形容词nice。

stem: The Yangtze River is one of ________ rivers in the world.
stemZh: 长江是世界上最长的河流之一。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

stem: The panda is one of the ________ of China.
stemZh: 熊猫是中国的象征之一。
explanation: one of the + 复数名词，用symbols。

stem: They seem ________ a good time at the party.
stemZh: 他们似乎在聚会上玩得很开心。
explanation: seem to do sth.表示"似乎做某事"。

stem: —The new movie star is really popular. —Yes, and he will ________ on the talk show this evening.
stemZh: ——这位新电影明星真的很受欢迎。——是的，他今晚会出现在脱口秀节目中。
explanation: appear表示"出现"。

stem: Jim is talented in drawing. He draws ________ in his family.
stemZh: 吉姆在绘画方面有天赋。他在家里画得最美。
explanation: 修饰动词draws用副词，in his family表示范围，用最高级the most beautifully。

stem: Hard work ________ achieving success.
stemZh: 努力在取得成功中发挥重要作用。
explanation: play a big role in表示"在……中发挥重要作用"。

stem: The Fuxing high-speed train is one of ________ trains in the world.
stemZh: 复兴号高铁是世界上最现代化的列车之一。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

stem: —China is one of ________ countries in the world. —Yes. It has much ________ history than the US.
stemZh: ——中国是世界上最古老的国家之一。——是的。它的历史比美国长得多。
explanation: 第一空one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词；第二空than提示用比较级longer。

stem: It is important ________ students ________ part in outdoor activities.
stemZh: 对学生来说，参加户外活动很重要。
explanation: It is important for sb. to do sth.是固定句型。
keywords: it is important for sb. to do

stem: I don't agree ________ you. I think he has something to do ________ it.
stemZh: 我不同意你。我认为他与此事有关。
explanation: agree with sb.表示"同意某人"；have something to do with表示"与……有关"。

stem: The elephant is much ________ than the panda.
stemZh: 大象比熊猫大得多。
explanation: than提示用比较级，much修饰bigger。

stem: The local government has built a nature reserve to provide a safe ________ for wild animals.
stemZh: 当地政府建立了一个自然保护区，为野生动物提供安全的栖息地。
explanation: habitat表示"栖息地"。

stem: Chinese is one of ________ in the world. As Chinese students, we should learn it well.
stemZh: 汉语是世界上最古老的语言之一。作为中国学生，我们应该学好它。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词，old的最高级是oldest。

stem: —Can I use your color pencils? —Sure, feel free ________ them. I'm not using them now.
stemZh: ——我可以用你的彩笔吗？——当然，随便用。我现在不用它们。
explanation: feel free to do sth.表示"可以随便做某事"。

stem: Amy works ________ of all the children.
stemZh: 艾米是所有孩子中工作最努力的。
explanation: of all the children表示范围，用最高级hardest。

stem: Please keep as ________ as possible while watching birds, as noise will make them afraid and fly away.
stemZh: 观鸟时请尽可能保持安静，因为噪音会使它们害怕并飞走。
explanation: as...as中间用原级quiet。

stem: They are ________ a new car.
stemZh: 他们对买新车感兴趣。
explanation: be interested in doing sth.表示"对做某事感兴趣"。

stem: The two pictures look almost ________. I can't find any differences.
stemZh: 这两幅画看起来几乎一样。我找不到任何不同。
explanation: look the same表示"看起来一样"。

stem: Michael was late for school ________ he missed the school bus.
stemZh: 迈克尔上学迟到了，因为他错过了校车。
explanation: as引导原因状语从句，表示"因为"。

stem: —Which notebook do you want to buy? —I will pick the black one, because it's three times ________ than the others.
stemZh: ——你想买哪本笔记本？——我会选黑色的，因为它比其他几本便宜三倍。
explanation: 倍数 + 比较级 + than 结构。

stem: The harder you study, ________ results you will get.
stemZh: 你学习越努力，你取得的结果就越好。
explanation: "the + 比较级，the + 比较级"结构。

stem: English is a useful ________ to introduce Chinese culture to the world.
stemZh: 英语是向世界介绍中国文化的有用工具。
explanation: tool表示"工具"，英语是向世界介绍中国文化的有用工具。

stem: I ________ a lot of interesting things when I was there.
stemZh: 我在那里时学到了很多有趣的东西。
explanation: when I was there提示用一般过去时learnt。

stem: For him, a space camp is ________ than any other camp in the world.
stemZh: 对他来说，太空营比世界上任何其他营都棒。
explanation: than any other camp提示用比较级greater。

stem: Shanghai is one of ________ cities in China. Lots of visitors come here every year.
stemZh: 上海是中国最大的城市之一。每年许多游客来这里。
explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

stem: The room was so crowded that there was ________ air to ________.
stemZh: 房间太拥挤了，以至于几乎没有空气可以呼吸。
explanation: air是不可数名词，用little修饰；breathe是动词，表示“呼吸”。

stem: —Our class won the first prize in the basketball game. —What ________ exciting news!
stemZh: ——我们班在篮球比赛中获得了一等奖。——多么令人兴奋的消息啊！
explanation: news是不可数名词，用What + 形容词 + 不可数名词，不加冠词。

stem: To make dumplings, we need to prepare the filling and the dough as the main ________ first.
stemZh: 为了包饺子，我们需要先准备好馅料和面团作为主要原料。
explanation: ingredients表示“原料”，制作饺子的主要原料是馅料和面团。

stem: — How can I make the color purple? — It's easy. Just ________ red ________ blue.
stemZh: ——我怎样才能调出紫色？——很简单。只要把红色和蓝色混合在一起。
explanation: mix...with...表示“把……和……混合”。

stem: I'd like three ________ of ________.
stemZh: 我想要三公斤面包。
explanation: three kilos of bread表示“三公斤面包”，bread是不可数名词，不加-s。

stem: What ________ it is to go swimming in ________ weather!
stemZh: 在这么好的天气里游泳真是太有趣了！
options: a great fun; such a fine
optionsZh: 极大的乐趣；这么好的一个
一个极大的乐趣；这么好的
一个极大的乐趣；这么好的一个
explanation: 第一空fun是不可数名词，用great fun；第二空weather是不可数名词，用such fine。

stem: Your room is in a ______. You need to clean it up before Grandma comes.
stemZh: 你的房间乱七八糟的。奶奶来之前你需要打扫干净。
explanation: in a mess表示“乱七八糟”，与需要打扫的语境相符。

stem: We need 200 ________ of flour to make the bread.
stemZh: 我们需要200克面粉来做面包。
explanation: 200 grams of flour表示“200克面粉”，数词后接可数名词复数grams。

stem: I found a _____ of socks in the bedroom, but they didn't make a __________.
stemZh: 我在卧室里发现了一双袜子，但它们不成对。
explanation: a pair of socks表示“一双袜子”；make a couple表示“成为一对”。

stem: We need ________ water for the plants.
stemZh: 我们需要很多水来浇植物。
explanation: water是不可数名词，用much修饰；many修饰可数名词复数。

stem: —How much ________ do you need —Two spoons.
stemZh: ——你需要多少蜂蜜？——两勺。
explanation: How much提问不可数名词的量，honey是不可数名词。

stem: ________ honest the boy was! All the students told a lie ________ him.
stemZh: 这个男孩多么诚实啊！除了他之外，所有学生都撒谎了。
explanation: 第一空中心词是形容词honest，用How；第二空except表示“除……之外（不包括）”。

stem: ________ nice pumpkin pie it is!
stemZh: 这是多么美味的南瓜派啊！
explanation: pie是可数名词单数，nice以辅音音素开头，用What a。

stem: Mary and Meimei would like mushrooms, ________ and ________ on their pizza.
stemZh: 玛丽和梅梅想在披萨上放蘑菇、西红柿和奶酪。
explanation: tomato的复数是tomatoes；cheese是不可数名词，不加-s。

stem: The teacher gave us ________.
stemZh: 老师给了我们一些建议。
explanation: advice是不可数名词，some advice表示“一些建议”，没有复数形式。

stem: The tourist with great ________ had several exciting ________ during his visit to Africa.
stemZh: 这位有着丰富经验的游客在非洲之行中有几次激动人心的经历。
explanation: 第一空experience作“经验”讲，不可数；第二空several修饰可数名词复数experiences。

stem: We have ________ for lunch.
stemZh: 我们午餐吃两片面包。
explanation: bread是不可数名词，two pieces of bread表示“两片面包”。

stem: Finding information is not hard today, but the ____ is how we can tell whether the information is true or not.
stemZh: 如今找到信息并不难，但挑战在于我们如何分辨信息是否真实。
explanation: challenge表示“挑战”，分辨信息真假是一个挑战。

stem: —How many ________ can you see in the picture —Ten.
stemZh: ——你能在图片中看到多少个西红柿？——十个。
explanation: How many后接可数名词复数，tomato的复数是tomatoes。

stem: —Could you please ________ the tomatoes into small pieces We need them for the soup. —Sure.
stemZh: ——你能把西红柿切成小块吗？我们做汤需要。——当然。
explanation: cut up表示“切碎”，符合把西红柿切成小块的语境。

stem: —Good evening, madam. Need any help —Sure. I'd like a big ________ of beef noodles with some vegetables. Maybe some cabbage
stemZh: ——晚上好，女士。需要帮忙吗？——当然。我想要一大碗牛肉面，加些蔬菜。也许来点卷心菜。
explanation: a bowl of beef noodles表示“一碗牛肉面”。

stem: ________ beautiful flowers they are!
stemZh: 它们是多么美丽的花啊！
explanation: flowers是复数名词，用What引导感叹句。

stem: Look! There is a small ________ in the middle of the lake.
stemZh: 看！湖中央有一个小岛。
explanation: island表示“岛屿”，在湖中央。

stem: The ______ of the cake is thin and crispy, just like I like it.
stemZh: 蛋糕的外壳又薄又脆，正是我喜欢的样子。
explanation: crust表示“外壳”，蛋糕外壳薄而脆。

stem: ________ wonderful the music sounds!
stemZh: 这音乐听起来多么美妙啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词wonderful，用How引导感叹句。

stem: My classmate likes to collect____ of new words he looks up.
stemZh: 我的同学喜欢收集他查阅的生词笔记。
explanation: notes of new words表示“单词笔记”，与查阅生词的语境相符。

stem: I'm hungry after playing basketball. I'd like two ________ of beef ________.
stemZh: 打完篮球后我饿了。我想要两碗牛肉面。
explanation: two bowls of beef noodles表示“两碗牛肉面”，bowl和noodle都要用复数。

stem: ________ delicious the mooncakes are!
stemZh: 这些月饼多么美味啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词delicious，用How引导感叹句。

stem: There ________ a lot of milk in the bottle.
stemZh: 瓶子里有很多牛奶。
explanation: milk是不可数名词，there be句型中be动词用is。

stem: He ______ the vegetables into small pieces and started frying them.
stemZh: 他把蔬菜切成小块，开始炒。
explanation: cut表示“切”，cut the vegetables into small pieces意为把蔬菜切成小块。

stem: ________ time we're having today!
stemZh: 我们今天玩得多么开心啊！
explanation: time表示“一段时光”时是可数名词，用What a good。

stem: I only put ________ sugar in the milk, so it won't be too sweet for you.
stemZh: 我只在牛奶里放了一点糖，所以对你来说不会太甜。
explanation: sugar是不可数名词，a little表示“一点”，符合语境。

stem: You should sleep for ____ eight hours a day to keep healthy.
stemZh: 为了保持健康，你每天应该至少睡八个小时。
explanation: at least表示“至少”，每天至少睡八小时。

stem: ____useful information you gave us!
stemZh: 你给我们提供了多么有用的信息啊！
explanation: information是不可数名词，用What引导感叹句。

stem: —How many ________ are there in your school —Twenty.
stemZh: ——你们学校有多少女教师？——二十。
explanation: How many后接可数名词复数，woman作定语修饰复数名词时变women，故用women teachers。

stem: —______ exciting news! Our team won the game.
stemZh: ——多么令人兴奋的消息啊！我们队赢了比赛。
explanation: news是不可数名词，用What引导感叹句。

stem: —________ sweet the orange juice smells!
stemZh: ——橙汁闻起来多么甜啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词sweet，用How引导感叹句。

stem: ____ fun it is to build a sandcastle with kids on the beach!
stemZh: 和孩子们在沙滩上堆沙堡多么有趣啊！
explanation: fun是不可数名词，用What引导感叹句。

stem: Before you cook the noodles, you should ______ the water in the pot.
stemZh: 煮面之前，你应该先把锅里的水烧开。
explanation: boil the water表示“烧水”，煮面前要先烧开水。

stem: The scientist made a ____ that changed people's understanding.
stemZh: 这位科学家做出了一项改变人们认知的发现。
explanation: make a discovery表示“做出发现”，与科学家改变人们认知的语境相符。

stem: On the first day of the Spring Festival, we wear new clothes and visit our friends and ____.
stemZh: 春节第一天，我们穿上新衣服，拜访朋友和亲戚。
explanation: relatives表示“亲戚”，春节期间拜访亲戚是传统习俗。

stem: Don't forget to ____ the vegetables before you put them into the pot.
stemZh: 把蔬菜放进锅里之前，别忘了把它们切碎。
explanation: cut up表示“切碎”，符合把蔬菜放进锅前切碎的语境。

stem: Annie can dance well. It seems that she was born ________ a great talent for dancing.
stemZh: 安妮舞跳得很好。似乎她天生具有舞蹈天赋。
explanation: be born with表示“天生具有”，be born with a talent意为天生有天赋。

stem: —Can I help you —Yes, I'd like ________.
stemZh: ——需要帮忙吗？——是的，我想要三片面包。
explanation: three pieces of bread表示“三片面包”，bread是不可数名词。

stem: How many ________ do you need
stemZh: 你需要几箱橙子？
explanation: How many后接可数名词复数，boxes of oranges表示“几箱橙子”。

stem: First, ________ two tomatoes and some beef. Then put them into boiled water.
stemZh: 首先，把两个西红柿和一些牛肉切碎。然后把它们放进开水里。
explanation: cut up表示“切碎”，符合把食材切碎的语境。

stem: ________ hard the students are working!
stemZh: 学生们学习多么努力啊！
explanation: 中心词是副词hard，用How引导感叹句。

stem: ____ important news is to everybody in the modern world!
stemZh: 在现代世界，新闻对每个人来说多么重要啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词important，用How引导感叹句。

stem: There ________ some water in the glass.
stemZh: 玻璃杯里有一些水。
explanation: water是不可数名词，there be句型中be动词用is。

stem: The boy would like ________.
stemZh: 这个男孩想要两片面包。
explanation: two pieces of bread表示“两片面包”，bread是不可数名词。

stem: —Could you please give me some ________ on how to improve my writing —Sure. First, you should read more good articles.
stemZh: ——你能给我一些关于如何提高写作的建议吗？——当然。首先，你应该多读好文章。
explanation: advice是不可数名词，没有复数形式。

stem: —____ chicken soup do we need to make Yunnan Rice Noodles? —A big bowl.
stemZh: ——做云南米线我们需要多少鸡汤？——一大碗。
explanation: soup是不可数名词，用How much提问数量。

stem: ________ wonderful the movie is!
stemZh: 这部电影多么精彩啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词wonderful，用How引导感叹句。

stem: There ________ some water in the cup.
stemZh: 杯子里有一些水。
explanation: water是不可数名词，there be句型中be动词用is。

stem: —How much ________ do you need —One kilo.
stemZh: ——你需要多少土豆？——一公斤。
explanation: 此处表示“多少土豆”，potatoes是可数名词复数，符合称重购买的语境。

stem: ________ nice weather! Let's go for a walk.
stemZh: 多么好的天气啊！我们去散步吧。
explanation: weather是不可数名词，用What引导感叹句。

stem: _________ exciting experience they had at the V-Day military parade last weekend!
stemZh: 上周末他们在胜利日阅兵式上经历了一次多么激动人心的经历啊！
explanation: experience在此指“一次经历”，是可数名词单数，exciting以元音音素开头，用What an。

stem: The recipe says we need two ______ of butter and a cup of milk.
stemZh: 食谱上说我们需要两汤匙黄油和一杯牛奶。
explanation: tablespoons表示“汤匙”，two tablespoons of butter意为两汤匙黄油。

stem: The number of the students in our school ________ about 2,000.
stemZh: 我们学校的学生人数大约是2000人。
explanation: the number of作主语，表示“……的数量”，谓语用单数is。

stem: Scientists are ________ new ways to reuse water to save resources.
stemZh: 科学家们正在寻找重复利用水的新方法来节约资源。
explanation: look for表示“寻找”，科学家在寻找新方法。

stem: ________ colourful picture! I love it.
stemZh: 多么色彩鲜艳的一幅画啊！我喜欢它。
explanation: picture是可数名词单数，colourful以辅音音素开头，用What a。

stem: —How is the weather in Zhenjiang today? —There is much ________ here. You may need an umbrella.
stemZh: ——今天镇江的天气怎么样？——这里雨水很多。你可能需要一把伞。
explanation: much修饰不可数名词rain，there is much rain表示雨水很多。

stem: The beef dumplings we ordered at the restaurant ________ really good, so we ate two plates.
stemZh: 我们在餐馆点的牛肉饺子尝起来真不错，所以我们吃了两盘。
explanation: 根据“we ate two plates”可知用一般过去时tasted。

stem: —Could you please pass me the ____ I need to cut the steak. —Sure, here you are.
stemZh: ——你能把刀递给我吗？我需要切牛排。——当然，给你。
explanation: 切牛排需要刀，用knife。

stem: — The soup tastes a bit bland. — You can add some ________ to it.
stemZh: ——这汤尝起来有点淡。——你可以往里面加一些胡椒。
explanation: pepper作为调味品时通常不可数，some pepper表示“一些胡椒”。

stemZh: 我想要两瓶橙汁。
explanation: two bottles of orange juice表示“两瓶橙汁”，juice不可数。

stem: ________ fine weather it is today!
stemZh: 今天天气多么好啊！
explanation: weather是不可数名词，用What引导感叹句。

stem: If the soup is not salty enough, you can ________ a little more salt ________ it.
stemZh: 如果汤不够咸，你可以往里面再加一点盐。
explanation: add...to...表示“把……加到……中”。

stem: The farmer keeps lots of ________ on his farm.
stemZh: 这个农民在农场里养了许多羊。
explanation: sheep单复数同形，lots of sheep表示“许多羊”。

stem: ________ bad weather it was! We decided ________.
stemZh: 天气多么糟糕啊！我们决定不出去。
explanation: 第一空weather是不可数名词，用What；第二空decide not to do sth.表示“决定不做某事”。

stem: —________ lovely toy! Do you know its name —Yes. Its name is Binbin, one of the mascots of the 9th Asian Winter Games.
stemZh: ——多么可爱的玩具啊！你知道它的名字吗？——知道。它叫滨滨，是第九届亚冬会吉祥物之一。
explanation: toy是可数名词单数，lovely以辅音音素开头，用What a。

stem: The dish my mom is cooking in the kitchen ________ so nice that I can't wait to sit at the table.
stemZh: 妈妈在厨房做的菜闻起来太香了，我迫不及待想坐到餐桌旁。
explanation: smell表示“闻起来”，根据“in the kitchen”可知菜正在做，闻到香味。

stem: I like hiking in the forest because the air is ________ fresh.
stemZh: 我喜欢在森林里徒步，因为空气相当清新。
explanation: pretty可以修饰形容词，表示“相当”，pretty fresh意为相当清新。

stem: After reading the book, please remember to ______ it ______ on the shelf.
stemZh: 读完这本书后，请记得把它放回书架上。
explanation: put...back表示“放回原处”，把书放回书架。

stem: We need to plant more trees to improve our living ________.
stemZh: 我们需要种更多的树来改善我们的生活环境。
explanation: living environment表示“生活环境”，种树可以改善生活环境。

stem: ________ exciting news! We will have a ________ holiday after the exam.
stemZh: 多么令人兴奋的消息啊！考试后我们将有一个两天的假期。
explanation: 第一空news是不可数名词，用What；第二空two-day是复合形容词，作定语修饰holiday。

stem: I'd like some ________ and a glass of milk for breakfast.
stemZh: 我早餐想要一些面包和一杯牛奶。
explanation: bread是不可数名词，some bread表示“一些面包”。

stem: Look! ________ carefully Cathy is studying! We should learn from her.
stemZh: 看！凯茜学习多么认真啊！我们应该向她学习。
explanation: 中心词是副词carefully，用How引导感叹句。

stem: ________ loud noises when you are eating in a formal restaurant. It is not polite.
stemZh: 在正式餐厅吃饭时不要发出很大的噪音。这不礼貌。
explanation: 祈使句的否定形式用Don't + 动词原形。

stem: I love Italian food: pizza, ________ and so on.
stemZh: 我喜欢意大利食物：披萨、意面等等。
explanation: pasta是意大利面食，属于意大利食物。

stem: My grandmother's ______ for tomato soup is a family secret.
stemZh: 我奶奶的番茄汤食谱是家族秘密。
explanation: recipe表示“食谱”，番茄汤的食谱是家族秘密。

stem: —What would you like —I'd like ________.
stemZh: ——你想要什么？——我想要两杯牛奶。
explanation: two glasses of milk表示“两杯牛奶”，milk不可数。

stem: My mother often ____ soup for us before dinner to help us digest better.
stemZh: 妈妈经常在晚饭前给我们煮汤，帮助我们更好地消化。
explanation: boil soup表示“煮汤”，符合煮汤帮助消化的语境。

stem: __________ the boy is running! He must be the first place.
stemZh: 这个男孩跑得多么快啊！他一定是第一名。
explanation: 修饰动词running用副词，根据“He must be the first place”可知跑得快，用How fast。

stem: We should protect the environment ______ it's important for our health.
stemZh: 我们应该保护环境，因为它对我们的健康很重要。
explanation: because引导原因状语从句，说明保护环境的原因。

stem: ________ lovely the little girl is!
stemZh: 这个小女孩多么可爱啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词lovely，用How引导感叹句。

stem: ________ surprising news it is!
stemZh: 这是多么令人惊讶的消息啊！
explanation: news是不可数名词，用What引导感叹句。

stem: —How much butter do you need —I need ________.
stemZh: ——你需要多少黄油？——我需要两勺黄油。
explanation: butter是不可数名词，two spoons of butter表示“两勺黄油”。

stem: Everyone should ________ in protecting the environment to make the world better.
stemZh: 每个人都应该在保护环境中发挥作用，让世界更美好。
explanation: play a part in表示“在……中发挥作用”。

stem: These ________ have saved many children's lives.
stemZh: 这些女医生挽救了许多孩子的生命。
explanation: woman作定语修饰复数名词时，woman也要变复数，用women doctors。

stem: Before you make a fruit salad, you need to ________ the apples into small pieces.
stemZh: 做水果沙拉之前，你需要把苹果切成小块。
explanation: cut up表示“切碎”，符合把苹果切成小块的语境。

stem: You should ________ the onions and put them in the pan.
stemZh: 你应该把洋葱切碎，放进锅里。
explanation: cut up表示“切碎”，把洋葱切碎放进锅里。

stem: It is sunny. What ________ day!
stemZh: 天气晴朗。多么好的一天啊！
explanation: day是可数名词单数，good以辅音音素开头，用What a good day。

stem: To make pancakes better, you need to ______ the flour ______ milk and eggs first.
stemZh: 为了把煎饼做得更好，你需要先把面粉和牛奶、鸡蛋混合。
explanation: mix...with...表示“把……和……混合”。

stem: —Would you like ________ more fruit salad? —Yes, please. It tastes really fresh and sweet.
stemZh: ——你想再来一些水果沙拉吗？——好的，谢谢。它尝起来真的又新鲜又甜。
explanation: 表示委婉请求的疑问句中用some。

stem: The water is ______. You can make tea now.
stemZh: 水开了。你现在可以泡茶了。
explanation: boiling表示“沸腾的”，作表语描述水的状态。

stem: To make the soup more flavorful, you should ______ some pepper and salt.
stemZh: 为了让汤更有味道，你应该加一些胡椒和盐。
explanation: add表示“添加”，往汤里加胡椒和盐。

stem: What ________ it is to have a picnic in the park!
stemZh: 在公园野餐多么有趣啊！
explanation: fun是不可数名词，用great fun，感叹句用What。

stem: ________ the teachers in their school is 208 and one fifth of them are ________ teachers.
stemZh: 他们学校的教师人数是208人，其中五分之一是女教师。
explanation: 第一空the number of表示“……的数量”；第二空one fifth of them are women teachers，woman变复数。

stem: Eating too much junk food ____ bad for our health.
stemZh: 吃太多垃圾食品对我们的健康有害。
explanation: 动名词短语Eating too much junk food作主语，谓语用单数is。

stem: —Hi, Mary. ____ beautiful day! —Yes, it is.
stemZh: ——嗨，玛丽。多么美好的一天啊！——是的。
explanation: day是可数名词单数，beautiful以辅音音素开头，用What a。

stem: —How many ________ do we need for the vegetable soup —Only one.
stemZh: ——做蔬菜汤我们需要多少个西红柿？——只要一个。
explanation: How many后接可数名词复数，tomato的复数是tomatoes。

stem: Look at the rain. ________ bad weather it is!
stemZh: 看这雨。天气多么糟糕啊！
explanation: weather是不可数名词，用What引导感叹句。

stem: The story is very ____. It's easy for children to understand.
stemZh: 这个故事很简单。孩子们很容易理解。
explanation: simple表示“简单的”，根据“easy for children to understand”可知。

stem: It's every policeman's ________ to keep people safe and the traffic in good order.
stemZh: 保障人民安全和交通秩序是每个警察的职责。
explanation: job表示“职责”，保持安全和交通秩序是警察的职责。

stem: —______ delicious the soup is!
stemZh: ——这汤多么美味啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词delicious，用How引导感叹句。

stem: ______ delicious the stir-fried eggs and tomatoes smell!
stemZh: 西红柿炒鸡蛋闻起来多么香啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词delicious，用How引导感叹句。

stem: ________ great day January 1, 2001 will be!
stemZh: 2001年1月1日将是多么伟大的一天啊！
explanation: day是可数名词单数，great以辅音音素开头，用What a。

stem: Could you please pass me the ________? I want to spread some on my bread.
stemZh: 你能把黄油递给我吗？我想在面包上抹一些。
explanation: butter是不可数名词，the butter表示“黄油”。

stem: The young artist was thrilled to win the first ____ in the national competition.
stemZh: 这位年轻艺术家在全国比赛中获得一等奖，非常激动。
explanation: win the first prize表示“获得一等奖”。

stem: —Why do people in the south like eating rice —Because the warm climate is good for growing ____.
stemZh: ——为什么南方人喜欢吃米饭？——因为温暖的气候适合种植水稻。
explanation: 根据“people in the south like eating rice”可知是rice。

stem: —I followed your advice and the fish tastes delicious! —________. I'm glad you like it.
stemZh: ——我照你的建议做了，鱼很好吃！——不客气。很高兴你喜欢。
explanation: My pleasure表示“不客气”，回应对方的感谢。

stem: It will be ________ tomorrow, so there will be a lot of ________ tomorrow.
stemZh: 明天会下雨，所以明天会有很多雨。
explanation: 第一空用形容词rainy作表语；第二空用名词rain。

stem: —How much ________ do we need to make the milk shake —Only two teaspoons.
stemZh: ——做奶昔我们需要多少酸奶？——只要两茶匙。
explanation: How much提问不可数名词，yogurt是不可数名词。

stem: These are ________.
stemZh: 这些是两杯茶。
explanation: tea是不可数名词，two cups of tea表示“两杯茶”。

stem: There is ________ in the fridge.
stemZh: 冰箱里有一瓶牛奶。
explanation: a bottle of milk表示“一瓶牛奶”，milk不可数。

stem: Robots can do simple jobs ________ and never get bored.
stemZh: 机器人能反复做简单的工作，从不感到无聊。
explanation: over and over again表示“反复地”，符合机器人重复做简单工作的语境。

stem: ________ exciting the football match is!
stemZh: 这场足球比赛多么激动人心啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词exciting，用How引导感叹句。

stem: —How much ________ do you need to make the salad —Only two teaspoons.
stemZh: ——做沙拉你需要多少酸奶？——只要两茶匙。
explanation: How much提问不可数名词的量，yogurt是不可数名词。

stem: —In the past, people thought it was ________ to travel to the moon. —I think we will travel there one day.
stemZh: ——过去人们认为去月球旅行是不可能的。——我想有一天我们会去那里旅行。
explanation: impossible表示“不可能的”，与过去人们对登月的看法相符。

stem: If you ______ five ______ ten, you will get fifteen.
stemZh: 如果你把五和十相加，你会得到十五。
explanation: add...to...表示“把……加到……中”，5加10等于15。

stem: Wash the vegetables and ________.
stemZh: 把蔬菜洗一洗，然后把它们切碎。
explanation: 动词+副词短语，代词作宾语时放在中间，vegetables是复数用cut them up。

stem: Finally, I finished my homework on time.
stemZh: 最后，我按时完成了作业。
explanation: Finally与In the end意思相近，表示“最后”。

stem: According ________ Mr. Wang, we'll go on a trip this weekend.
stemZh: 根据王老师所说，我们这周末要去旅行。
explanation: according to表示“根据”。

stem: The ______ of the dish comes from the fresh tomatoes and onions.
stemZh: 这道菜的甜味来自新鲜的西红柿和洋葱。
explanation: sweetness表示“甜味”，来自新鲜西红柿和洋葱。

stem: ______ beautiful the landscape is!
stemZh: 这风景多么美丽啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词beautiful，用How引导感叹句。

stem: ________ lovely the baby is!
stemZh: 这个婴儿多么可爱啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词lovely，用How引导感叹句。

stem: ________ exciting moment it is!
stemZh: 这是多么激动人心的时刻啊！
explanation: moment是可数名词单数，exciting以元音音素开头，用What an。

stem: —The kids are too noisy. We need to hand out these books to them. —I think we'd better call them ____ to get their books.
stemZh: ——孩子们太吵了。我们需要把这些书发给他们。——我想我们最好一个一个叫他们来拿书。
explanation: one by one表示“一个一个地”，叫孩子们逐个来拿书。

stem: I'm looking forward to ____ the traditional food in Sichuan during my trip.
stemZh: 我期待着旅行期间品尝四川的传统美食。
explanation: look forward to doing sth.表示“期待做某事”，to是介词后接动名词。

stem: —The braised fish you made tastes great! —________ some more, please.
stemZh: ——你做的红烧鱼味道真好！——请再多吃一些。
explanation: Help yourself to表示“随便吃”，招待客人多吃一些。

stem: ________ enjoyable the spring outing last Friday was!
stemZh: 上周五的春游多么令人愉快啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词enjoyable，用How引导感叹句。

stem: Don't forget to ______ the potatoes before boiling them.
stemZh: 煮土豆之前别忘了把它们切碎。
explanation: cut up表示“切碎”，煮之前把土豆切碎。

stem: To make potato salad, first you need to ______ the cooked potatoes until they are soft.
stemZh: 做土豆沙拉，首先你需要把煮熟的土豆捣碎，直到变软。
explanation: mash表示“捣碎”，制作土豆沙拉需要把煮熟的土豆捣碎。

stem: I need ________ honey to make the cake.
stemZh: 做蛋糕我需要两勺蜂蜜。
explanation: honey是不可数名词，two spoons of honey表示“两勺蜂蜜”。

stem: ____educational movie Beyond the Clouds is！
stemZh: 《云上之上》这部电影多么有教育意义啊！
explanation: movie是可数名词单数，educational以元音音素开头，用What an。

stem: There are five ________ in the fridge.
stemZh: 冰箱里有五瓶牛奶。
explanation: five bottles of milk表示“五瓶牛奶”，milk不可数。

stem: ________ exciting news! Chinese Team won the game at last!
stemZh: 多么令人兴奋的消息啊！中国队最终赢了比赛！
explanation: news是不可数名词，用What引导感叹句。

stem: ________ honest the boy was!
stemZh: 这个男孩多么诚实啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词honest，用How引导感叹句。

stem: Mother asked me to ______ the big apple ______ small pieces for my little sister.
stemZh: 妈妈让我把大苹果切成小块给妹妹。
explanation: cut...into...表示“把……切成……”。

stem: _________ bad news it is and _____________ the children all look!
stemZh: 这是多么糟糕的消息啊，孩子们看起来多么惊讶啊！
explanation: 第一空news是不可数名词，用What；第二空修饰人用surprised。

stem: I don't like the ______ in this soup. It's too spicy for me.
stemZh: 我不喜欢这汤里的胡椒。对我来说太辣了。
explanation: pepper表示“胡椒”，根据“too spicy”可知是胡椒。

stem: ________ do you usually deal ________ your old clothes
stemZh: 你通常如何处理你的旧衣服？
explanation: How...deal with表示“如何处理”，deal with是固定搭配。

stem: I had ________ bread and a glass of warm milk for breakfast this morning.
stemZh: 今天早上我早餐吃了一片面包和一杯温牛奶。
explanation: bread是不可数名词，用a piece of表示“一片”。

stem: —What can I do for you, Mom —I'd like ________.
stemZh: ——妈妈，我能为你做什么？——我想要两杯酸奶。
explanation: yogurt是不可数名词，two cups of yogurt表示“两杯酸奶”。

stem: To make a cake, you need to ______ the flour, eggs, and sugar together in a bowl first.
stemZh: 做蛋糕，你需要先把面粉、鸡蛋和糖在碗里混合在一起。
explanation: mix表示“混合”，把面粉、鸡蛋和糖混合。

stem: The dumplings are so cold. You must ____ them.
stemZh: 饺子太凉了。你必须把它们加热。
explanation: heat表示“加热”，饺子凉了需要加热。

stem: ________ beautiful day! —Yes, it is.
stemZh: 多么美好的一天啊！——是的。
explanation: day是可数名词单数，beautiful以辅音音素开头，用What a。

stem: —How much ________ do you want —Two kilos.
stemZh: ——你想要多少肉？——两公斤。
explanation: How much提问不可数名词的量，meat是不可数名词。

stem: ________ funny person he is! He often tells jokes to make us happy.
stemZh: 他是个多么有趣的人啊！他经常讲笑话让我们开心。
explanation: person是可数名词单数，funny以辅音音素开头，用What a。

stem: Before you start making the cake, read the ________ carefully, or you might miss an important step.
stemZh: 开始做蛋糕之前，仔细阅读说明，否则你可能会漏掉重要步骤。
explanation: instructions表示“说明”，做蛋糕前要阅读说明。

stem: We need ________ yogurt and ________ honey to make the cake.
stemZh: 做蛋糕我们需要两勺酸奶和一杯蜂蜜。
options: two spoons of; a cup of
explanation: yogurt和honey都是不可数名词，用two spoons of和a cup of。

stem: ________ delicious the fish soup tastes with this kind of spice!
stemZh: 用这种香料做的鱼汤尝起来多么美味啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词delicious，用How引导感叹句。

stem: We need to ______ the oven to 200℃ before baking the cookies.
stemZh: 烤饼干之前我们需要把烤箱加热到200度。
explanation: heat表示“加热”，把烤箱加热到指定温度。

stem: The mother ________ the apple in half and gave one piece to her child.
stemZh: 妈妈把苹果切成两半，把一块给了孩子。
explanation: cut的过去式是cut，根据gave可知用一般过去时。

stem: Inventions in ____ have improved our health care.
stemZh: 医学上的发明改善了我们的医疗保健。
explanation: medicine表示“医学”，医学发明改善了医疗保健。

stem: There ________ two glasses of milk on the table.
stemZh: 桌上有两杯牛奶。
explanation: two glasses of milk作主语，be动词用are。

stem: Look! Two ________ are planting ________ with their students.
stemZh: 看！两位男教师正在和学生们一起种苹果树。
explanation: 第一空man作定语修饰复数名词时变men；第二空apple作定语修饰trees，用单数。

stem: Bob likes to go ________ boating.
stemZh: 鲍勃喜欢去划船。
explanation: go boating是固定搭配，不加冠词。

stem: ________ a clever boy he is!
stemZh: 他是个多么聪明的男孩啊！
explanation: What + a + 形容词 + 可数名词单数 + 主谓，此处用What引导。

stem: —What else do we need to make the dumplings, Mom —We need ________.
stemZh: ——妈妈，包饺子我们还需要什么？——我们需要两勺盐。
explanation: salt是不可数名词，two spoons of salt表示“两勺盐”。

stem: ______ you heat the oil before adding the vegetables?
stemZh: 你在加蔬菜之前加热油了吗？
explanation: 根据语境，询问过去是否做过，用Did。

stem: The restaurant is famous for its ____ chicken, which is crispy outside and tender inside.
stemZh: 这家餐馆以其炸鸡闻名，外酥里嫩。
explanation: fried chicken表示“炸鸡”，外酥里嫩。

stem: There ________ some milk and two eggs on the table.
stemZh: 桌上有一些牛奶和两个鸡蛋。
explanation: there be句型遵循就近原则，milk是不可数名词，be动词用is。

stem: ________ the boy works! I am proud of him.
stemZh: 这个男孩工作多么认真啊！我为他感到骄傲。
explanation: 修饰动词works用副词carefully，用How carefully。

stem: There are two ________ on the table.
stemZh: 桌上有两杯水。
explanation: two glasses of water表示“两杯水”，water不可数。

stem: Whenever she cooks, she ______ her grandmother's kitchen memories.
stemZh: 每当她做饭时，她都会想起奶奶的厨房记忆。
explanation: whenever引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时，主句也用一般现在时。

stem: Visiting local museums gives tourists a great ____ to learn more about the local history and culture.
stemZh: 参观当地博物馆给游客提供了一个了解当地历史和文化的好机会。
explanation: a great chance表示“一个好机会”。

stem: I'd like two ________.
stemZh: 我想要两碗面条。
explanation: two bowls of noodles表示“两碗面条”，noodle用复数。

stem: If you want to go to ________, you should take your schoolwork seriously.
stemZh: 如果你想上大学，你应该认真对待学业。
explanation: university表示“大学”，上大学需要认真对待学业。

stem: Could you please help me ________ two eggs into the bowl and mix them well? We will make scrambled eggs.
stemZh: 你能帮我把两个鸡蛋打进碗里并搅拌均匀吗？我们要做炒鸡蛋。
explanation: break eggs表示“打鸡蛋”，做炒鸡蛋需要打蛋。

stem: —I want to make stir-fried eggs and tomatoes. ________ sugar do I need —You need ________ sugar.
stemZh: ——我想做西红柿炒鸡蛋。我需要多少糖？——你需要两勺糖。
explanation: sugar是不可数名词，用How much提问；two spoons of sugar表示“两勺糖”。

stem: The delicious dish ____ beef, potatoes and carrots.
stemZh: 这道美味的菜由牛肉、土豆和胡萝卜做成。
explanation: be made of表示“由……制成”，能看出原材料。

stem: Everyone loves my dog Coffee, though he often makes a ________ at home.
stemZh: 大家都喜欢我的狗Coffee，尽管他经常在家里弄得一团糟。
explanation: make a mess表示“弄得一团糟”。

stem: My lift can carry 12 people ________ at a time. There is not enough room for more.
stemZh: 我的电梯一次最多能载12人。没有更多空间了。
explanation: at most表示“至多”，电梯最多载12人。

stem: —Let's make steamed fish for Linda's birthday dinner. —____.
stemZh: ——我们为琳达的生日晚餐做清蒸鱼吧。——好主意。
explanation: Good idea表示“好主意”，赞同对方的提议。

stem: ____good news! Why not tell it to your parents right now
stemZh: 多么好的消息啊！为什么不马上告诉你父母呢？
explanation: news是不可数名词，用What引导感叹句。

stem: ________ wonderful time we had at the party!
stemZh: 我们在聚会上玩得多么开心啊！
explanation: time表示“一段时光”时是可数名词，用What a。

stem: ________ great fun it is to have a picnic!
stemZh: 野餐多么有趣啊！
explanation: fun是不可数名词，用What引导感叹句。

stem: She ______ the milk into the bowl and mixed it with flour.
stemZh: 她把牛奶倒进碗里，和面粉混合。
explanation: pour表示“倒”，把牛奶倒进碗里。

stem: ________ interesting book it is!
stemZh: 这是多么有趣的一本书啊！
explanation: book是可数名词单数，interesting以元音音素开头，用What an。

stem: Two ________ of bread ________ enough for breakfast.
stemZh: 两片面包对于早餐来说足够了。
explanation: bread是不可数名词，用pieces；two pieces of bread作主语，谓语用单数is。

stem: ________ nice girl Kate is!
stemZh: 凯特是个多么好的女孩啊！
explanation: girl是可数名词单数，nice以辅音音素开头，用What a。

stem: —I love traveling but I don't know where to go next. —Well, ____ you make up your mind, I can help you plan the trip.
stemZh: ——我喜欢旅行，但我不知道接下来去哪里。——那么，无论你何时下定决心，我都可以帮你计划行程。
explanation: whenever表示“无论何时”，引导时间状语从句。

stem: ________ educational movie Beyond the Clouds is!
stemZh: 《云上之上》这部电影多么有教育意义啊！
explanation: movie是可数名词单数，educational以元音音素开头，用What an。

stem: ____ a wonderful experience it is to accept ourselves!
stemZh: 接纳自己是一次多么美妙的经历啊！
explanation: experience在此指“一次经历”，是可数名词单数，题干已给出不定冠词a，用What a wonderful experience it is。

stem: The ______ in the kitchen was a mess after I tried to bake a cake.
stemZh: 我试着烤蛋糕后，厨房的台面一团糟。
explanation: counter表示“台面”，厨房台面一团糟。

stem: There ________ a book and two pens on the desk.
stemZh: 桌上有一本书和两支钢笔。
explanation: there be句型遵循就近原则，a book是单数，be动词用is。

stem: When you ________ vegetables for cooking, be careful not to cut your fingers with the knife.
stemZh: 当你切菜做饭时，小心不要用刀切到手指。
explanation: cut up表示“切碎”，切菜时小心不要切到手。

stem: —What's your favorite ____ —I like Italian food best, especially pizza and pasta.
stemZh: ——你最喜欢什么菜系？——我最喜欢意大利菜，尤其是披萨和意面。
explanation: cuisine表示“烹饪风格、菜系”，意大利菜是一种菜系。

stem: _______ fast Liu Xiang runs!
stemZh: 刘翔跑得多么快啊！
explanation: 中心词是副词fast，用How引导感叹句。

stem: There are two ________ and six ________ in the zoo.
stemZh: 动物园里有两个猴子和六只狼。
explanation: monkey的复数是monkeys；wolf的复数是wolves。

stem: The chef added a little salt to the soup to improve its ____.
stemZh: 厨师往汤里加了一点盐来改善味道。
explanation: improve its taste表示“改善味道”，加盐是为了改善味道。

stem: —________ fine weather! It's a good match for going on a picnic.
stemZh: ——多么好的天气啊！很适合去野餐。
explanation: weather是不可数名词，用What引导感叹句。

stem: ________ nice cars!
stemZh: 多么漂亮的车啊！
explanation: cars是复数名词，用What引导感叹句。

stem: — ____ good advice! It's so helpful to us. — Thank you.
stemZh: ——多么好的建议啊！对我们太有帮助了。——谢谢。
explanation: advice是不可数名词，用What引导感叹句。

stem: —Helen, do you know how to put up a shelf —It's easy. Just read the ________.
stemZh: ——海伦，你知道怎么安装架子吗？——很简单。只要阅读说明。
explanation: instructions表示“用法说明”，安装架子需要阅读说明。

stem: —How much yogurt do we need —We need ________ yogurt.
stemZh: ——我们需要多少酸奶？——我们需要两杯酸奶。
explanation: two cups of yogurt表示“两杯酸奶”，yogurt不可数。

stem: As we all know, Finland is ________ island country.
stemZh: 众所周知，芬兰是一个岛国。
explanation: island以元音音素开头，用an。

stem: — What's your favorite ________? — I like cheddar best.
stemZh: ——你最喜欢什么奶酪？——我最喜欢切达奶酪。
explanation: cheese是不可数名词，favorite cheese表示“最喜欢的奶酪”。

stem: —________ salt do we need to make a bowl of tomato and egg soup? —Just one small spoon, please.
stemZh: ——做一碗西红柿鸡蛋汤我们需要多少盐？——只要一小勺。
explanation: salt是不可数名词，用How much提问。

stem: When making noodles, we need to ____ the dough first and then cut it into strips.
stemZh: 做面条时，我们需要先揉面团，然后切成条。
explanation: knead the dough表示“揉面团”。

stem: —What should we ________ the empty plastic bottles? —We should recycle them to make new things.
stemZh: ——我们应该怎么处理空塑料瓶？——我们应该回收它们来制作新东西。
explanation: do with表示“处理”，处理空塑料瓶。

stem: ________ fast the boy is running!
stemZh: 这个男孩跑得多么快啊！
explanation: 中心词是副词fast，用How引导感叹句。

stem: Please ____ the milk into the blender slowly.
stemZh: 请慢慢把牛奶倒进搅拌机。
explanation: pour表示“倒”，把牛奶倒进搅拌机。

stem: —______ delicious the mashed potatoes are!
stemZh: ——土豆泥多么美味啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词delicious，用How引导感叹句。

stem: The telephone allows people to talk to each other over long ____.
stemZh: 电话使人们能够远距离互相交谈。
explanation: over long distances表示“远距离”。

stem: The lion is often used as a ____ of courage.
stemZh: 狮子常被用作勇气的象征。
explanation: a symbol of courage表示“勇气的象征”。

stem: ______ a great party! ______ delicious the food is!
stemZh: 多么棒的聚会啊！食物多么美味啊！
explanation: 第一空party是可数名词单数，用What a；第二空中心词是形容词delicious，用How。

stem: ________ teenagers said they dreamed of _______ to the moon one day.
stemZh: 相当多的青少年说他们梦想有一天去月球。
explanation: quite a few表示“相当多”；dream of doing sth.表示“梦想做某事”。

stem: —________ expensive car it is! —Sure is. It's my uncle's.
stemZh: ——这是多么昂贵的车啊！——确实。是我叔叔的。
explanation: car是可数名词单数，expensive以元音音素开头，用What an。

stem: ________ useful language English is!
stemZh: 英语是多么有用的语言啊！
explanation: language是可数名词单数，useful以辅音音素开头，用What a。

stem: —________ nice girl Lucy is! —Yes. She always helps others.
stemZh: ——露西是个多么好的女孩啊！——是的。她总是帮助别人。
explanation: girl是可数名词单数，nice以辅音音素开头，用What a。

stem: ________ the mooncakes are!
stemZh: 这些月饼多么美味啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词delicious，用How delicious引导感叹句。

stem: —I'm trying to make a new drink. —You should be careful when you ____ different kinds of juice together.
stemZh: ——我在尝试做一种新饮料。——当你把不同种类的果汁混合在一起时要小心。
explanation: mix表示“混合”，把不同果汁混合在一起。

stem: —Would you like some ____ It's my favorite fruit. —Yes, please. It tastes sweet and sour.
stemZh: ——你想来点草莓吗？这是我最喜欢的水果。——好的，谢谢。它尝起来又甜又酸。
explanation: 根据“favorite fruit”可知是水果，strawberries是水果。

stem: —________ funny the movie is! —Yes. Lots of children like it.
stemZh: ——这部电影多么有趣啊！——是的。很多孩子喜欢它。
explanation: 中心词是形容词funny，用How引导感叹句。

stem: The story's ____ is "Be yourself and be confident".
stemZh: 这个故事的寓意是“做自己，要自信”。
explanation: message表示“信息、寓意”，故事的寓意是做自己。

stem: We made a strawberry cake for my mom's birthday. ________, we put a small chocolate card with "Happy Birthday" on the top.
stemZh: 我们为妈妈的生日做了一个草莓蛋糕。最后，我们在上面放了一张写着“生日快乐”的小巧克力卡片。
explanation: Finally表示“最后”，描述做蛋糕的最后一步。

stem: There ________ some apples and a banana on the plate.
stemZh: 盘子里有一些苹果和一根香蕉。
explanation: there be句型遵循就近原则，apples是复数，be动词用are。

stem: —What would you like to drink —I'd like ________.
stemZh: ——你想喝什么？——我想要一杯茶。
explanation: a cup of tea表示“一杯茶”，tea不可数。

stem: It is ________ to say "thank you" when the waiter serves you food in a restaurant.
stemZh: 在餐馆服务员给你上菜时说“谢谢”是有礼貌的。
explanation: polite表示“礼貌的”，说谢谢是有礼貌的。

stem: The first ______ on the shopping list is milk. Don't forget to buy it.
stemZh: 购物清单上的第一项是牛奶。别忘了买。
explanation: item表示“项目”，购物清单上的第一项是牛奶。

stem: ________ funny the story is!
stemZh: 这个故事多么有趣啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词funny，用How引导感叹句。

stem: I'd like three ________.
stemZh: 我想要三张纸。
explanation: paper是不可数名词，three pieces of paper表示“三张纸”。

stem: —________ bad weather it is! We can't go boating on Xuanwu Lake. —Don't worry! Let's go to Nanjing Museum instead.
stemZh: ——天气多么糟糕啊！我们不能去玄武湖划船了。——别担心！我们改去南京博物院吧。
explanation: weather是不可数名词，用What引导感叹句。

stem: —I'm having problems using this camera. What should I do? —You'd better read the ____ first. It will tell you how to use it.
stemZh: ——我用这个相机遇到问题了。我该怎么办？——你最好先阅读说明。它会告诉你如何使用。
explanation: instructions表示“说明”，阅读说明了解如何使用相机。

stem: —How many ________ are there in the box —Twenty.
stemZh: ——盒子里有多少个苹果？——二十个。
explanation: How many后接可数名词复数，用apples。

stem: Could you give me ________ on some colors in fashion?
stemZh: 你能给我一些关于时尚色彩的建议吗？
explanation: advice是不可数名词，排除C、D；希望得到肯定回答的疑问句用some。

stem: Although they are twins, they have ______ bedrooms because they like different styles.
stemZh: 虽然他们是双胞胎，但他们有各自的卧室，因为他们喜欢不同的风格。
explanation: separate表示“分开的、独立的”，双胞胎有各自的卧室。

stem: When you go camping, a flashlight is an important ______ to put in your bag.
stemZh: 去露营时，手电筒是包里要带的重要物品。
explanation: item表示“物品”，手电筒是露营要带的重要物品。

stem: ________ interesting the story is!
stemZh: 这个故事多么有趣啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词interesting，用How引导感叹句。

stem: We should ____ the food properly to keep it fresh for a longer time.
stemZh: 我们应该妥善储存食物，使其保持更长时间的新鲜。
explanation: store表示“储存”，妥善储存食物保持新鲜。

stem: ________ great fun we have ________ with each other at lunchtime!
stemZh: 午餐时间我们互相聊天多么有趣啊！
explanation: fun是不可数名词，用What；have fun doing sth.是固定搭配。

stem: ________ delicious the stir-fried eggs and tomatoes taste!
stemZh: 西红柿炒鸡蛋尝起来多么美味啊！
explanation: 中心词是形容词delicious，用How引导感叹句。

stem: My mother asked me to ________ some salt to the soup.
stemZh: 妈妈让我往汤里加一些盐。
explanation: add...to...表示“把……加到……中”，往汤里加盐。

stem: Before we start the basketball game, let's ______ for five minutes to avoid getting hurt.
stemZh: 开始篮球比赛前，让我们热身五分钟以避免受伤。
explanation: warm up表示“热身”，比赛前热身避免受伤。

stem: ________ good time the children had playing football on the playground!
stemZh: 孩子们在操场上踢足球玩得多么开心啊！
explanation: time表示“一段时光”时是可数名词，用What a。
